articleTitle: Classification of Rice-Plant Images into Healthy/Disease Class using ResNetV2 Variants
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Deep-learning (DL) approaches have gained widespread adoption in diverse domains due to their enhanced accuracy and adaptability. Notably, the application of the pre-trained DL models is widely considered by researchers to solve a variety of image examination tasks. The proposed research aims to implement the pre-trained ResNetV2 (RN2) model for a chosen plant disease examination task. This work used RN2 to classify the rice-plant leaf images (RLI) into healthy and disease classes using the SoftMax classifier. This work implements various pre-trained RN2 schemes for organizing the photos using (i) conventional deep features and (ii) reduced features after a 50% dropout rate. The experimental outcome of this work confirms that the presented results demonstrate that the implemented technique provides better detection accuracy on the chosen images for both the conventional and the reduced features. This result verified that the implemented technique best examines the RLI.

articleTitle: Integrating Jenkins for Efficient Deployment and Orchestration across Multi-Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper shows a comparative study of terraform and kubernetes as orchestration tools for cost optimization capabilities of these tools and provide insights into effective reducing of cloud expenditure. The primary objective of the research is to evaluate and compare the cost reduction capabilities of these tools in the cloud-based environment. This methodology involves planning and carrying out evaluates in a multiple clouds environment while simulating real-time workload and environment. Kubernetes and integrating with jenkinsto highlights its resource allocation efficiency and auto-scaling features as ways to reduce cost. The study also explores how advanced machine learning algorithms and predictive analytics might be incorporated into the orchestration process. It offers a path for businesses to take on a transformational journey toward cutting-edge cost-cutting tactics, reinventing the way multicloud settings are managed, and optimizing the return on cloud expenditures.

articleTitle: Detection of Stroke in Brain CT with Fused Deep-Features and Hummingbird Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Brain is one of the sensitive organs and the abnormality in the brain is a medical emergency. Hemorrhagic Stroke (HS) is one of the harsh brain condition and appropriate screening and treatment is necessary to reduce its harshness. Medical imaging supported brain screening is a common clinical practice to examine the HS. This work proposes Deep-Learning Technique (DT) to detect HS from the CT scan slices. The stages in this scheme includes; (i) CT slice collection and resizing, (ii) feature extraction using DT, (iii) Hummingbird-Algorithm based feature selection and serial features concatenation and (iv) classification and verification of the performance. This research considered N=2000 images (1000 healthy and 1000 stroke) along with the skull section. The performance of EfficientNet and DenseNet variants are considered to examine the CT slices. The experimental outcome of this study confirms that the fused optimal features helps to attain an accuracy of >96%. In future, this performance of this system can be improved by considering ensemble of features.

articleTitle: Toxicity Detection in Soap using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the most generic skincare products used by the majority of the masses is soap, which is availablein a variety of colors, shapes and fragrances. People generally tend to purchase soaps based on appearances and brand but unfortunately are unaware of the harmful chemical substances which are used in the process of manufacturing which deteriorates the skin causing long term damages. Furthermore, the popular brands in the market are endorsing soaps that predominantly contain carcinogens and the consumers are not aware of the health-hazards. Deep learning principles included in the suggested technique can be utilized to forecast soap’s toxicity based on the presence of dangerous ingredients. A deep learning model is created using the previous dataset which is the most essential part of deep learning. Machine learning is used to create a categorization model once the data has been displayed to aid in characteristic analysis. The precision, recall, and F1 score performance indicators are used to assess some algorithms.

articleTitle: Development of Lightweight Deep-Learning Scheme to Classify Retinal OCT into Normal/DME Class
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Eye is a vital sensory organ, which is responsible to convert the light into information. The abnormality in eye leads to a variety of vision issues and early diagnosis and treatment is necessary. This research proposes a Lightweight Deep-Learning Technique (LDLT) to examine the retinal Optical Coherence Tomography (OCT) images. The stages of this research includes; (i) data collection and resizing, (ii) feature mining using the chosen LDLT, and (iii) binary classification using five-fold cross validation and performance confirmation. In this study, the retinal OCTs of normal (1000 images) and Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) (1000 images) are considered for the examination with MobileNets (MNs) and NASNets (NNs). The classification of the OCTs is performed using the deep-features and the performance metrics computed during this task is then evaluated to confirm the merit of proposed tool. The experimental outcome of this study confirms that the MobileNetV2 (MNV2) helped to achieve a detection accuracy of >97% with the chosen data. In future, ensemble of features and fused deep-features are to be included to improve the DME detection accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Inclusive Online Conversations with Multimodal AI for Contextual Toxicity Analysis, Automated Rephrasing, and Bias Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Online communities and discussion platforms provide a suitable stage to share ideas, opinions and thoughts. But they have also created space to increase negativity by posting toxic and nuance contents and comments, leading to division, chaos and fights. These contents are sometimes targeted on a certain group of people based on gender, caste, religion and countries, paving ways to the disrupting of world peace. Some of these contents are targeted against an individual and are threatening and harsh, which can be coined as cyber bullying. The proposed system is aimed to provide a multi-featured solution that encompasses real time data moderation with the help of ensemble of embedder modules like GloVe, Emo2Vec and BERT to produce both semantic and contextual embeddings accompanied by BERT encoder and classifier, rephrasing module to provide inclusive paraphrases for the toxic inputs while preserving the information and a reinforcement module for the system to increase its adaptivity. This novel combination of modules overcomes the limitations of existing system by increasing the usability, robustness and real time processing.

articleTitle: Finding patterns in employee attrition rates using self-organizing Kohonen maps and decision trees
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This text presents a study of the causes of employee termination in organizations. Using employee data such as age, gender, marital status, monthly income, education, and others, an analysis was conducted using neural network algorithms (Kohonen maps) and Decision Trees. The results showed that both methods were suitable for analysis, but the neural network method showed the lowest error (7.4%). The analysis allowed to identify the most significant factors such as monthly income, age of employees, marital status and years of employment with the company. The analysis will help to optimize the process of predicting employee dismissal and save resources on unnecessary analyses.

articleTitle: Classification of Corn Leaf Images using Pre-Trained Deep Learning Schemes: A Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Automatic image classification using pre-trained deep learning (PDL) schemes are widely employed in several domains. This research aims to verify the classification performance of the chosen PDL schemes using the Corn Leaf Image (CLI) dataset. Stages existing in the proposed system include; (i) CLI collection, resizing and pre-processing with histogram equalization, (ii) feature extraction using chosen PDL scheme, (iii) SoftMax supported binary classification, and (iv) performance evaluation and verification. In this study, 3000 CLI images (1500 normal and 1500 rust instances) are examined. The experimental investigation of the study reveals that the VGG16 scheme exhibits superior classification accuracy on the chosen CLI dataset. Specifically, it achieves an accuracy of >93% when considering raw images and attains 100% accuracy when using pre-processed images. This research confirms that, in comparison to other models such as VGG19, ResNet variants, and DenseNet variants investigated in this study, VGG16 provides better result for the CLI dataset.

articleTitle: An Internet of Things Powered Systematic Weather Tracking System based on Environmental Evaluation Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The method that is presented in this work is an innovative approach to the problem of monitoring the climatic conditions in a specific location and making the results of that monitoring accessible in other parts of the world. The Internet of Things enables this by providing a sophisticated and efficient means of connecting real-world items to the web and of interconnecting these objects into a global network. In this category, the items might be anything, including electronic devices, sensors, and electronic equipment for automobiles. This study sets the framework for a practical solution that will allow for regional weather monitoring and the dissemination of that data to interested parties anywhere in the world. The Internet of Things, an efficient and effective method of linking objects to the web and associating the universe as a whole of things in a network, is likely responsible for many of the technical developments underlying this phenomena. It’s possible that we're talking about stuff like electrical gadgets, sensors, and electronic equipment for cars here. The system’s sensors monitor and record data about the surrounding environment, such as temperature, humidity, light intensity, barometric pressure, and precipitation rate. Every time these ratings surpass the chosen threshold constrain for every sensor an alert notification are sent to the device operator, notifying them to take the necessary steps.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Smart Credit Card Fraud Detection System using Intelligent Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: There has been an uptick in the incidence of fraudulent financial activity. The expansion of e-commerce and online payment systems has been connected to an increase in the number of instances of financial fraud, such as fraudulent use of credit cards. Because of this, it is extremely vital to put in place systems that are able to detect the theft of credit cards. The use of stolen credit cards is on the rise all across the world, and immediate action is required to tackle this growing problem. Because the major goal of the system is to protect users from being charged for products and services that they did not approve, setting a limit on this kind of conduct is in the users' best interests. It is essential to pick the characteristics of fraudulent transactions very carefully when employing machine learning for the purpose of detecting fraudulent credit card activity. Over the course of time, the fraudulent acts do not follow any identifiable pattern. Criminals are able to successfully commit acts of online fraud because to the utilization of newly developed technology. Because fraud is an ever-evolving crime, an effective fraud detection model has to be able to adjust to new circumstances and get better over time. We offer the Intelligent Learning Scheme for Digital Fraud Detection (ILSDFD), in this research. ILSDFDD is an engine for the detection of credit card fraud that is based on deep learning and makes use of the feature selection process and classification principles. The suggested remedy is deep learning, which is an unsupervised learning process that uses back-propagation and is based upon auto encoder network. This is accomplished by keeping the inputs and outputs equal to one another. Deep learning was included into the Auto Encoder that was utilized for this research using a Python-based development platform. The accuracy, precision, and recall of a model are the criteria that are used to determine how successful it is. The proposed algorithm is cross-validated with the conventional Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithm to prove the efficiency of the proposed scheme ILSDFD. The outcomes demonstrated that our suggested approach outperforms the other contestants' strategies and that the previously discussed techniques improve prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Supply Chain Visibility and Security: GPS-Based Smart Locks in Trucks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In modern supply chain administration, guaranteeing the perceivability and security of merchandise in travel has developed as a basic concern. The expanding complexity of worldwide exchange, coupled with the rising occasions of robbery and altering, has emphasized the require for inventive arrangements to improve supply chain productivity and security. This paper presents the concept of GPS-based shrewd locks coordinates inside trucks to address these challenges. The proposed arrangement involves the arrangement of GPS-enabled locks that utilize real-time area following and tamper-proof instruments to protect cargo amid transportation. These savvy locks offer a comprehensive approach to screen and oversee the development of products, empowering partners to track the exact area and status of shipments all through the supply chain travel. Leveraging progressed GPS innovation, the locks give ceaseless upgrades on the cargo's whereabouts, guaranteeing straightforwardness and real-time perceivability for both providers and clients. Additionally, the integration of savvy locks with advanced sensors empowers the location of any unauthorized get to or altering endeavors, activating prompt alarms to assigned specialists. This include essentially decreases the dangers related with pilferage, robbery, and fake item invasion, in this manner invigorating the security measures in put. Furthermore, the execution of secure communication conventions and scrambled information transmission encourage supports the flexibility of the framework against potential cybersecurity dangers.By tackling the control of GPS-based shrewd locks, supply chain partners can proactively relieve operational dangers, optimize course arranging, and streamline coordinations operations. This technology-driven approach cultivates believe and responsibility among exchanging accomplices, cultivating a secure and effective environment for the development of merchandise. The discoveries of this consider emphasize the transformative potential of joining GPS-based keen locks as a foundation of modern supply chain administration, advertising a strong system for upgrading perceivability and security within the coordinations industry.

articleTitle: Analyzing Sentiments in Paulo Coelho’s Literary Works Using VADER Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sentiment analysis, a prominent facet of natural language processing (NLP), is instrumental in discerning the emotional undercurrents in text. This study employs the Valence Aware Dictionary and sEntiment Reasoner (VADER) to conduct an in-depth sentiment analysis of select novels by the celebrated Brazilian author, Paulo Coelho. Our research aims to unveil the intricate emotional nuances and narrative depths embedded within Coelho’s literary masterpieces, providing deeper insights into his unique storytelling style and thematic exploration. Through sentiment polarity analysis, we uncover the richness of emotion within Coelho’s works, with a spectrum spanning positive sentiments like hope and inspiration, predominantly found in novels such as “The Alchemist” and “By the River Piedra I Sat Down and Wept.” Simultaneously, we identify negative sentiments, including sadness and conflict, which add complexity to narratives, notably in “Brida” and “The Fifth Mountain”. These emotional facets are complemented by neutral sentiments, ensuring a balanced emotional landscape. Furthermore, our sentiment intensity assessment using VADER reveals varying degrees of emotional depth across Coelho’s novels, with “The Alchemist” and “Brida” standing out as emotionally intense, showcasing the profound nature of character journeys. This research not only illuminates the emotional dimensions of Coelho’s narratives but also demonstrates the utility of sentiment analysis tools like VADER in literary analysis. It bridges a crucial knowledge gap, highlighting the potential for interdisciplinary collaboration between literary scholars and computational linguists. Ultimately, this study enhances our appreciation of Paulo Coelho’s literary artistry, offering nuanced insights into the emotional landscapes of his novels while showcasing their universal resonance across diverse linguistic and cultural contexts.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Computing Resource Allocation with LSTM-Based Predictive Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cloud resource demands have become more complicated as big data and AI have progressed, with characteristics such as being abrupt, arriving in bunches, and diversified. This has led to resource allocation lagging far behind the requests and an uneven resource utilization that wastes resources. Predicting when resources will be needed is done so that apps can get their hands on them right when they're needed, satisfying their dynamic resource requirements. Maintaining uniformity in service provision is challenging because of fluctuating consumer demand. This research presents a proactive approach to cloud computing resource allocation using LSTM to predict resource demands. In particular, this approach suggests an LSTM prediction method that enhances the accuracy of resource request predictions and then constructs a Round Robin resource allocation algorithm that reduces allocation latency and evenly distributes the various types of resources available on a physical machine.

articleTitle: Reliability and QoS Aware Intelligent UAV Communication with Throughput Maximization in Wireless Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To perform effective traditional terrestrial communication among the wireless networks, Unmanned Ariel Networks (UAVs) are created which provides the way to perform next generation communication system. This technology consists of certain special characteristics like high speed communication and unpredictable mobility among the devices. Due to this drawback in certain period reliability issues are occurred that increases the power utilization and delay occurrences among the devices which lead to affect the overall stability. For that purpose in this Reliability and Quality of Service (QoS) Aware Intelligent UAV Communication with Throughput Maximization (RQIUT) is performed among wireless network. The core processes of this model are system model, energy consumption model, QoS requirements and throughput maximization process. Through this processes the communication among the devices are carried out without delay and unwanted power utilization and that leads to improve the performance. The implementation of this model is carried out in NS3 and the parameters which are concentrated in this analysis are energy efficiency and packet delivery ratio. From the research outcome it is proven that RQIUT perform much better when compared with the earlier baseline researches.

articleTitle: A Node MCU Enabled Comprehensive Remote Healthcare Evaluation System for Elder People Care and Support
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has an opportunity to greatly improve our quality of life by providing immediate data that is acquired from an intelligent network of linked devices and then transferred via the internet. In this piece, we have discussed the Remote Medical Diagnosis System and the several life-threatening situations in which it possesses the potential to be a life-saving tool. Sometimes people get sick in areas where there are no hospitals or other medical facilities and they don't make it when they don't get the treatment they need because they can't obtain it. Sometimes they don't make it. This problem is made even more difficult in the rural areas of emerging countries. As part of the presentation, the temperature and heart rate of a person are both read and shown online. Through the use of a web browser, you will have immediate access to all of your medical records. An integrated TCP/IP protocol stack is required in order to send and receive sensor information, such as a patient's heart beat or electrocardiogram (ECG). Using several metrics and Electrocardiogram (ECG) readings, the NodeMCU ESP8266 WiFi module sends patient data to the remote monitoring site. This information may be accessed in real time. The patient's information and settings are stored on a distant Internet of Things server. In this instance, patient data is monitored using a smartphone that is linked to the cloud by a NodeMCU ESP8266. The NodeMCU ESP8266 comes equipped with its own built-in WiFi connectivity. Every user of the system, from doctors and nurses to patients themselves, has easy and rapid access to the system's database, where they may evaluate the findings. The findings of the analysis may be accessed by the patient or the doctor on an Internet of Things website or an Android application, respectively.

articleTitle: Real-time Weapon Surveillance using CV-based Motion Capture and DL-driven Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The rising crime rate during highly populated eventsor also in secluded, areas of concern have made security the top priority in the industry. Abnormality detection and continuous monitoring have become crucial applications for computer vision. As the need for protecting people and their possessions grows, video surveillance systems are increasingly put into place to aid in pattern recognition, event identification, and information gathering. Our proposed system correctly identifies and categorizes various types of firearms by leveraging convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and object identification methods. The model's resilience and flexibility are ensured by the fact that it was trained using a large dataset that included still photos and videos of numerous types of weaponry. In this study, we focus on automating the detection of firearms using VGG16 and Faster RCNN. Image datasets that have been manually labeled are used in the implementation. Despite both algorithms' great accuracy, putting them to use for practical purposes needs a striking balance between swiftness and precision. Public places, transport hubs, and other sensitive areas can benefit greatly from the use of our real-time weapon detection technology. It is a useful resource for pinpointing potential dangers so that people can be protected from them in a timely manner.

articleTitle: IoT-Based Smart Road for Accident Detection and Alert Using Sensor Fusion and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The expanding number of street mischances has ended up a worldwide concern, inciting the improvement of progressed frameworks for opportune location and alarm. This paper presents an imaginative arrangement, an IoT-based Savvy Street framework, outlined to distinguish and expeditiously react to potential mischances. Leveraging sensor combination and machine learning procedures, especially YOLO (You Merely See Once) for question location and One-Class SVM for peculiarity discovery, the proposed framework can precisely distinguish and anticipate unsafe circumstances on the street. The Savvy Street framework coordinates different sensors, counting cameras, LiDAR, and accelerometers, to capture real-time information on street conditions, vehicle developments, and natural parameters. The collected information experiences a combination utilizing progressed calculations, empowering the framework to produce a comprehensive situational mindfulness demonstration. The YOLO calculation contributes to the real-time discovery of vehicles, people on foot, and impediments, guaranteeing effective observation of potential collision dangers. Additionally, the One-Class SVM calculation helps in inconsistency discovery, empowering the framework to recognize irregular designs and behaviors on the street. Through persistent learning, the framework can recognize between ordinary activity exercises and possibly perilous occasions, subsequently activating convenient alarms and preventive measures. Furthermore, the integration of IoT innovation empowers consistent communication between the Savvy Street framework and adjacent vehicles, permitting quick notices and recommendations for remedial activities. The proposed Savvy Street framework illustrates promising capabilities in improving street security and lessening the event of mishaps. By leveraging sensor combination and machine learning strategies, it offers a proactive approach to mishap discovery and caution components, guaranteeing the security of both drivers and people on foot. This arrangement serves as a critical step towards the improvement of brilliant transportation frameworks, cultivating a more secure and more efficient street foundation for the long term.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Breast Cancer Diagnosis using RESNET50
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Breast cancer is a noncutaneous cancer that is diagnosed in more women all over the globe than any other kind of cancer combined. The condition known as breast cancer is one of the utmost widespread and deadly forms of the disease, and it is regarded as the second most prevalent cause of cancer-related deaths in women throughout the globe. On the other hand, early diagnoses and identification may provide a much-improved probability of receiving the appropriate therapy and surviving the disease. The pretrained convolutional neural network is one of the most powerful technologies, and it has shown amazing and superior outcomes. In order to train and categories the BreakHis dataset into benign or malignant categories, the proposed model makes use of the transfer learning approach of the powerful ResNet-50 CNN that has been pretrained on ImageNet. The results of the simulations demonstrated that the suggested model achieves an extraordinary classification accuracy of 99%, beating other models which were trained on the same dataset and compared to it.

articleTitle: Block Chain for Cloud Security: Enhancing Trust and Data Integrity in AI-Based Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The ontology process in research methodology denoted the multiple usage of methodologies in a single study based on various emphases. The concept of multimodal interactions from the perspective of block chain technology in artificial intelligence has successfully secured the security of the cloud infrastructures of various business organizations. With the help of block chain along with the integration of artificial intelligence, large-scale business organizations have integrated server less cloud security. The overall success has provided trustworthiness to business organizations from the core perspectives of the block chain cloud.

articleTitle: Renewable-Based Smart Wireless EV Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A sustainable and dependable infrastructure is becoming more important to accommodate the ever-increasing demand for electric cars (EVs). Renewable-based smart EV charging stations are an innovative solution that not only provides charging services but also leverages renewable energy sources to minimize the environmental impact of transportation. An intelligent electric vehicle charging station that draws power from renewable sources, such as solar panels, is the proposed solution in this project. In order to optimise the charging process and regulate energy consumption, the charging station will use advanced technology like the Internet of Things (IoT). The proposed charging station will have a modular design that can be easily scaled up or down to meet the demand of different locations. The station will also incorporate a monitoring and control system that can provide real-time information on the charging status and energy consumption. Proteus software is used for the simulation of the proposed system. Also, hardware was constructed to verify the results.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Management and Tracking using AI and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Technology has come a long way, and now many problems can be solved with the help of new developments in the field. With this technology, we can finally put an end to the suffocating effects of air pollution. Air pollution is on the rise due to the widespread use of automobiles powered by internal combustion engines. By replacing internal combustion engines with electric motors, we can end our reliance on polluting fossil fuels and ensure future generations have access to clean air. Electric vehicles are similar to machines in that they are powered by a rechargeable battery. To what extent an EV functions depends on its battery. Voltage, current, and temperature are the indicators of battery health. These factors are used to calculate the state of charge (SOC). These results are tracked by a BMS (Battery Management System). This article details how to create an EV monitoring system that makes use of AI and IoT to collect data from the vehicle’s battery and send it to the cloud. Using a cloud-based smartphone app, we can track how well the battery is doing.

articleTitle: Evolutionary Hybrid Algorithms to Pioneer Localization in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research article delves deep into the intricate realm of wireless sensor network (WSN) localization, driven by the critical objective of minimizing localization errors. This pursuit of accuracy prompts the utilization of hybrid algorithms that seamlessly fuse Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) + Firefly Optimization (FF) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) + FF. Drawing inspiration from nature-inspired computing paradigms, these hybrid algorithms represent a novel approach to addressing the localization challenge. By synergizing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Firefly Optimization (FF), this study pioneers a powerful solution that propels advancements in solving the intricate WSN localization problem. The convergence of these two algorithms brings forth substantial enhancements in accuracy, efficiency, and efficacy, reflecting the potential of such hybrid methodologies to revolutionize localization strategies. The research’s contribution lies not only in the successful application of these hybrid algorithms but also in their conceptual innovation, exemplifying the potency of nature-inspired approaches in the realm of computing. In a world increasingly reliant on accurate localization, the outcomes of this study hold implications for a wide array of applications, ranging from surveillance and environmental monitoring to healthcare. Through this exploration of evolutionary hybrid algorithms, this article not only addresses the immediate challenge of WSN localization but also lays the foundation for future advancements in the field.

articleTitle: Enhancing User Experiences: Evaluating Movie Recommendation Algorithms in Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The abundance of content and services in the modern digital environment makes it difficult to give people the best recommendations. To address this, recommendation systems use machine learning and data analysis to generate personalised suggestions that improve user experiences and decision-making. This study looks into recommendation systems, focusing in particular on algorithms for movie recommendations. In order to identify the best user-centric recommendations, it closely examines six noteworthy methods, illuminating their usefulness in sifting through the profusion of options. This investigation helps the study improve recommendation system tactics for providing relevant and interesting content suggestions in a changing digital environment.

articleTitle: Implementation of Leaf Disease Detection Using SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When pest infestations damage plants and crops, it affects the country's agricultural output. In order to detect any signs of disease, farmers or specialists of ten keep a constant eye on the plants. However, this process is typically in efficient, costly, and time-consuming. Quick and accurate results are obtained by automatic detection using image processing techniques. Crops are vulnerable to numerous diseases caused by bacterial, viral, and fungal pathogens along with in sect in festations. Correct control measures cannot be implemented at the right time for a disease without an accurate disease diagnosis. Earlier disease detection serves to prevent damage and lessens the probability of crop loss. When problems are discovered early on, crops can also be treated with a little dosage of pesticide and fungicide application.

articleTitle: Enhancing Dehazing Performance of Single Optical Satellite Images using Gamma Correction and Improved DCP
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Dehazing is an essential preprocessing step for improving the quality of satellite imagery. Hazy conditions can significantly impact the visibility and clarity of satellite images, making it difficult to extract useful information from them. In recent years, several dehazing techniques have been proposed for satellite imagery, including contrast stretching, dark channel prior, and adaptive gamma correction. In this research work, we propose a novel haze removal approach that combines gamma correction with modified dark channel prior-based haze removal approach in the YCbCr color space. Our approach enhances the luminance component of the image by applying gamma correction to the Y channel, and reduces computational complexity by subsampling and combining the chrominance channels. The performance of the proposed system is assessed using peak signal to noise ratio (PSNR) and structural similarity index (SSIM) and compared with the state-of-the-art methods. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed our approach outperforms other methods in terms of dehazing and contrast improvement, suggesting its potential for various applications that require high-quality satellite image processing.

articleTitle: Application of Bayes Rule for Precise Analysis of Class-Imbalanced Stroke Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The interpretability of stroke risk prediction is still lagging and it can be solved by using deep analysisofdata with the application of the Bayes rule. The prediction model has to be produced with accuracy, clarity, and comprehensibility without ambiguity, especially in machine learning and data analytics. The class imbalance problem is a common issue affecting the raw data, which means the imbalanced categorization of outcome feature value. In many fields, such as fraud detection, network intrusion detection, and medical diagnostics, this class imbalance issue is present where negative class samples outnumber positive class samples. If some datasets have class imbalance and imperfect issues, there will be no proper classification pattern. There are many resampling methods to address this class imbalance problem. However, these resampling methods can make an even distribution of classes by generating or omitting some samples, but theycannot handle imperfect data. The probabilistic analysis can lead to the identification of issues that exist in the dataset and provide direction to medical experts on dealing with the condition to avoid panic.The strength of applying the Bayes rule will provide a meaningful interpretation of stroke data. This paper investigates the Baye rule's significance in stroke data analysis.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Cardiovascular Disease Prediction by Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Globally, the prevalence of cardiovascular disease as a cause of death has risen in recent years. Variations in people's lifestyles, dietary preferences, and workplace cultures, among other factors, have affected the severity of this alarming global problem. Establishing a method that can identify early symptoms and save numerous lives is the most effective method for preventing this condition. Machine learning (ML) methods for cardiovascular disease identification and prediction are exceedingly difficult to develop, despite their potential clinical utility. The development of precise and efficient initial-stage cardiac disease prediction using computational assistance of clinical decision-making utilising electronic patient records could address the dearth of cardiac knowledge and the high rate of incorrectly diagnosed cases that plagues nations. This investigation intended to investigate the architecture to predict cardiovascular disease using ML and also on the evaluation matrices for the performance analysis. As a consequence, this study discovered that a relatively simple supervised ML technique can be used to predict cardiovascular disease with high accuracy and considerable potential value.

articleTitle: A comparative performance of LSTM, ANN and ARIMA for prediction of stock price
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: People have studied how to predict stock prices a lot. But there are pros and cons to both artificial neural networks (ANN) and the widely used autoregressive incorporated A rolling average model (ARIMA). Hypothesis-based LSTM networks for long- and short-term memory could be used in many interesting ways in the future. This article goes into great detail about three models, looking at their guiding principles and how well they are thought to work. The manner in which information is processed has a significant impact on it, but most people believe the LSTM model is the most accurate at making long-term forecasts. articleTitle: Semantic Similarity for Text Comparison between Textual Documents or Sentences
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The inclusion of semantic information into any similarity metric boosts its effectiveness and gives findings that are interpretable by humans for further inquiry. A similarity calculation approach only centered on word properties inside the text sometimes provides less precise findings. This document gives three methods that aims to focus on textual terms and incorporate semantic information into their feature vectors, thereby computing semantic similarities. These strategies are founded in both corpus and knowledge-based approaches, namely: cosine similarity using tf-idf vectors, cosine similarity employing word embeddings, and soft cosine similarity utilizing word embeddings. Among these three, cosine similarity utilizing tf-idf vectors is deemed the most proficient in spotting similarities among succinct texts. The texts found by this technology are easily comprehensible and can be easily employed in other applications for important information retrieval.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Qualitative Evaluation of User-Generated Online Gaming Videos

abstract: In recent times, there have been notable advancements in the field of virtual reality (VR) and augmented reality (AR). This is done in order to address the issue. In order to quantify the temporal-related aberrations that the spatial features are unable to predict, we additionally extract the motion features. articleTitle: Elevating Security in Wireless Sensor Networks using ECC and AES Cryptographic Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research article stands as a formidable response to the security vulnerabilities that loom over wireless sensor networks (WSNs). In a pioneering stride, the study introduces an advanced cryptographic framework designed to tackle these vulnerabilities head-on. The heart of this framework lies in the seamless integration of two potent cryptographic forces: Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) and the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). The result is the ECC and AES cryptographic amalgamation, positioned as a robust solution to fortify the security of data transmission within WSNs. Engineered with a keen understanding of the challenges posed by resource-constrained environments - a hallmark of WSNs - the ECC and AES cryptographic system emerges as a beacon of security. This fusion optimizes security protocols while meticulously curtailing memory and energy consumption. The research outcomes hold promise for a transformative impact on WSNs, elevating the data protection landscape to unprecedented heights. articleTitle: Deep Learning Video Streaming Web Application with AI Botsusing NLP

abstract: In this digital age, online learning has become increasingly prevalent, but learners often struggle with asking questions and getting immediate clarification. To address this issue, this research paper proposes a solution in the form of a web application that uses deep learning, AI bots, and NLP to generate keywords and provide real-time responses to user queries during video playback. The title of the paper is "Deep Learning Video Streaming Web Application with AI Bots using NLP". It highlights the application's key features and technologies used, including deep learning, AI bots, and natural language processing (NLP). The problem addressed in this paper is the difficulty learners face when seeking real-time answers to their questions during online video tutorials. The proposed solution aims to address this issue by providing a platform that allows users to add questions and answers to a database, which can then be accessed during video playback. The solution presented in this paper uses a combination of deep learning, AI bots, and NLP to generate relevant keywords and provide real-time responses to user queries. The analysis output shows that the proposed solution can effectively address the issue of real-time question answering during online video tutorials. abstract: The poor performance of public transportation delays is one of the most important problems confronting railway networks globally. articleTitle: AI-Enhanced Multi-Cloud Security Management: Ensuring Robust Cybersecurity in Hybrid Cloud Environments

articleTitle: Vision Based Open Manhole Detection for Viually Impaired Person
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Open manholes pose a significant danger, especially for visually impaired individuals. This can even lead to loss of life in some cases. The proposed model involves preprocessing images of open and closed manholes, including resizing, gray-scale conversion, and edge detection. To enhance feature extraction, the project employs techniques such as Local Binary Pattern (LBP), HU moments, and depth histogram analysis. articleTitle: An Optimistic K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm for Detecting Brain Stroke in Comparison with Logistic Regression Algorithm to Improve the Accuracy

abstract: The proposed system aims to enhance the resultant accuracy measured from stroke prediction obtained from the Novel Optimistic K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithm (NOKNN) and subsequently compare its performance with Logistic Regression (LR). Materials and Methods: In this research, the Novel Optimistic K-Nearest Neighbor and Logistic Regression algorithms were used to identify brain strokes using machine learning. With a group sample size of 20 per algorithm evaluation, the total sample size of 40 is used for comparison. The purpose of comparing these two sets of data is to enhance the research’s overall accuracy. The research’s accuracy was assessed using the ClinCalc tool, which was configured with an alpha value of 0.8, a 0.8 of G-Power value, 0.05 value of significance, and 95% of Confidence Interval (CI). articleTitle: Quantitative Assessment of Magnet Thickness Impact on PMSM Motor Performance for EVs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The primary objective of this project is to optimise the magnetic thickness of the permanent magnet employed in an electric three-wheeler’s Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM). In particular, the goal is to investigate how modifying the thickness of Curved shape Neodymium Ferrite Boron (NdFeB) magnets affects key performance parameters, including torque, efficiency, losses, and flux. The optimization process involves analytical calculations to compare the existing PMSM design with the optimised design. Finite Element Analysis (FEA) simulations are conducted to accurately determine the magnetic flux distribution within the motor and evaluate the desired performance parameters. The results of the analysis will be presented using graphs, charts, and tables, allowing for easy comparison between the two designs. The study’s findings will help identify the optimal magnet thickness for the PMSM rotor, which can provide maximum torque output, increased efficiency, reduced losses, and improved flux distribution. The outcomes of this project have significant relevance to the electric three-wheeler industry. They can offer valuable insights into designing PMSMs that deliver superior performance with improved efficiency and reduced energy consumption. articleTitle: Comparison of elevator drives Regenerative Energy using DC-DC Converter with Battery Energy Storage Systems in High raise buildings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In spite of an enormous rise in global population, buildings with multiple floors have become necessary and mandating the installation of an elevator. The commercial construction industry in India has expanded significantly in recent years. In this study, the actual regenerative energy of geared and gearless elevator drives is examined. Elevator regenerating drives utilize the lift's operating conditions and the difference in weight between the vehicle and counterweights to convert the force of gravity into electrical power. The other supporting elevator devices, such as the emergency rescue device, emergency light and fan (CAR cabin), communication system, and alarm, are then directly powered by the regenerative energy. When the power goes out, an emergency rescue device is employed to run the elevator and the Light & fan are essential for passengers in the cabin, as well as communication and alarm to alert While the power is off, all devices should work in battery mode and the battery should charge while the power is on. The batteries are now being charged by the grid. By using the regenerative braking energy, the excessive wasted power across the dynamic braking resistor is rescued and saved to the battery if more energy will be generated could be resent to the grid using inverter. The key objective of this research is to better understand and predict how much energy may be saved by using both drives in various operations such as an energy recovery function in both regular and dynamic scenarios. The result shown that gearless machine has given 3 times more regenerative energy compared with geared machine. The gearless machines yielding more efficiency, less weight and less maintenance than the geared machine and it is concluded that for "regenerative mode" also gearless has given the better performance than the geared machine. The presented analysis has been experimentally validated, and the results are explained.

articleTitle: Real-Time Employee Monitoring System using CCTV Cameras

abstract: In this approach, we detail an approach to monitoring employees using preexisting setups such as CCTV camera feeds and a network connection. articleTitle: Improving E-commerce Fraud Detection via Machine Learning: Comparative Evaluation of Model Effectiveness
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the fast-growing E-commerce world, fraud has become a major concern, causing economic losses and eroding consumer trust. This work aimed to detect E-commerce fraud using machine learning on a customer dataset. The dataset contained transactional and customer data, requiring preprocessing to handle missing values and categorical features. articleTitle: An Experimental Analysis of Lung Cancer Classification Based on Autoencoder on CT Scan Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When it comes to medical picture recognition, convolutional neural networks are now the gold standard. The mistake in recreating the CT picture is responsible for the low overall accuracy in lung tumor prediction and the lengthy processing time. The use of multispace images in the pooling layer of a convolutional neural network is proposed here in an effort to boost overall prediction accuracy while simultaneously decreasing processing time. Using multispace images in the pooling layer of a convolutional neural network and an Adam Procedure for optimization, the suggested technique is able to detect lung cancer with high precision. The Autoencoder system contributes to this success. The CT images were first fed into a convolution filter and down sampled using max pooling as a first step in the processing pipeline. Autoencoder models based on convolutional neural networks are utilized to extract features, and multispace image reconstruction techniques are employed to minimize reconstruction errors, resulting in greater precision for predicting lung cancer. Python Tensor Flow was used to analyze the state-of-the-art and recommended remedies, and the results show a considerable improvement (from 91 to 87) in accuracy when classifying lung cancer. The suggested approach boasts the lowest error rate alongside the best accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity.The suggested technique reduces processing time while maintaining superior categorization accuracy, as contrasted to the state of the art. Low-pixel images may be analyzed for categorization evaluation now that the huge dataset is operational.

articleTitle: Analysis and Realization of a Manitoba Converter for Portable Medical Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Batteries are used in many types of medical devices from simple assistive aids to mobile X-ray equipment and pacemakers etc., Since batteries allow medical devices to be portable, they are used for powering many personal assisting medical devices, which are worn on the body. Battery power is also well suited for diagnostic devices that are used regularly for short period of time. A low-cost replacement battery is used in most of the medical devices. The user has inconvenience when changing the batteries in a medical gadget. The traditional AC-DC power path layout for medical equipment typically consists of three stages, including a linear regulator, a chopping circuit, and a rectifier. Function of linear regulators is to manage the charging current to minimize voltage ripple after the rectifier stage. High efficiency cannot be easily attained since the linear regulator’s efficiency is strongly dependent on the voltage drop between the source and load. Between the rectifier and the linear regulator, DC-DC buck converters were inserted to increase efficiency. Even while switching converters increase DC-DC conversion efficiency, a rectifier is still required on the power line to change the AC source into a DC source. One additional circuit stage indicates a larger circuit layout and greater power conduction loss when viewed from the perspective of the whole power line. It makes sense that combining a three-stage power conversion with a single-state power conversion would be ideal. In this paper, a conventional battery is replaced by rechargeable battery in medical devices to improve the lifetime of the device. An automatic charger/regulator circuit for the battery is developed employing power electronic converter circuit. Various converter topologies such as conventional buck type rectifier, PWM rectifier, MANITOBA rectifier is studied and analysed in MATLAB. From the computed parameters (THD, voltage Ripple & current Ripple), MANITOBA rectifier proves to be the best suited power converter for portable medical devices. The proposed rectifier is a new bridgeless buck-boost employing an Active Virtual Ground (AVG) technique with a simple structure involving a single-stage conversion. An LC filter at the source side lessens leakage current and differential mode (DM) noise produced by the circuit. The planned 1W topology prototype is successfully executed, and the outcomes are confirmed.

articleTitle: Air Quality Analysis Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: There is now a serious issue with air pollution, which is harmful to both the environment and human health. We have created an air pollution monitoring system utilizing a Nord-MCU with an inbuilt ESP-8266 Wi-Fi module to address this problem. The system consists of inexpensive sensors that gauge the air's concentrations of carbon monoxide (CO), nitrogen dioxide (NO2), and particulate matter (PM2.5 and PM10). A Nord MCU board collects and processes the data and is linked to the sensors. The data is transmitted to a cloud-based platform using the ESP8266 Wi-Fi module so that it may be instantly processed and visualized there. The system has undergone testing in a real-world setting, and the outcomes demonstrate that it is able to deliver precise and trustworthy information on air quality levels. Additionally, the system is expandable, allowing for the installation of more sensors to assess different contaminants. This project then collects these readings from the device and stores them as a dataset for our pollution prediction model. We have used a machine learning module to generate predictions of future air-polluted areas based on the data collected by our device. Overall, this project shows that utilizing a Nord MCU and a built-in ESP8266 Wi-Fi module to monitor air quality is both practical and useful. Real-time air quality monitoring is crucial for mitigating the harmful consequences of air pollution on human health and the ecosystem. The system provides a scalable, affordable solution for this task. On the other hand, the machine learning model utilizes the data collected and helps us predict the potential air quality in the region to determine the pollution hotspots.

articleTitle: Helmet Detection System through CCTV Using Yolo and Autonomous Ticket Generation: A Smart Solution for Enhanced Road Safety and Enforcement

abstract: Street security remains a basic concern all inclusive, with a noteworthy parcel of street mischances ascribed to non-compliance with security controls, especially the disappointment to wear protective caps whereas riding two-wheelers. articleTitle: An Optimized Ensemble Machine Learning Framework for Water Quality Assessment System by Leveraging Forward Sequential Minimum Redundancy Maximum Relevance Feature Selection Method

abstract: The assessment of water quality is a paramount significance in safeguarding public health and preserving aquatic ecosystems. This research presents an innovative approach, combining ensemble machine learning and a forward sequential minimum redundancy maximum relevance technique, to classify the water based its quality features. The proposed approachique is employed in order to discern the best informative and relevant attributes from a comprehensive set of water quality parameters. By reducing dimensionality, this technique optimizes computational efficiency and minimizes the risk of Machine Learning (ML) models’ over fitting. articleTitle: Enhanced Wireless Sensor Network Localization using Modified Firefly Optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research study delves into the realm of wireless sensor networks (WSNs), focusing on the enhancement of localization accuracy. Through an extensive simulated analysis encompassing diverse parameters, the research brings to light FF's inherent potential in mitigating the challenges posed by localization errors. The research article sheds light on FF's capabilities as a standalone solution for bolstering the accuracy of WSN localization. articleTitle: Efficient Fault Detection in Renewable Energy Systems through IoT and Isolation Forest Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As renewable energy sources are becoming more integrated into the power grid, ensuring system reliability is crucial. A unique defect detection method for renewable energy systems leveraging the Internet of Things (IoT) and the Isolation Forest algorithm is presented in this research. The integration of IoT devices provides real-time monitoring and data collection from solar panels, wind turbines, and energy storage units. The machine learning Isolation Forest method effectively finds data abnormalities and defects. The Isolation Forest algorithm can correctly detect problems and abnormalities in renewable energy systems, enabling early maintenance and repair. This proactive defect detection technology improves renewable energy’s reliability and efficiency, minimizing downtime and power grid stability. IoT technology and the Isolation Forest algorithm improve problem detection and system performance and creating a more sustainable and cost-effective energy-producing infrastructure. It shows that advanced data analytics and machine learning may make renewable energy systems more reliable and appealing as clean energy sources.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Loads of Residential Buildings by Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Because of its substantial technological and practical significance, energy consumption prediction in residential buildings is a critical component in electrical energy networks. It is a complicated process to forecast due to several variables, including resident behavior, household dimension, loads existing in residence, and numerous additional things. Machine Learning (ML) approaches can help to bridge this barrier by utilizing historical information that is already available to forecast new instances and produce wise conclusions. Thus, this work emphasizes investigating the applications of ML techniques to forecast the load of residential buildings precisely.

articleTitle: Efficient UAV Path Planning and Energy Optimization with Cooperative System Model for Vehicular Adhoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks (VANETs) is a highly trending technology which occupies lots of applications of intelligent communications in day to day life. Typically, vehicles in a vehicular network move at rapid speeds with unpredictable mobility, leading to frequent changes in the network’s structure. Consequently, this might cause some problems while transmitting data between vehicles. In addition, external activities might lead to data loss. In order to overcome certain drawbacks in recent times ground level to air level data connectivity is concentrated which includes the concept of Unmanned Aerial Networks (UAV). The primary obstacles in the construction of UAV is that its network formation and path finding process. For the purpose of overcoming these kinds of drawbacks in this article effective UAV path planning and the energy optimization (EUPEO) is concentrated in the vehicular communication. Through this process the communication is carried out in an effective manner with intelligent path planning of UAV and as well it reduces the delay and energy consumption. The idea is implemented in ns3 and from the final outcome it is obviously proven that the EUPEO method achieved superior results than previous methods concerned with efficiency and as well the delivery rate of the information transmitted.

Author Keywords: Effective UAV Path Planning and Energy Optimization

articleTitle: Nature-Inspired Algorithms to perform Localization and Security in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research article embarks on a dual-pronged journey, ardently addressing the challenges of both localization enhancement and security fortification in the context of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). The study introduces a holistic approach, employing nature-inspired computing algorithms - namely Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Firefly Optimization (FF) - to diligently tackle the intricate issue of localization errors. To amplify the potency of these algorithms, hybrid variations are ingeniously crafted, ushering in heightened effectiveness. Furthermore, the research article undertakes a visionary stride by unveiling a hybridized system that harmoniously merges two stalwart cryptographic forces - Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) and the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES). This fortified system stands poised to bolster data security within WSNs, aligning seamlessly with the overarching goals of the research. Through meticulous simulated analyses, the article meticulously unveils the tangible outcomes of these dual approaches. The research validates the efficacy of these innovative methods in real-world scenarios, painting a vivid picture of their collective impact. The findings resoundingly underscore the potential of these approaches to revolutionize the realms of accuracy, efficiency, and security across an array of WSN applications. As the modern landscape continues to demand both enhanced precision and robust security measures, this research article emerges as a beacon of innovation. By synergizing localization enhancements and security fortifications through nature-inspired algorithms and hybrid cryptographic methodologies, the study unfolds a comprehensive strategy that holds profound implications for the trajectory of WSNs.

articleTitle: A Systematic Procedure to Identify Human Blood Groups by using Image Processing Assisted Learning Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the occurrence of a life-threatening situation needing the transfer of blood, it is crucial to first determine the patient's blood type. Currently, technicians execute these checks manually, which might introduce room for error. Rapid and accurate blood type determination, free of human error, is crucial. If we use AI methods like artificial intelligence and deep learning to determine a person's blood type, we can minimize the little margin of error introduced by human calculations and outcomes. As the field of computer vision continues to advance at a rapid pace, we are able to provide the highest quality service to our clients. Schematic Learning based Human Blood Group Analyzer (SLHBGA) is a unique deep learning based image processing technology created to determine the human blood types. Methods from the field of image processing, such as filtering and structural processes, are employed. The blood group may be determined rapidly and precisely with this method. The proposed approach of SLHBGA provides better efficiency in results, which will be shown clearly with proper comparisons of conventional learning assisted model called Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) Model. The following resultssection then offers the necessary evidence to demonstrate the effectiveness of the suggested method in terms of following metrics such as: blood group identification accuracy, blood group classification timeline, reduced loss-ratio, sensitivity and specificity.

articleTitle: Enhancing Personality Type Prediction with Ensemble Models: A Robust Predictive Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research proposes an inventive methodology for deducing individuals’ personality types by amalgamating information from diverse social media platforms with scores from the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI). This involves creating a unique dataset from text data gathered from various social media sources, utilizing Advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) to classify participants into 16 MBTI personality categories. The primary objective is establishing a robust data preparation process, ensuring data accuracy, and developing and rigorously evaluating a prediction model using machine learning techniques like logistic regression, support vector machines, and neural networks. Accuracy is used as the performance evaluation metric compared with other machine learning algorithms. The study’s impact is significant, extending beyond personality inference to offer insights into understanding individuals’ online behaviour and personalities. This has implications for user experience research, social media marketing, and mental health studies, benefiting from the insights and methodologies generated. By leveraging social media data and machine learning, this research represents a pioneering approach to personality analysis, unlocking novel avenues for comprehending human behaviour and cognition.

articleTitle: Optimizing Machine Learning Model Accuracy via OBNT Algorithm: Advanced Data Preprocessing Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Machine learning has emerged as a focal point in the current landscape of data analytics. It involves the utilization of diverse ML algorithms to analyze data and extract valuable insights. These insights serve multiple industries, such as retail, petroleum, stock markets, and various organizations, resulting in increased sales, productivity, and profitability. Building an effective ML model to analyze and predict future data patterns is contingent upon high accuracy, which is directly dependent on the quality of the underlying data. Techniques like data preprocessing and feature selection play crucial roles in ensuring data quality. In this research, a methodology is proposed to meticulously select the most optimal data from raw datasets to construct an ML training model, thereby bolstering the accuracy percentage. The study involves comparing the accuracy of models built without employing the proposed technique against those utilizing it, alongside a comparative analysis of machine learning algorithm accuracy post-application of the proposed technique in contrast to existing preprocessing methodologies. The findings unequivocally demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed OBNT Algorithm in enhancing the accuracy of ML training models. The results indicated a statistically significant difference between the two groups, with a P value of 0.003 (p < 0.05).

articleTitle: Hybrid K-Means Clustering for Grouping the Special Children Using Computational Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Computers have become an integral part of human existence, and there is an enormous amount of data available all around the world that may be utilised to extract useful and relevant information. It benefits the company in a variety of ways, including decision assistance and decision making. As a result, an effective data mining methodology is becoming increasingly important for all businesses. The current research work is about data analysis and outcomes interpretation. Data analysis has been attempted in accordance with the study’s aims. Data from the special children dataset was categorized, tabulated, and evaluated. The t-test was used to determine the significance of the difference between the means of two independent groups, as well as product moment correlation between variables. A research on the efficacy of counselling and motivation for partly special children’ socio-personal adjustment and degree of accomplishment motivation might be undertaken. The impact of a life skills training programme on partly those children socio-personal adjustment and success motivation. The impact of an ICT-based language curriculum on linguistic efficiency and personal growth.

articleTitle: Landslip Trigger Classification of Global Landslide Catalog Dataset Using Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A severe natural calamity that results in loss of life and property is a landslip. As a result of rising urbanization, destruction of forests, and global warming, it is expected to happen more often than previously. Mapping the likelihood of landslides is essential for protecting people and property. Many research papers been conducted in the past to approximate the likelihood of landslides occurring based on terrain slope and soil type and even more recent studies have used machine learning techniques to predict sensitivity to landslides. The prediction of landslip triggers hasn't yet been studied, though. By identifying the main sources of landslides in various parts of the world, our research aims to advance the current body of knowledge. By identifying the main causes of landslides in different regions of the world, our research aims to advance the current body of knowledge. This paper summarizes five implementation techniques of machine learning: K-nearest neighbor, Support Vector Machine random forest, and Xgboost using a dataset of landslip incidents and their related triggers. The efficiency of all well-known ML classifiers was demonstrated. Ensemble tree techniques (i.e., Xgboost) have been found to have demonstrated to have been most successful in terms of overall performance.

articleTitle: Evaluation of charging power levels in different Hybrid Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Electric Vehicles (EVs) are becoming a promising way to improve the quality of the air, security of power, and commercial chance as the EV market is growing rapidly. To speed up the use of EVs and make transportation more sustainable, barriers need to be removed. The main ones are the high cost of EVs, concerns about range and scarcity of EV charging facilities. The majority of the EVs existing in the supply market are both HEVs and PHEVs. The effectiveness of a battery charger depends on how well it meets the following criteria: high power density, low cost, small size, and long life. A thorough state-of-art of the current state of electric vehicles, including their energy storage systems, charging methods, power levels and feasibility is presented along with the comparative evaluation of characteristics of different EVs and PHEVs based on their charging power levels.

articleTitle: Noise Identification in Urban Cities Using Performance of Random Forest, KNN, and SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The definition of noise is any unwanted disturbance. The impact of urban noise on residents is a naturally significant issue, and in some regions, the rising noise level is regarded as a serious concern. Nevertheless, noise pollution can be reduced through improved urban planning and government regulations. However, the implementation of this form of intervention requires the use of an established noise surveillance infrastructure. This study investigates machine learning (ML) models for urban noise recognition.

articleTitle: A Robust Method for Driver Drowsiness Detection and Analysis using Pertinent Elements
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Effective sleepiness detection techniques are required in the current situations to improve road safety due to the rising frequency of traffic incidents linked to driver fatigue. In the current world of traffic where people use their own vehicle for travelling long distances, almost 30% of the driver sleepiness causes accidents, and each year about 1 lakh similar incidents are happening. In order to overcome this problem, we can use technology that constantly keeps track of the driver and alerts him periodically whenever the driver feels drowsy or is inattentive while driving. This project can be implemented in two ways, one is using IOT approach, where sensors come into play, and the second approach is Machine Learning model. We have implemented the machine learning model of the project where we have used SVM classifier model to detect face and imutils library for facial landmark detection (eyes and mouth). Then we have developed an algorithm that calculates the Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR) and Mouth Aspect Ratio (MAR). When the driver’s eyes are being closed (EAR<0.25) for a long interval of time (>5secs) or driver yawning (MAR>0.75), then we will be generating strong beeps that alerts the driver.

articleTitle: Auto ML and Neural Architecture Search for Deep Learning Model Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study digs into the ever-changing environment of Neural Architecture Search (NAS) and Atom (Automated Machine Learning) for the purpose of deep learning model optimization. We take a methodical look at these methods to see whether they can really bring about a sea change in the way AI is created and used. Our studies are based on a comprehensive process that covers issue statements, data cleaning, Atom and NAS algorithm selection, optimization goals, model training, and ethical concerns. We offer simulated experimental findings that demonstrate the effectiveness of these techniques, focusing on the dramatic improvements to model performance and the time savings from automation. Importantly, our research highlights the need for justice, accountability, and openness in the context of automated model optimization. Our results have important implications for the field of artificial intelligence and for society at general, which we explain as part of our conclusion. We conclude by outlining potential avenues for further study, such as the use of transfer learning, scalability, hybrid techniques, and self-adaptive algorithms. A thorough introduction to Atom and NAS, this study provides valuable ideas that may promote growth, accessibility, and ethical responsibility in AI.
