articleTitle: Exploring Motivations for Learning Computer Networks with Hands-on Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In general, subjects like computer networks, network security, and ethical hacking become difficult to learn (teach) and practice, for both professors and students. This article walks through eight different practical tasks that illustrate the principles underlying computer networking protocols. This study considers of twelve exercises using various tools. Examples of NSlookup theory, DNS concepts, packet delivery mechanisms, public/private addressing, and the unsecured portals are the first six exercises which are considered here. The remaining exercises such as the role of Web servers, packet capture analysis using Wireshark, password recovery using Burp Suite, and penetration testing using Kali-linux are explored in this study. The prevalent consensus is that the beginners find it extremely difficult to grasp computer networking protocols and network security concepts. The main goal of this publication is to investigate practical activities that will help readers understand the principles of computer networking. This kind of research encourages self-learning, which allows the research community, teachers, and students to focus more on practice.

articleTitle: Data analysis using neural networks and Kohonen maps in a comparative perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper discusses two powerful methods of data analysis, neural networks and self-organising Kohonen maps. The main emphasis is on the importance of correct data preparation before analysis. Their impact on the accuracy and quality of research results is analysed. The paper provides deep insight into the effective application of these techniques in various data analysis scenarios.

articleTitle: Effective data security for Vehicular Adhoc Network using a Novel ECC-based Authentication and Key Exchange
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Now a days the number of smart devices usages around the World is greatly increased which practice more improvement in the area of intelligent transmission system (ITS) for the purpose of sensing analysis and effective communication technology for safety and mobility with proper traffic monitoring in the transportation sector. In order to provide effective intelligent communication proper traffic congestion monitoring with efficiency is required. For that purpose vehicular ad hoc networks are developed to attend flexibility in communication with proper traffic management using this cells organized vehicles. Due to the usage of huge number of vehicles in the particular area and with the presence of several external environments providing security and privacy for that transmitted data becomes highly essential so that the confidential of the data can be secured at the time when the data is travelling in an air medium. For that purpose in this article, effective data security for VANETs using the novel ECC based authentication with data exchange (EDVEA) is developed. The core processes of this model are ECC authentication process, intelligent system model and ECC authentication with key exchange process. This approach enhances the privacy and security of the network by using a mutual authentication model, hence improving the overall performance of the vehicle network. The EDVEA is implemented using the ns2 simulation platform, with the analysis focusing on calculating the end-to-end delay and routing overhead parameters. The results demonstrate that the performance of the EDVEA outperforms the previous baseline studies.

Author Keywords: Intelligent System Model and Key Exchange Process)

articleTitle: Improving IoT Security with AI-Powered Anomaly Detection and Intrusion Prevention
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Internet of Things(IoT) technologies are already a standard piece of technology in many sectors of business and government. Unfortunately, security attacks that target information integrity and service availability are proven to be quite effective against IoT devices and networks. In addition, contrasted to conventional Information Technology (IT) networks, the heterogeneity of the data gathered from diverse IoT gadgets, along with the disruptions experienced inside the IoT system, make it more difficult to spot aberrant behavior and compromised nodes. To ensure that fraudulent information won't be utilized in IoT-driven decision-support tools, there is an urgent requirement for robust and trustworthy anomaly detection. In this article, we suggest a Conjugate gradient-based improved GAN (CG-IGAN) anomaly detection system for IoT that can learn and collect reliable and practical features that are not severely impacted by unstable situations. The botnet dataset is collected and then it is extracted using Independent Component Analysis (ICA). The classifier then makes use of these traits to improve the precision with which it can identify malicious IoT data. The suggested CG-IGAN design is beneficial in terms of improving the accuracy of identifying malicious data when contrasted to the most advanced IoT-based anomaly detection methods, according to research findings based on real-world IoT datasets.

articleTitle: Versatile Solar Pump Controller for Various Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The agriculture industry is in a constant state of transformation, with ongoing upgrades in farming equipment, agricultural infrastructure, and production facilities. Solar panels offer versatile solutions with myriad applications in farming. However, the substantial investment made by both farmers and governments in Solar PV pumping systems is underutilized, as these systems operate for just 150 days annually, essentially half the year. To maximize the potential of solar photovoltaic systems, which generate electricity year-round during sunny hours, it is crucial for the controllers installed in these solar pumping systems to serve multiple purposes, catering to a variety of agricultural and other farmer needs. This single solar-powered product has the capability to operate a wide range of applications, including water pumping, a mobile application, soil conditioning sensors, an ultrasonic sensor, a Bluetooth module, a battery, and an Arduino Uno board.Such diversification has the potential to significantly boost agricultural productivity and, in turn, increase farmer incomes.The primary aim of this study is to create remotely accessible, multi-mode, cost-effective, simple, highly reliable, and environmentally friendly solar water pumping systems that offer financial benefits to Indian farmers year-round. Solar water pumps have the potential to greatly benefit Indian farmers by providing both a consistent water supply and an additional source of income.

articleTitle: A Cutting-Edge AI-and-IoT-Powered Cyber Secured Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Recent times have witnessed amazing progress in the utilization of the Internet of Things (IoT), and along with it has come an increase in the number of cybersecurity stressors. Artificial intelligence, sometimes known as simulated intelligence, is at the forefront of cybersecurity. It is used to conduct complex calculations in order to safeguard businesses and systems, including Internet of Things (IoT) devices. In spite of this, computer programmers have figured out a method to exploit simulated intelligence to their advantage, and they have even started employing hostile computer-based intelligence in their cyberattacks. This is a significant development in the field of cybersecurity. This audit article collects material from a variety of different overviews and examination distributions on the internet of things (IoT), man-made intelligence, and attacks with and against computer-based intelligence. The goal of this page is to introduce and summarize the essential writing that has been done in these topics. In a similar vein, it investigates the link that exists between these three regions. In light of these computer-based intelligence processes, we provide a comprehensive analysis of "Computer-based intelligence driven cybersecurity" in this article. This study may be useful for smart cybersecurity administrations and the executives who oversee them. Because of the security intelligence exhibiting made possible by computer-based intelligence ways, the cybersecurity registering cycle has the potential to become more automated and savvy than traditional security frameworks. This is due to the fact that such methods are computer-based. In addition, we give a number of potential avenues for further research that are included within the scope of our investigation.

articleTitle: Heuristic Based Optimized Classifier for HAR
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition plays a pivotal role in various domains, from healthcare to wearable technology. This Paper presents a novel approach that combines heuristic-based feature selection with Particle Swarm Optimization to optimize the performance of HAR classifiers. We begin by employing heuristics to intelligently select relevant features from raw sensor data, reducing dimensionality and enhancing classification efficiency. Subsequently, PSO is applied to fine-tune classifier hyperparameters, achieving superior model accuracy and robustness. Our approach initiates by harnessing heuristics to autonomously discern and select pertinent features from raw sensor data. This intelligent feature selection not only trims the data dimensionality but also elevates the overall efficiency of the classification process. Subsequently, we apply PSO, a nature-inspired optimization algorithm, to meticulously fine-tune classifier hyperparameters.

articleTitle: Machine Learning with Deep Learning Approach for Cyber Security Threats Prevention Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The need for effective cybersecurity solutions has never been greater than in today's world of constant digitalization and interconnection. This study explores the use of deep learning to the creation of a model for preventing cyber security threats using machine learning. The model is meant to successfully identify and prevent cyber-attacks by analysing network traffic and system behaviour using a convolutional neural network (CNN) linked with variationalautoencoders (VAEs). This study's findings illustrate the model's competency in threat recognition with a high degree of accuracy, precision, and recall. Actively monitoring and evaluating network data, providing automatic threat identification and response, further demonstrates its usefulness when used in the real world. This work sets the path for future developments in quantum-resistant encryption, adversarial machine learning studies, deep learning architectures, autonomous cybersecurity systems, explainable AI, and global threat intelligence cooperation. These new approaches have great potential for paving the way towards a more secure and resilient cyber future.

articleTitle: Data Prediction & Comparative Error Analysis of Compressible Fluid Flow using Neuro-Fuzzy Modelling
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Nitrogen gas under pressure released from storage is expected to flow at a set pressure at the downstream end of the control valve. The dynamic changes in pressure and temperature are measured and the Proportional- Integral-Derivative (PID) error-based prediction model gives feedback signal to the control valve to attain accurate downstream pressure. It was observed that the error percentage in a PID controller is very much higher and hence the system never reaches the target pressure. As it is a highly dynamic system having few seconds as the processing time, less error percentage is desired to attain the set point in a short period of time. Statistical model of the real time data was done through regression and compared with the ANFIS modeling results. It could be found that the machine learning process with ANFIS modeling resulted in very less error when compared with the existing PID controller and the traditional statistical modeling.

articleTitle: Automation of Enforcer Agent Installation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As a part of an organizational initiative to move towards a zero-trust model, The proposed study analyses a number of solutions for hosts that are physical or in legacy models to be compatible with the micro-segmentation of endpoint hosts. One of the solutions, that would be considered for testing would be to install the enforcer agents and build over a Palo Alto network solution for physical/virtual servers. Installing the agents on the endpoint hosts for the Linux (RHEL kernel), Red Hat/CentOS and Windows hosts are a bit cumbersome and the success rate is very low. It is not feasible to install it on multiple hosts at the same time. Hence an automated agent installation is used to fix the aforementioned vulnerability. The aim of the work is expected to develop a single-click automation interface that facilitates concurrent agent installation on many hosts. After installation, the resource utilization of the legacy and micro-segmentation agents with their respective policies are compared. The installation success rate was 90–95% based on testing, and resource utilization was adequate.

articleTitle: An Efficient Technique for Cloud Resource Management Using Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Resource management is a vital process in the cloud for satisfying the customer requirement. Resources get the task from the user and perform necessary action. The task needs the data which are collected from various environments. The existing systems are not concentrating on the data but it maps the request to the resources. Resource level management provides the service response to the user. It suffers the data related issues, so it is solved by incorporate the efficient machine learning over the cloud. The proposed model classifies the dataset based on the workload condition namely GPU and CPU level. The model also developed related to the workload. The resources from the cloud are provisioning and allocate to the specific region with necessary parameters. Dynamic load assignment helps to the user for keeping the cost in their acceptable level. Various machine and deep learning models have been analysed related to workload parameters. It achieves high efficient resource monitoring in order to handle faulty resource and make then to active level.

articleTitle: Automating Threat Advisory Report Generation Using Threat Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)

authors.preferredName: Arachchi T A D L P T
authors.lastName: T A D L P T

abstract: A security operations center (SOC) is a necessary component of any organization. SOC analysts are the first to encounter threats to an organization. SOC environments are responsible for security incidents and event management (SIEM); therefore, SOC teams are tasked with monitoring incidents, threat hunting, and incident response for networks and systems. Threat advisory reports are manually written by SOC analysts using the threat intelligence gathered from various threat databases and RSS feeds. This process takes time because reports must be tailored to the organization’s specific requirements, and many organizations hire other organizations that provide SOC operations as a service. Therefore, for this report, the generation process takes more time. In the current world, every second matters regarding information security because an incident can escalate too quickly.This research aims to develop a solution that can generate threat advisory reports automatically in a productive, timesaving, cost-efficient, and accurate manner. Researchers are proposing to implement a dashboard system where the organization can specify its requirements, and based on those requirements, the solution will generate tailor-made threat advisory reports for the organization. This solution will allow the SOC teams to analyze and respond to threats rather than spend time hunting for them.

articleTitle: A Logical Design of Robust Methodology to Detect and Classify Melanoma Disease using Hybrid Deep Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Recent research has determined that the form of skin cancer known as melanoma is the deadliest. When detected early and treated surgically, patients have a far better chance of surviving. Melanomas have been classified using a number of different methodologies, but none of them have been able to generate an answer that is considered to be adequate. Because of this, there is a huge need for computerized techniques of diagnosis that may be applied to dermoscopy images. The provision of a completely automated system for improved melanoma classification is the fundamental objective of this research project. To this purpose, we have created a unique deep learning principle that we call the Hybrid Learning based Melanoma Classifier (HLMC). This innovative deep learning principle takes its cues from a more conventional kind of deep learning known as the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Our goal is to solve the challenge of melanoma classification. When it comes to classification, the use of segmented images allows us to achieve an accuracy of 97.34%, sensitivity of 94.31% and a specificity of 95.17%. A classification approach that is based on deep learning and image segmentation produces more accurate findings and increases diagnostic precision when these parameters are used. In their day-to-day clinical practice, medical professionals are going to consider the proposed technique to be an extremely helpful resource. For all the proposed melanoma detection scheme HLMC provides an efficient predictions to analyze the disease in proper way, in which the resulting section shows the proper proof to it through the respective outcomes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Wireless Sensor Network Localization using Hybrid PSO and FF Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this research article, the objective revolves around the refinement of precision in wireless sensor network (WSN) localization. A pivotal challenge in this domain pertains to the mitigation of localization errors. To tackle this predicament, the study harnesses the capabilities of nature-inspired algorithms, specifically Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Firefly Optimization (FF). Recognizing the inherent potency of these algorithms, the research ingeniously fuses their attributes to create hybrid iterations, denoted as PSO + FF and GA + FF. These hybrid versions are meticulously designed to harness the collective strengths of both PSO and FF, thereby augmenting their efficacy. Through an exhaustive regime of simulated analyses, this article meticulously examines the performance of these hybrid algorithms. The outcomes of the study resoundingly affirm the dominance of the hybrid approaches, as they exhibit heightened efficiency and accuracy when tasked with solving the intricate localization conundrums within WSNs. The research serves as a significant stride in the evolution of localization techniques, emphasizing precision and proficiency as paramount attributes. The implications of these findings are extensive, encompassing a diverse spectrum of applications within the realm of WSNs. These range from environmental monitoring and surveillance to healthcare and beyond. By addressing the formidable challenge of localization errors through the innovative amalgamation of PSO and FF, this research offers a substantial contribution to the practical enhancement of WSNs. Through the strategic utilization of these hybrid algorithms, the study bridges the gap between theoretical prowess and real-world application, unlocking new possibilities in the landscape of WSN technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Modified Buck Boost Converter fed DC Motor drive
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Power Electronic Converters have plenty of applications after the invention of Switched Mode Power Supplies. The Prominent Converters are Buck Converter, Boost Converter and Buck-Boost Converter. The Buck Boost Converter includes the advantages of Buck and the Boost Converter individually. This Paper Proposes a Single-Phase AC-AC buck boost Converter with Multiplier Stage to improve low input Voltage to a Higher Output Voltage. The Modified Buck-Boost Converter is simulated both in open loop and Closed loop System. The time domain Specifications are measured with PI Controller and Fuzzy Logic Controllers. The Steady state Error drastically decreases when the Converter is simulated with a Fuzzy Logic Controller. The Software analysis is done using MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Realization of Boost Zeta Converter for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: For PV applications, the realization of non-isolated boost zeta converter is presented in this paper. The aim is to attain high voltage gain with ensured very low output ripple. The Double Zeta Quadratic Converter (DZQC) is used to achieve this. The converter is simulated using MatLab/Simulink with photovoltaic (PV) interface. The output waveforms of the converter ensure the low ripple content and high gain voltage. The experimental results of the DZQC are in good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Enhancing Land Cover Classification with Object-Based Contextual and Time Series Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this research, Object-Based Image Classification (OBIC) applied to satellite imagery is explored, particularly in the context of land cover classification. While Deep Learning and Object-Based Convolutional Neural Networks (OB-CNN) have enhanced accuracy, they require substantial computing resources and may have limitations in capturing object relationships. To address this, a novel OBIC framework that harnesses Graph Convolutional Networks (GCN) to construct a graph structure from objects, allowing for the consideration of object relationships is introduced. The study introduces the Contextual Object-Based GCN (OB-GCN). The research also emphasizes the significance of analyzing multitemporal imagery for accurate land object classification, introducing a Time Series Object-Based CNN (OB-CNN) that interprets time series data. By implementing the Contextual OB-GCN and Time Series OB-CNN models, overall accuracies of 83.1% and 78.8% are achieved, respectively. The study compares the performance of Contextual OB-GCN with Time Series OB-CNN to determine their effectiveness in classifying land objects.

articleTitle: Development and Evaluation of a Speech-Recognized Voice Bot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In recent years, there have been significant advancements in speech recognition technology, which have opened up new possibilities for voice-controlled applications and devices. This report presents the design, development, and evaluation of a Speech-Recognized Voice Bot (SRVB) that aims to enhance user interactions with technology through natural language processing. The SRVB utilizes cutting-edge speech recognition algorithms and machine learning techniques to convert spoken language into actionable commands. The methodology involves training a deep learning model on a large dataset of speech samples and conducting user experiments to assess its performance. The results indicate that the SRVB demonstrates promising accuracy and usability, making it a valuable tool for a wide range of applications.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Vehicle Accident using GoogleNet Classifier Compared with ResNet-50
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research aims to make real-time predictions about road traffic accidents using two distinct machine learning (ML) techniques and to compare the performance of selected classifiers. The study suggests utilizing neural networks, specifically the GoogleNet and ResNet-50 classifiers, to achieve this goal.GoogleNet algorithm is used in comparison with ResNet-50 with different 80% of training and 20% of testing data in order to predict vehicle accidents. The average G-power over the course of the tests is approximately 95%. The dataset for the present work contains 12,300 unique values with group 1=9840 and group 2=2460 related to the light condition, weather conditions, types of collisions and the factors considered are reviews. On performing statistical analysis (SPSS) on group 1 and group 2 and achieved mean accuracy of 94.3110% and 87.33% respectively. It expresses that there is a statistical significance variance between the Novel GoogleNet progression and the ResNet-50 algorithm with p = 0.001 (p<0.05). According to the testing outcomes, the proposed approach is believed to be the best technique for identifying accidents that happen on the road as a result of vehicle collisions. The investigation’s efficacy is evidenced by the higher level of accuracy demonstrated by the proposed Novel GoogleNet classifier when compared to both the ResNet-50 classifier and traditional classifiers typically employed in accident prediction.

articleTitle: Exploring the Impact of Herbal Remedies on Autism Spectrum Disorder Using AGLSTM Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Autism is a personality disorder that can cause significant emotional, intellectual, and behavioral deficits. Autism is recognized as an illness on the spectrum because, while certain kids might have mild symptoms, others may have extensive life-challenging abnormalities. However, autistic people have unique characteristics and health goals and may react differently to conventional or herbal therapy than others. Herbal medications might be a possible approach to helping autistic people's bodies and brains. However, further research is needed to determine whether herbal therapy is useful for autistic individuals. To gain insight into how people think regarding herbal medication for autism, data must be processed promptly as it is generated, which may be accomplished using sentiment assessment, which analyzes polarization in writings. This paper proposes the AGLSTM Model, a hybrid model that solves the sentiment evaluation issue by combining LSTM with agglomerative clustering. The suggested system signifies text data into numerical vectors that illustrate text features such as the frequency of words and embeddings of phrases using the TF-IDF technique and the word2vec model. Every word becomes assigned to a cluster using a method known as clustering based on how similar it is to the cluster nucleus or other texts in the region. The outcome of the experiment is a set of clusters composed of sentences with comparable emotional content. The LSTM framework can detect long-term correlations between word patterns and classify feedback as positive or negative.

articleTitle: Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence Algorithms that Minimize Power Consumption in Internet of Things Gadgets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The exponential growth of IoT gadgets has enabled previously unimaginable levels of connectedness and convenience, but it has also introduced a significant new difficulty: battery life. In this study, we investigate how artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning may be used to cut down on power usage in Internet of Things (IoT) devices. With an emphasis on data-driven insights and fictitious data situations, we provide a systematic technique for data collecting, algorithm creation, and rigorous testing. Our results show that by combining Q-learning with supervised learning and statistical analysis, considerable gains in energy efficiency may be achieved. There is strong statistical evidence that data transmission operations may reduce their energy footprint by 25%. In addition to the technical details, we explore the practical ramifications of our study, such as increased battery life, reduced environmental impact, and reduced expenses. Insights into the revolutionary potential of machine learning and AI in transforming the IoT landscape towards a more sustainable and user-centric future are provided in this research paper, which may be used as a practical guide by industry experts, academics, and policymakers. We also provide an overview of promising future avenues for improving IoT power management and scalability, such as the use of sophisticated reinforcement learning models, the incorporation of energy harvesting, and real-time adaption.

articleTitle: Vision GNN Based Phishing Website Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Phishing, which is a common cyber threat, exploits human vulnerabilities by impersonating legitimate entities to deceive users into sharing sensitive information. Traditional methods of detecting phishing websites primarily rely on textual features and heuristics, often failing to capture the evolving sophistication of phishing tactics. This study introduces an innovative approach for identifying phishing websites through an image of the website utilizing VisionGNN architecture which is a Graph Neural Networks (GNN) based approach. By using the VisualPhish dataset, consisting 1195 pages across 155 websites, our approach focuses on significantly enhancing accuracy in phishing website detection using RGB images of the websites. Through training with image augmentations and the application of optimization techniques such as AdamW and cosine decay for learning rate adaptation, a good result in predictive capabilities are attained. The outcomes demonstrate the model’s efficacy in accurately classifying both benign and phishing websites. Impressively, our VIsionGNN-based approach with its pyramidsmall model architecture out of its four combinations achieves 97% accuracy on the VisualPhish data set. With our approach being the first time VisionGNN architecture has been utilized in phishing website detection, our study spotlights the potential of pioneering Graph Neural Network-based approaches in strengthening cyber security against the escalating threat of phishing websites. Furthermore, this study lays the groundwork for future research areas aimed at utilizing VisionGNN-based approaches for more real-world applications.

articleTitle: Automatic Segmentation and Extraction of Skin Lesion in Dermoscopic images using Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Dermoscopy, an epiluminescence light microscope that magnifies lesions and enables investigation down to the dermo-epidermal interface, is a non-invasive method that doctors may use to help with the diagnosis of melanoma. The research on melanoma skin cancers and the many subtypes of each is included in our paper. The four steps of the approach are preprocessing, segmentation, extraction of features, and classification. The artifact-filled image is preprocessed during the preprocessing stage using noise filtering and contrast sharpening. The processed image (Fuzzy C-Means method) immediately initiates a segmentation method. K-means clustering outperforms fuzzy C-Means in terms of outcomes for overlapping data sets. Gabor then does feature extraction. The Gabor filter and Glcm perform feature extraction in the next stage. By computing the pair of pixels with defined values and appearing in a given spatial image in an image, Glcm is used to characterise the image. The Gabor filter determines if a picture contains any certain frequency content. Last but not least, for classification, the bulk of the algorithms described in the literature rely on a feature extraction stage that is followed by a classifier that takes the retrieved features as inputs. However, Support Vector Machine is utilised for classification in our method. SVM produces spaces with many dimensions. The picture is categorised according to the type of melanoma malignancies in the classification output.

articleTitle: COVID-19 Classification using CNN, Inception V3 and Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic has posed unprecedented challenges for global healthcare systems, neces-sitating accurate and rapid diagnostic solutions. The suggested method utilizes the capabilities of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and the Inception V3 module to provide a novel deep learning strategy for COVID-19 identification. The capacity of the Inception V3 architecture to extract nuanced features from challenging medical imaging data is famous. This work evaluates the performance of the CNN-Inception V3 model in differentiating COVID-19 instances from other respiratory illnesses, such as pneumonia, fibrosis, tuberculosis, and normal lung scans, through a thorough examination employing a broad dataset of chest X-ray and CT images. Important parameters like accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) are used to assess the model’s performance. The study also explores the interpretability of CNN-Inception V3 model predictions, providing information on possible clinical uses. The results of this study add to the corpus of research on deep learning-based COVID-19 diagnostics and show the value of cutting-edge technology in the fight against infectious diseases.

articleTitle: Efficient Energy Wireless Sensor Networks Using ACO
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In wireless sensor network (WSN), achieving energy efficient routing is a complicated & difficult task. Sensing node element present in WSNneed limited energy and careful usage as it is operated by number of less rated batteries. Also complexity occurs in maintaining maximum scalability, transferring the data packets in a safe & secured path, increment in life time. So, this research work utilizes a novel Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) based efficient algorithm for energy path. The main benefits of preferring this algorithm isthat it finds the optimal routing solutions and minimum from source to destination. With the objective function, the path having maximum fitness margin is chosen for the routing way 100 sensor nodes placed in a distance of 100m from the base station (BS)to the network is simulated. Then the modified proposed work is compared with the Moth Flame Optimization (MFO) algorithm withmaximum network life time and efficient energy transfer. From the results it is noted that the ALO based WSN is mainly efficient optimally utilize energy.

articleTitle: AI Powered Transformative Post Generator for LinkedIn using LLM and Explicit Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research paper presents an advanced LinkedIn post generator that utilizes cutting-edge Language Models (LLMs) to discern user intent and generate contextually relevant content. The system meticulously analyzes user input to craft professional and engaging LinkedIn posts. This tool has signifi- cant potential for individuals and businesses seeking to enhance content creation and maintain a consistent social media presence. Our paper encompasses natural language processing techniques, prompt engineering, and a user-friendly interface design. It includes an explicit content filter to ensure the production of appropriate and professional content in line with LinkedIn's standards. This paper provides a comprehensive overview of our development process, technology stack, user intent recognition methodology, and user interface design. We also discuss the practical applications, benefits, and implications of this tool for improving online presence and content creation efficiency within professional social media platforms. This research contributes to the growing field of AI-driven content generation in the context of professional networking platforms.

articleTitle: Investigation of Emerging Memory Technologies Such as Resistive Ram and Phase-Change Memory for VLSI Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: TPC manufacturers have followed a very much organized order of memory arrangements since the innovation of the electrical PC and the Von Neumann model, obviously offsetting execution and limit with cost. With an end goal to address these issues and somewhat or totally supplant the current technologies, new ones have been examined and grown as of late, like resistive RAM (RRAM) and phase change memory (PCM). The attributes of state of the art memory technologies for VLSI applications, for example, resistive RAM and phase-change memory, are analyzed in this examination. The field of creating memory technologies is first given a fast framework. Conversation is had in regards to the RRAM's electrical properties, obstruction exchanging cycle, and material characteristics. Furthermore, various hardships are talked about, including perseverance, maintenance, homogeneity, and the effect of functional temperature and irregular message commotion (RTN). There is a portrayal of the RRAM's multi-facet cell (MLC) stockpiling capacities, which is attractive for arriving at high capacity thickness at a sensible cost. Different functional techniques for accomplishing reliable MLC activity have been offered, along with their fundamental actual components. A prologue to the subject of creating memory technologies is given in this paper. It is tended to how phase-change memory and RRAM vary as far as their electrical properties, opposition exchanging instrument, andmaterial piece. Moreover, various troubles are talked about, like power, maintenance, consistency, and the effect of functional temperature and irregular message commotion (RTN).

articleTitle: Enhancing Energy Efficiency in Solar Water Heating Systems for Sustainable Homes with IoT Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sustainable home techniques and methods are becoming more popular as homeowners recognize the need to perform their part to slow global warming and save their energy bills. One effective solution for lowering household energy use and carbon emissions is installing a solar water heating system. To increase the effectiveness, convenience, and sustainability of solar water heating systems, it investigates how to combine these technologies. It discusses the limitations of traditional solar water heating systems, such as their inefficiency, high maintenance costs, and complicated operation. The potential for sensors, data analytics, and remote control to improve energy gathering and distribution is explored in the Internet of Things (IoT)-enabled solar water heating systems. It also proceeds through how predictive maintenance algorithms might help extend the system's life and reduce repair bills. It provides a household installation to evaluate the economics and benefits of IoT-enabled solar water heating systems. Our research shows that energy efficiency has significantly increased, potentially saving up to 30% more money than traditional systems. IoT technology's real-time monitoring and management functions give households more agency over and understanding of energy use.

articleTitle: A Novel Model to Predict Sustainable Growth of Country based on Women Entrepreneurship using Deep Learning Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The dissemination of information and dissemination among individuals have converged on social media. The rise in prominence of social networking platforms has encouraged more individuals to disseminate news online. Thus, it aids in comprehending and anticipating user behaviour on social media platforms, which in turn aids business owners in better comprehending and enhancing the quality of their products and services. It also aids in their ability to comprehend the needs of their clientele. In any economy, the role of entrepreneurs is crucial. Those individuals possess the knowledge, drive, and initiative to bring novel products to market or services to the public, and they also know how to maximize the financial potential of their ideas. Traditions are firmly established in Indian society and the socioeconomic and psychological barriers that have been put up have traditionally favored men. This makes it difficult for educated Indian women to advance in their community. Indian women, although facing several social constraints, have always stood out and been celebrated for their accomplishments. Aspirations for a better life and more equality in education have altered the social structure of the nation of India and as a result, every Indian woman has had to make adjustments to her traditional ways of life. She has gone head-to-head with men and come out on top in every arena, including the corporate world. These ladies are bossy, convincing, and fearless leaders. In this study, we offer Predictive Learning for Women Business Empowerment (PLWBE), a unique deep learning based prediction model that can calculate a country’s growth rate as a function of the number of women who own their own businesses. The study’s findings add to our understanding of the difficulties faced by women business owners everywhere, and its metrics for measuring PLWBE are cross-validated against those from a traditional classification approach called Support Vector Machine (SVM) to demonstrate the scheme’s efficacy.

articleTitle: Real Time Pot Hole Detection for Safe Roadways
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As roadways are developing at an increasingly faster rate with increase in rate of road users, smart and safe transportation systems are required. In this view, an automated pothole identification system based on YOLOv5 (You Only Look Once) method is presented in this paper. Using live video feed and still photos, the technology is intended to find and locate potholes on roads. The YOLOv5 model is trained and fine-tuned with multiple hyper parameters to achieve high accuracy in pothole identification. The dataset is collected and annotated using Roboflow. To improve road maintenance and safety, the system is owned to track and detect potholes on roads in real-time. Performance of proposed system is measured using evaluation parameters such as mAP, precision, F1 score and recall. Presented approach highlights the significance of utilizing cutting-edge technologies for safer and more effective road maintenance while demonstrating the usefulness and promise of employing YOLOv5 for automated pothole detection.

articleTitle: Collision Aware Energy Efficient UAV-assisted Heterogeneous Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Heterogeneous Sensor Networks (HSN) is the most trending technology which is used in lots of intelligent communication systems so that it greatly helps to increase the quality of life of people. Due to high speed and unpredictable mobility certain drawbacks are occurred in the network that reduces the communication quality. For that purpose and Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are created in the network that can able to improve the device monitoring and its mobility so that it increases the sustainability of the devices. The process of UAV deployment is highly flexible but proper UAV placement is the challenging issue in the network. For that purpose in this article Collision Aware Energy Efficient UAV (CEEUH) is concentrated which can able to increase the effectiveness of UAV utilization. The experimental demonstration is conducted using NS3, and the parameters analyzed in this study include energy efficiency and packet delivery ratio. The final output is compared to the findings of existing research, and the results demonstrate that the proposed model outperforms previous techniques

Author Keywords: Collision Aware Energy Efficient UAV and Network Simulation 3

articleTitle: Smart Agricultural Security System: Integrating Arduino Technology for Intruder Detection and Crop Protection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Indian economy has traditionally depended heavily on the agricultural sector, and farmers have been essential to the development of the nation. Farmers who are absent to watch over their fields, however, may encounter difficulties, such as damage by surrounding forested area animals. In order to improve cropsecurity in the current day, a new initiative intends to create a system that can recognize intruders, watch suspicious activity, and swiftly inform the land owner. To do this, an Arduino is used, and if an animal enters the field, a buzzer will sound, LED lights will flash, and the farmer will receive a message within ten seconds of the animal’s detection. This adaptable solution gives growers a practical technique to guarantee that their crops are secure from invasions or unauthorized actions. Additionally, it has sensors to monitor the soil properties for the best growth of the plant. The usage of human-shaped manikins in farm areas persists for such a reason in deterring birds or other animals from agricultural production as well as protecting and intake in crops. Since there are numerous problems with these ideas, increasing crop protection is currently a primary priority. This project’s principal goal is to provide a system to identify intruders, keep a close eye out for any damaging actions, and then alert the system’s owner. It works as an adjustable system that gives farmers a practical method to ensure adequate protection of their fields from any attacks or invading acts.

articleTitle: Analysis of Secured Hash Algorithm-256 in a Blockchain-Based Money Transaction System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Blockchain is not an antique term in the history of computer programming. Introduced and developed only in the last decade, Blockchain has become the first choice of all cyber security engineers. The study is concentrated on the integration of blockchain technology with a few of the strongest hashing algorithms with a focus on SHA-256. The study aims to create and compare adequate and feasible methods to enhance the accuracy and confidence among various enterprises whose systems accompany blockchainbased transactions. The study acknowledges that there has been an increase in the use of Bitcoin in the international market. With the increase in investment in cryptocurrency, blockchain has become one of the most future-proof and sensitive technologies available in the market. The following context discusses the origin of blockchain, the platforms and scripts standardized, and the algorithms that are involved or have the potential to make blockchain cryptographically stronger. It demonstrates the need for a new paradigm to improve efficiency and accuracy.

articleTitle: Enhancing Line Following Robot Navigating with Smart Assistant Capabilities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the essential technologies in the domain of mobile robots is to the ability to traverse a pre-established path. Line-following robots are robotic systems that are specifically engineered to detect and trace black or white lines on surfaces that exhibit alternating colors. The robots are designed to operate independently by adhering to a predetermined path. Equipped with a variety of sensors, these robots are capable of detecting the line in contrast to the surrounding background, so ensuring their ability to remain on track. The attainment of precise and adaptable movement is facilitated by a set of infrared (IR) sensors. In order to regulate the movement of the wheels, a combination of two direct current (DC) gear motors and a caster wheel is utilized. The implementation of an algorithm that governs motor speed and facilitates the robot’s ability to track a line is achieved through the utilization of an Arduino Uno. The main objective of this project encompasses two key aspects. Firstly, it involves the construction of a durable chassis that possesses the ability to transport designated payloads between predetermined waypoints. Secondly, it entails the development of an algorithm that empowers the robot to maneuver through narrow curves effortlessly.

articleTitle: An In-Depth Study of Handwritten Digit Recognition Methods: An Exploration of Deep Learning and Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This article explains how deep learning and machine learning techniques are being utilized to replace humans in a variety of activities, like item classification and sound addition. It emphasizes handwritten text recognition (HTR), which involves computers interpreting handwritten content from sources like paper documents and touchscreens. For recognizing handwritten digits, the study analyzes three algorithms: support vector machines (SVM), multilayer perception (MLP), and convolutional neural networks (CNN). This comparison aims to evaluate the correctness and execution times of different approaches. The evaluation is based on parameters like the dataset used, the number of epochs, algorithm complexity, accuracy, and hardware specifications. The study compares the effectiveness of CNN, Multilayer Perception (MLP), and Support Vector Machines using handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset. It evaluates these algorithms based on criteria such as runtime, complexity, rate of precision, the count of epochs, and the quantity of hidden layers specifically within deep learning techniques. SVM had the highest training data accuracy, but CNN outperformed others on the test dataset. The article’s primary goal is to identify the most precise model for recognizing handwritten digits. It achieves this by assessing the performance of different algorithms and comparing them based on various characteristics.

articleTitle: Understanding the Regional Differences in World Happiness Index Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The World Happiness Report, created by the Sustainable Development Solutions Network and influenced by Gallup World Poll data, responds to a global call for happiness and well-being to be prioritized as core governance measures. The survey highlights the science of happiness across a region or country by investigating personal and national variances in happiness. This study entails data collection, cleansing, and exploratory analysis to uncover variable correlations. It discovers key factors of national happiness levels through correlation heat map and feature selection. Following that, prediction models based on machine learning techniques, such as regression and decision trees, are developed to anticipate a country's happiness score based on the Quality-of-Life factors relating to social, economic, and health data. The aim of this study is to provide insights into elements that contribute to the happiness of a population and explore the various policies implemented by the governments of progressive countries which led to societal upliftment. The regression techniques employed by the study have performed excellently, with an R-squared value of 0.7867 and a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.4797. Notably, the Quality of Life (QoL) indicator for the year 2023 was predicted using Support Vector Regression (SVR), which turned out to be the best approach overall. In a nutshell, this study demonstrates data science's ability to decipher complex societal issues, as seen through the perspective of happiness and well-being.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Prediction of Traffic Accidents Using Deep Learning Ensemble Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Because of the widespread negative effects that traffic accidents can have on people's lives, the study of how to assess and anticipate them using cutting-edge technology is an important area of study. The research of traffic accidents has traditionally relied on data made public by traffic-entities and road-police forces. However, with the advent of social-media, researchers now have access to detailed, real-time data on road accidents occurring across a region, allowing for more comprehensive analyses that take into account previously unreported incidents. This paper uses an ensemble-Deep-Learning(EDL) strategy made up of Gated-Recurrent Units(GRUs) and Convolutional-Neural-Networks(CNNs) to offer a model to forecast traffic accidents utilizing data mined from social-media and the open web. The acquired results are compared to those of published baseline methods and other researchers. The outcomes are encouraging, showing that the proposed EDL approach outperforms the conventional models and other DL approaches published in the literature when applied to the problem setting. Authorities in charge of preventing accidents on the roads can use the data generated by the program.

articleTitle: ARITM: A Perceptual Quality Magnification of Noise Suppressed Digital Images using Adaptive Recursion and Image Transformation Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the realm of digital image processing and enhancement, the relentless pursuit of achieving higher perceptual quality in noise-suppressed images has remained a compelling challenge. This abstract presents a novel approach that leverages the synergy between adaptive recursion and a sophisticated image transformation model to magnify the perceptual quality of noise-suppressed digital images. The proliferation of digital imagery in various applications, from medical diagnostics to multimedia content, necessitates the development of advanced techniques to preserve and enhance image fidelity. While noise suppression techniques have made significant strides in reducing unwanted artifacts, they often introduce trade-offs between noise reduction and preservation of image details. Our proposed method begins by employing adaptive recursion, where the image is divided into local regions, each analyzed independently for noise characteristics and visual features. Adaptive recursion ensures that noise reduction is applied selectively, preserving important image details, even in challenging scenarios. The synergy between adaptive recursion and the image transformation model is a key highlight of our approach. By iteratively applying the transformation model within each local region, we adaptively enhance image features that contribute to perceptual quality, such as sharpness, contrast, and color fidelity. This adaptive enhancement process ensures that image details are magnified while suppressing noise artifacts, ultimately resulting in images of superior perceptual quality. Our experimental results, conducted on diverse datasets with various levels of noise, demonstrate significant improvements in perceptual quality compared to state-of-the-art methods. Additionally, we evaluate the computational efficiency of our approach, highlighting its feasibility for real-time and high-throughput image enhancement applications.

articleTitle: A Robust Data Communication Model to Transmit Data through Human Body using Intelligent Wearable Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: One of the prominent research endeavors in the healthcare sector revolves around the applications of Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs), which offer substantial potential for remote monitoring of human health. This research project is centered on the development of a wearable WBAN application dedicated to the remote monitoring of individuals' health. The primary objective is to continuously capture, process, and transmit human physiological parameters for health monitoring. ECG, SPO2, heart rate, and respiration are just some of the vital physiological signals that are measured by the four specialized biomedical sensor nodes used in this application. These measurements are then converted into actionable data. Subsequently, a processor processes this data and sends it to a central node using a transceiver. The central node serves as a hub for collecting and transmitting the data in real-time to a monitoring PC, where the physiological parameters are visually displayed and recorded on a graphical interface.

articleTitle: Feature Selection based Performance Comparison of Classifier Models for an Imbalanced Dataset: Early Diagnosis of Symptoms for Ovarian Cancer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research aims to reveal the evidence that can be used to narrow the knowledge gap, understand the early signs, and undergo prediagnosis for Ovarian Cancer patients. After the exploratory data analysis, classifier models are applied to the ovarian cancer dataset. The performance of all the classifiers before and after dimensionality reduction was analyzed based on confusion matrix parameters. Applying scoring methods like Information Gain and Gini Decrease for Feature Selection, Principal Component Analysis, and an integrated approach is used for feature extraction. A comparative analysis of classifiers was done, and the performance results were evaluated using the weighted TPR-TNR method as the dataset is imbalanced. The scoring feature selection method has been used to rank the features, which aims to reduce the data's dimensionality to eight for larger datasets, allowing features with maximum information and providing the best attributes by using this methodology, an accuracy of 99.8% on a different validation dataset could be achieved. Gradient Boosting, ANN, Adaboost, and Random Forest are the most recommended classifier algorithms. This study indicates that out of nine classifier models, two models, ANN and Gradient Boosting, significantly improve outcomes with fewer dimensions. This will also help the healthcare industry regulate unnecessary treatment delays by focusing on a limited number of features.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Novel Learning based Prediction Scheme to Detect the Role of Women Entrepreneurs for Family Growth
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In emerging nations, women's participation in the household economy appears to be essential. Historically, it has been assumed that men had an inherent advantage in underdeveloped countries. Women's entrepreneurial status has improved piecemeal, though, with a more supportive social and cultural climate and more chances. The administration has implemented a number of reform and empowerment initiatives for women. However, women entrepreneurs still face widespread resistance from their families and communities. This has dealt with the meat and potatoes of the issues that women business owners encounter. This research examines how women company owners' inclination toward Entrepreneurial Orientation (EO) influences their ability to succeed financially and provide for their families in limited circumstances. In specifically, studies investigate the causes of EO, the factors that determine its impact on corporate success, and its impact on family income. Using a structural equation model on data pertaining to women business owners, researchers found that while higher levels of financial capital and education positively impacted Innovative- and pro-active EO, higher levels of financial capital were the only antecedent positively influencing Risk-taking EO. Entrepreneurial opportunity, financial resources, business education, and experience all have a positive impact on women's company success, whereas cultural barriers have the opposite effect. Women business owners in Bangladesh may help support their families by capitalizing on their company's success.

articleTitle: Mapping the Landscape of Machine Learning Applications in Bitcoin Price Forecasting: A Bibliometric Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The growing utilization of machine learning techniques for forecasting has generated significant interest among individuals involved in Bitcoin investing, trading, and portfolio management. This research presents a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of 123 English- language journal articles indexed in Scopus, focusing on the use of machine learning techniques for forecasting Bitcoin prices. The study provides valuable insights into the field’s progression, patterns, and key contributors. Noteworthy authors include Gupta R, Li J, Li X, and Li Y, while prominent institutions include "King Abdulaziz University", "Mansoura University", and "Sungkyunkwan University". China, Korea, and India are the leading countries in terms of article productivity. The top publishing outlets are identified as "IEEE Access", "Computational Economics", "Entropy", and "Finance Research Letters". The study’s findings cater to the interests of stakeholders in this field. This study conducts the key- word co-occurrence and co-citation analysis to identify potential clustering of topics. The findings have significant implications for academics, industry practitioners, regulators, and policymakers.

articleTitle: EHLM: Empirical Design of Novel Road Curve and Lane Identification Scheme using Effective Hybrid Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this study, we present a novel Road Curve and Lane Identification Scheme that harnesses the power of an Effective Hybrid Learning Methodology (EHLM). This advanced approach combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), Mask R-CNN, and ResNet, creating a formidable framework for road curve detection and lane identification in complex driving scenarios. The EHLM framework offers a versatile solution that excels in detecting road curves and accurately identifying lanes, crucial components of autonomous driving systems and advanced driver assistance. It leverages the strengths of each architecture, from CNN's feature extraction capabilities to Mask R-CNN's precise instance segmentation and ResNet's deep learning prowess. This study provides a comprehensive overview of the EHLM approach, showcasing its efficacy in real-world road scenarios. Through extensive experimentation and evaluation, we demonstrate the superiority of our methodology, achieving precise road curve detection and lane identification. Our research contributes to the development of safer and more efficient autonomous vehicles, ultimately enhancing road safety and transportation systems.In our evaluation, we have considered several models, including CNN, DCNN, MRCNN, CNN-LSTM, ANN, and our Proposed Model. Among these contenders, the Proposed Model stands out prominently in terms of accuracy, achieving an impressive 97.23%. This indicates its remarkable ability to correctly classify and recognize the target elements within the dataset.

articleTitle: Twitter spam detection through feature integration and an enhanced deep neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The utilization of platforms for social networking for the purpose of communication and socializing has experienced a substantial increase. Nevertheless, with the ongoing expansion of social networks, Twitter has evolved as a crucial platform within the realm of social media, serving as a significant conduit for real-life interactions while also becoming a prominent channel for the dissemination of spam content. In light of the aforementioned issues, the task of identifying spam on social media platforms assumes a growing significance. The previous techniques are not able to fully utilize the properties inherent in high-dimensional data from social networks. A proposed method for effectively filtering spam data on social media involves the utilization of the Spotted Hyena and Personalized best Cuckoo Search Optimization Algorithm-based Deep Neuro Fuzzy Network. The suggested methodology demonstrates strong performance in handling high-dimensional data inside a real-world platform environment. This is achieved by employing a novel classifier that incorporates fuzzy temporal correlation and an auto-encoded Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory model. The proposed approach exhibits enhanced robustness, yielding optimal outcomes while concurrently mitigating issues related to computational complexity. Moreover, the suggested methodology shown enhanced efficacy in relation to key evaluation metrics such as precision, recall, and F-measure. These metrics were assessed using a continuous dataset consisting of 5,000 instances, resulting in respective values of 0.898, 0.913, and 0.899. This was accomplished through the execution of a series of tests.

articleTitle: Forecasting Gold Price using Ensemble based Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: An ensemble-based machine learning strategy is presented in this article for estimating gold’s price. The suggested method creates an ensemble model that yields more precise and reliable predictions by combining a variety of machine learning algorithms, such as Decision Tree, Support Vector Regressor, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and others. The study uses daily gold price data from November 2011 to January 2019 to assess the performance of the suggested approach. Various statistical metrics, including R2 score, mean absolute error, and root mean square error are used to assess the performance of the proposed approach. The suggested strategy may be a helpful tool for traders, investors, and policymakers to employ when deciding how much gold to invest in and how to trade internationally. The suggested ensemble-based machine learning approach offers a useful and efficient solution for gold price prediction. The outcomes show that combining various machine learning techniques can improve the model’s predictability and stability.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: A hybrid Improved Fully Homomorphic Encryption with AES to provide high security in Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Since this information may be accessible by a third party and could compromise the client's information's confidentiality, there is a barrier between the customer and the true location of his information. The most often used approach to bridging this security gap has been to first encrypt online data using traditional methods before sending it to the cloud service provider. But to decrypt the information and complete the calculations that are required, the customer must give the server a secret key. Using homomorphic encryption, mathematical calculations can be made on encrypted information without having to first decode it. The electrocardiogram (ECG) measures and finds arrhythmias in the circulatory system. It differ from individual to individual, these characteristics are now employed for identification. So it's crucial to secure an ECG signal. A safety method known as Homomorphic Encryption (HE) handles encrypted information without the need for decryption.The identical initial information findings are provided by HE. In this research, an Improved Fully Homomorphic Encryption (IFHE) technique using Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) is proposed for encoding the ECG measures to enhance safety while safeguarding the confidentiality of information while removing sharing key limitations. The information of the customer is encrypted in the cloud server discussed in this work, so required computations can be performed on the encrypted information. To do this, it is proposed that the method of assessment be added as a further layer of security to the AES technique, which then executes several homomorphic mathematical computations on the encrypted information in place of the initial information. To increase safety, a linear polynomial equation with changeable values is proposed for the assessment procedure.Additionally, the IFHEAES method has a 100% success rate in decryption (recovering the original signal) and 95.8% efficiency in categorization. Its decryption and encryption reaction times are almost 6 times and 3 times faster than those of other techniques, correspondingly. This is so that it can effectively deal with the noise those results from any FHE technique because it is proposed to be built on computationally light matrix computations. As a result, IFHEAES offers the best privacy and security when processing and resistant to threats.

articleTitle: Uncovering the Clusters of Economic Growth and Globalisation Research Using Topic Modelling: A Machine Learning Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Economic growth and globalisation are intricately linked, constituting a dynamic relationship that shapes the trajectory of nations and their development. This research employs a combination of bibliometric analysis and a machine learning technique (structural topic modelling) on a dataset of 1255 research articles from Elsevier’s Scopus database spanning 2002-2022 in the field of economic growth and globalisation. The outcomes of structural topic modelling unveil five distinct thematic clusters: i) Economic growth and human development, ii) Economic growth and technology, iii) Economic growth and environment, iv) Economic growth and foreign trade, and v) Economic growth and policy decisions. The largest cluster is Topic 4 which explores the relationship between economic growth and foreign trade, representing 33.7% of the corpus. The prominent journal, "Environmental Science and Pollution Research," contributes 90 articles (7.2% of the total articles). The study’s forthcoming research goals emphasise the necessity for the efficient utilisation of digital technologies, automation, machine learning, and interconnectedness to promote growth in the manufacturing and services sectors. This will help in fetching the best results in the integration of economic growth and globalisation. These results enhance our understanding of key areas in this field. These findings hold significant importance for a wide audience, encompassing regulators, policymakers, scholars, financial institutions, and industry professionals.

articleTitle: ILAPP: An Efficient Design of Sign Language Recognition System using Intelligent Learning Assisted Prediction Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this study, we introduce ILAPP (Intelligent Learning Assisted Prediction Principles), an innovative design for a Sign Language Recognition System. ILAPP harnesses the power of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for efficient feature extraction and employs the renowned LeNet-5 Model for robust classification. Sign language recognition is a critical technology that bridges communication gaps for individuals with hearing impairments. Our system, ILAPP, offers an efficient and effective solution to this challenge. The core of ILAPP lies in its utilization of CNNs to extract essential features from sign language images, capturing intricate patterns and nuances crucial for accurate classification. The LeNet-5 Model is employed for classification, benefiting from its proven capabilities in image recognition tasks. Our research focuses on enhancing the accuracy and efficiency of sign language recognition, aiming to provide a practical tool for the deaf and hard-of-hearing community. ILAPP represents a significant advancement in this field, and its promising results underscore its potential for real-world applications. This study showcases the fusion of intelligent learning principles with state-of-the-art models, highlighting the importance of leveraging AI in addressing accessibility and communication challenges.In our study, the proposed model demonstrates an impressive accuracy rate of 98.23% when compared to existing models. This high accuracy rate signifies the exceptional performance and effectiveness of our model in sign language recognition.

articleTitle: VisionPal: Visual Assistant System for the Visually Impaired People
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Visual impairment affects millions of individuals worldwide, hindering their ability to interact with society. This research introduces VisionPal, a comprehensive smartphone-based application for the Visually Impaired. The system employs advanced image processing and deep learning techniques to address the challenges visually impaired individuals face in outdoor environments. The core of VisionPal is a smartphone application that integrates features such as obstacle detection, vacant seat identification, road sign recognition, and pedestrian crossing assistance. The background and literature survey delve into related works that are focused on this study. Leveraging YOLOv8, InceptionV3, Tesseract, and MobileNetV2 models, the methodology incorporates machine learning models to detect obstacles, vacant seats, crowd levels, road signs, and color lights. Researchers developed a mobile application allowing users to interact via vocal commands. Testing reveals high accuracy, and the findings depict that the YOLOv8 model precisely identifies vacant seats and crowd levels, achieving an overall accuracy of 98.74%, and obstacle identification depicts an overall accuracy of 94.38%. Further, the InceptionV3 model exhibits 97% accuracy in recognizing road signs and colors. The MobileNetV2 model achieves 98.5% accuracy in identifying traffic lights and pedestrian crossings. User feedback emphasizes the user-friendliness and effectiveness of the application in enhancing outdoor experiences for visually impaired individuals. The significance of this work is its ability to empower visually impaired individuals, enhancing their autonomy, safety, and quality of life. VisionPal addresses real-world challenges by offering a reliable and innovative solution for the visually impaired to navigate public places. The integration of state-of-the-art technologies makes VisionPal a promising tool for promoting inclusion and enabling visually impaired individuals to engage more fully in society.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy logic Clustering Classification of Satellite Images Using K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this study, a unique strategy to improving the semantic segmentation of satellite photographs with complicated backdrops is presented. This approach makes use of deep learning techniques, specifically an algorithm called a K-means clustering algorithm. Satellite imaging is an extremely helpful instrument that can be used to gain a current and up-to-date portrayal of the ecosystem that the Earth and its surroundings are a part of. By continually recording photographs in real time, the vast network of remote sensing satellites that circle the Earth provides coverage that is both comprehensive and consistent over the whole planet. This feature makes it possible to implement a broad variety of applications that are beneficial to the human race.
