Significant interest in a variety of applications has been sparked as a result of the increasing accessibility of routinely collected satellite photographs of a variety of places. Image segmentation is an extremely important technique that is utilized in the field of satellite image processing. This technique is utilized for the purpose of extracting and compiling vast amounts of data from satellite photographs. Because of its potential to derive and evaluate information from a picture, the process of extracting and segmenting satellite images has been the subject of a great deal of research. Image segmentation is an essential stage in the field of satellite image processing because it simplifies the process of extracting and compiling vast amounts of information from satellite photographs. There is a paucity of self-supervised deep learning algorithms that hold the capacity to partition an image into a specified number of separate clusters, such as the k-means algorithm, while simultaneously applying an end-to-end deep learning approach at this time. One example of such an algorithm is the k-means algorithm. In this part, we will discuss the k-Means technique, which permits unsupervised segmentation of a 4-band picture (a picture that contains the near-infrared, red, green, and blue bands), into k separate classes. Our method demonstrates that it is possible to do discrete search using convolutional neural networks (CNN) in conjunction with gradient descent software. [CNN] stands for "convolutional neural networks." Within the model, the model is able to identify k different clustering classes, each of which is represented by a discrete binary mask and its matching texture that was developed independently. When put together, these parts provide an accurate representation of the original picture. By combining the concepts of fuzzy logic with the idea of membership function, the purpose of this investigation is to develop a solution to the problems caused by the traditional implementation of the k-means algorithm. When evaluating the efficacy of the method, several different cluster validity metrics are taken into consideration and the accuracy is about at 87.25 percent and 97.75 percent.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Internet of Things based Systematic Toll Plaza Controlling System using Logical RFID
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The paper introduces innovative system redefines the traditional toll booth management by seamlessly integrating IoT technology and logical Radio-Frequency Identification (RFID). The system's operations take place in real-time, enhancing toll collection processes and improving overall efficiency. The core functionality of this system revolves around the application of IoT technology and logical RFID. When a vehicle approaches the toll plaza, it enters the IoT-enabled RFID reader zone. Here, the logical RFID system, equipped with advanced data processing capabilities, scans and interprets the RFID tags or cards affixed to the vehicles. These RFID tags serve as unique identifiers for the vehicles, enabling swift and automated toll collection. The system is empowered by IoT capabilities, which allow for real-time data exchange between the toll plaza and a central control center or server. This seamless communication ensures that toll transactions are promptly recorded, processed, and monitored. The use of IoT further facilitates efficient and intelligent toll management. It offers commuters a seamless and expedited toll collection experience, reducing congestion and wait times. For toll operators, the system provides a reliable and efficient method for managing toll transactions, enhancing accuracy and security. The real-time communication and logical processing capabilities further elevate the system's responsiveness and monitoring abilities.

articleTitle: Enhancing Malicious QR Code Link Detection with Swarm-Intelligent Squirrel-Search Optimized ANN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Recently, hackers have made plans to replicate harmful links by tricking people in a variety of ways. By acquiring access to sensitive information they use online, they attempt to remotely manipulate the victims' machines or obtain their data. QR codes are two-dimensional barcodes that can encode different types of data and are viewable by digital devices like smart phones. However, there is no recognized procedure for creating QR codes; therefore they could be vulnerable to a number of dubious assaults. The goal of this study is to use the Swarm-Intelligent Squirrel-Search Optimized Artificial Neural Network (SISSO-ANN) to identify harmful URLs concealed behind 2D QR codes. On the basis of barcode forgery, a cyber attack that may be carried out online has been proposed. Through a number of sites, a dataset of harmful and helpful Uniform Resource Locators (URLs) was produced, and their lexical properties were gathered. The experimental finding demonstrates that SISSO-ANN works better than other current techniques and achieves detection precision value of 93.80%,and accuracy of 93.50% which is much greater than the present secure QR code scanners. Additionally, the application with the least privilege authorization, SISSO-ANN, is the most privacy-friendly.

Author Keywords: Swarm-Intelligent Squirrel-Search Optimized Artificial Neural Network (SISSO-ANN)

articleTitle: Use of artificial intelligence and big data for drug discovery model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: For the discovery of new drugs, chemists strictly adhere to a set of rules. Artificial intelligence (AI) and big data are currently being used for drug discovery in development and practise in order to increase productivity or develop novel medications for diseases that were initially untreatable. Furthermore, drugs were not anticipated or created with the same efficiency as they are now owing to AI and big data. The incorporation of AI and ML into the drug research and development procedure has enabled greater precision, fewer toxic side effects, and enhanced dosage formulations. AI has been expanded to include the modelling of novel compounds that resemble pharmaceuticals in order to predict their ADMET properties in the drug discovery procedure. This study will discuss how the use of AI and big data modeling has changed the process of conventional drug development at various phases of drug development and advancement.

articleTitle: Neuroassist ADHD Analyzer: A Smart Application for Recognizing Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) Levels in Children
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is a common neurodevelopmental disorder that affects children. Identifying children with ADHD is a challenging task, as it requires specialized training and expertise. A novel approach to identifying children with ADHD using artificial neural networks (ANNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs) was proposed in this research paper. The web application “NEUROASSIST ADHD Analyzer” was developed to assist in the identification of children with attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) using electroencephalogram (EEG) and facial expression data. The application includes three focus games, focus activities, a facial expression analyzer, a combined probability predictor, and a BOT application for the SNAP IV questionnaire. The ANN and CNN models were used to implement these components. An LR model was used to predict the overall result. The integration of these multiple models into the combined model resulted in an accuracy of 94%, with a sensitivity of 90% and a specificity of 92%. Additionally, the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) was 0.91, indicating good discriminative power. Furthermore, a user study indicated that the application is user-friendly and effective in assisting with the diagnosis of ADHD. This research demonstrates the potential of ANNs and CNNs in identifying children with ADHD and presents a promising tool for assisting clinicians in diagnosing the disorder. Future work could focus on improving the accuracy of the models by incorporating additional data sources and features and expanding the application to a larger population.

articleTitle: Internet of Things Assisted Learning Strategy based Effectual Parking System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: To manage data, parking systems now depend on a centralized gateway solution (i.e., the cloud), which creates various possible failure modes, including data loss, extensive delays, and multiple points of failure. Furthermore, features that do not improve parking utilization and revenue are considered throughout the parking space selection process. Because a steady price point is chosen, the pricing strategy is not particularly lucrative. We describe a cloud-based parking management platform that makes use of IoT devices in this research. The proposed Smart Parking system employs Internet of Things (IoT) modules installed regionally to monitor and inform users to the availability of parking spots. A user may also use a mobile app to enquire about parking space availability and book a place. In addition, the paper gives an overview of the system architecture. The paper finishes with a description of system functioning provided as a use case, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed paradigm.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Deep Learning Neural Network Model and Data-Driven Methods for Smart Grid Theft Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Smart grids are harmed by electricity theft, and electric companies lose a lot of money as a result. Recent research has looked at ways to use a mix of deep learning (DL), machine learning (ML), and statistical methods to spot anomalies and illegal tendencies in electrical consumption (EC) data collected by smart meters. In this research, we combine the best features of the convolutional neural network with the gated recurrent unit to create a unique hybrid model that we call the CNNGRU Model. Accurate power theft detection is one of the model's primary goals, along with resolving problems with previous attempts at this. Overfitting and an insensitivity to data imbalance are two of the problems. Despite its processing complexity, the proposed strategy exceeds its rivals in terms of accuracy. Scientists may dedicate their focus to finding ways that increase performance in the presence of enormous volumes of data as computers become more powerful. The efficacy of the hybrid DL model is studied using a variety of performance measures, including such as F1-score, precision, recall, accuracy, and false positive rate.

articleTitle: An Efficient Learning Assisted Malaria Parasites Identification Methodology based on Blood Smear Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Malaria remains a global health challenge, necessitating accurate and efficient methods for the identification of malaria parasites from blood smear images. In this study, we propose an innovative approach for malaria parasites identification that leverages the power of deep learning and gradient boosting. Our methodology combines the feature extraction capabilities of the MobileNet convolutional neural network with the robust classification capabilities of XGBoost. The MobileNet model is employed to extract discriminative features from blood smear images, providing a rich representation of the parasites’ morphological characteristics. Subsequently, XGBoost is utilized as the classification model to distinguish between infected and uninfected blood samples based on these extracted features. This hybrid approach showcases remarkable accuracy and efficiency, offering a reliable solution for malaria diagnosis. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our methodology, achieving precise identification of malaria parasites while minimizing false positives. The proposed model takes the lead with an impressive accuracy score of 0.98, signifying its exceptional capability in distinguishing between different classes within the dataset. This model, tailored for the specific task at hand, utilizes a combination of innovative techniques to achieve superior accuracy.This innovative learning-assisted approach holds great promise for enhancing malaria diagnosis, particularly in resource-constrained settings, and represents a significant step towards combatting this life-threatening disease more effectively.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Potato Plant Disease Image Reconstruction: Leveraging Deep Learning Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Agriculture stands as an indispensable pillar of human existence. In today's world, digitalization has permeated every facet of life, simplifying the handling of complex tasks. It is imperative that the agricultural sector embrace technology and digitization to benefit both farmers and consumers. The integration of technology and regular monitoring holds the key to the early identification and eradication of crop diseases, ultimately leading to improved yields.Within this document, a methodology is presented for the identification and categorization of diseases afflicting potato plants. This approach relies on the widely recognized Plant Village Dataset, which offers open access to reliable data. The process begins with image segmentation, employing the K-means method to delineate regions of interest. Feature extraction is facilitated through the gray level double decomposition matrix in concurrence with three level concept, enabling the characterization of disease-related patterns. Subsequently, disease classification is achieved using the multi-class support vector machine method, enhancing diagnostic accuracy.The proposed methodology showcases its effectiveness with an impressive accuracy rate of 95.99%. It underscores the pivotal role technology plays in modern agriculture, not only benefiting farmers by safeguarding their crops but also ensuring the quality and safety of agricultural products for consumers. As we navigate the ever-evolving landscape of agriculture, digitalization remains an ally in securing a sustainable future for both agriculture and humanity at large.

Author Keywords: Disease detection in plant leaves using classification of image

articleTitle: An Adaptive Defensive Mechanism for DQN Storage Resources Allocation from Advanced Persistent Threats
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Attackers that utilize Advanced Persistent Threats (APTs) use a wide array of sophisticated methods to steal information from firms that are the targets of their attacks in a way that is both ongoing and undetected. They may even coerce the storage system into using a certain protective strategy, only to be attacked in retaliation for their actions. For the purpose of illustrating the exchanges that take place between anAPT attacker and a defensive party, this research study utilized a model based on the Colonel Blotto game. The defensive side uses a well devised strategy to distribute their central processing units (CPUs) across the various storage devices that are contained within an organizational system. The purpose of this study is to investigate the Nashilibria (NEs) that are associated with the distribution of central processing units (CPUs) in settings that include both symmetric and asymmetric CPUs. The interaction between an APT attacker and a defensive is the primary focus of the inquiry. The purpose of this research is to investigate the impact that restricted CPU resources, data storage capacity, and the number of storage devices will have on the level of data security that is expected to be maintained by the organization's storage system as well as the efficiency of that system. The purpose of this study is to investigate the relationships between a limited amount of CPU resources, a restricted amount of data storage capacity, and the number of storage devices. This research suggests a method for allocating CPU resources that blends policy hill-climbing (PHC) with the Greedy technique. Even without prior knowledge of the APT attack model or the data storage model, the goal is to improve the effectiveness of the defender's APT defense in a dynamic game situation. This is the case even though the knowledge gap exists. This strategy draws on previous experiences gained when navigating similar situations in order to rapidly establish quality standards and accelerate the learning process. The usage of a Q-network (DQN) for the allocation of central processing units (CPUs) provides a considerable improvement in the detection performance APTs in scenarios that comprise a significant quantity of CPUs. In light of the findings of the simulation, it has been hypothesized that the usage of reinforcement learning for CPU allocation, as opposed to Q learning, has the potential to increase the degree of data security.

articleTitle: Sepsis Risk Assessment with XGBoost: A Data-Intensive Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In sepsis, immunological response to infection fails, causing systemic inflammation and organ failure. Sepsis progresses quickly and is commonly misdiagnosed, making early discovery and treatment crucial for patient outcomes. Augmented patient care and earlier intervention are possible using machine learning sepsis prediction systems. This research investigates if the well-known gradient boosting technique XGBoost can predict sepsis. Our goal is to construct a viable predictive model that can identify sepsis patients at risk of deterioration utilizing a huge dataset of EHRs from various healthcare facilities. The information includes vitals, test results, and patient details. Methodology includes "data preprocessing," "feature engineering," and model development". Train the XGBoost model to predict sepsis onset and then build a threshold-based system to alert patients when their risk surpasses a certain level. Some indicators of model efficacy include sensitivity, specificity, and AUC-ROC. Sepsis prediction appears promising using the XGBoost model. If doctors can detect at-risk patients early and administer early treatments, fatality rates and patient outcomes may decrease. The study emphasizes the need of machine learning in healthcare to improve clinical decision support systems and assist critical care physicians.

articleTitle: An efficient task of floading mechanism using Genetic Operator Adaptive Firefly Algorithm (GOAFA) in an Edge-Cloud environment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Over the last few decades, cloud has been treated as the popular computing techniques over the internet. This cloud ecosystem should be reliable, and flexible with dynamic load balancing. The users on the internet are becoming billions and the resources are dynamically allocated to them in a demand fashion and their services have increased at an alarming rate. The load balancing is the major issue of cloud computing where the workload is dynamically distributed to every one (nodes) in the network. Moreover, edge computing assists with the cloud to enhance the system performance where the generated data are processed by edge computing nodes. Edge computing makes the computing resources that are closer to the user’s location of the cloud. This will decrease the response time and minimize the network bandwidth. Nevertheless, it is still a challenge to maintain the load balance in edge nodes while minimizing the event completion time. With this perspective, this paper proposed an efficient task offloading method to ensure the load balance of the edge-cloud environment with reduced propagation time and load balance variance. Technically, first, construct the system model and then defined the multi-objective problem using the proposed Meta heuristic algorithm. Afterward, proposed a Genetic Operator Adaptive Firefly Algorithm (GOAFA) to optimize the propagation time and solves issues on load balancing in Edge-cloud environment (ECE). Finally, few simulations are done to prove the efficiency of the proposed system model.

articleTitle: Transforming Lung Carcinoma Analysis: Deep Learning‘s Efficient Segmentation and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cancerous cells can develop in the lungs, a condition known as lung carcinoma. One of the most deadly and challenging malignancies to cure, lung cancer often spreads to other parts of the body at an early stage. The World Health Organisation reports that for several decades, lung cancer has topped all cancers globally in terms of incidence. Early detection and treatment of lung cancer are of the utmost importance. More effective treatments, less intrusive surgeries, and longer survival times may result from this. This paper presents a method for efficiently segmenting and classifying lung carcinomas using convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for the purpose of identifying malignant tumors. Here, additional effective methods such as an adaptive median filter for preprocessing, histogram equalization, edge-based segmentation, and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for successful classification are used to identify the lung carcinoma. To make segmentation more efficient, we use the Adaptive Median Filter in conjunction with the Histogram Equalization technique. It is also possible to transfer the important properties to the classification algorithm by deriving them from feature similarity. When compared to another prediction model that is already in use, the suggested model has the potential to attain superior accuracy. Reduced time and effort spent on detecting lung cancer are two benefits of the enhanced performance.

articleTitle: Facial Pain Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The method of recognizing and measuring pain endured by somebody through their facial movements is known as facial pain identification. Because they represent the person's behavioral and physiologic responses to pain, facial expressions are an important predictor of pain. This technique is often used in medical settings to assess and manage pain in patients who cannot verbalize their pain, such as young children, elderly individuals, and those with communication difficulties. Facial pain is a common symptom that can indicate various underlying health conditions. The ability to recognize face discomfort quickly and accurately is critical for efficient prevention and treatment of these diseases. Deep learning algorithms have demonstrated encouraging results in a variety of medical applications, including pain detection, in recent years. We present a deep learning-based pain in the visage monitoring system in this research that uses CNN to extract significant characteristics from face photos and categorize them as pain or non-pain. The suggested system will then be trained and tested using datasets that are widely accessible of photos of face discomfort. Evaluating and analyzing the usefulness of the different deep learning frameworks for this purpose.

articleTitle: Exploring Human Resource Management Intelligence Practices Using Machine Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Human Resource Management Intelligence (HRMI) and sophisticated data analytics are converging to bring about a revolutionary change in HR procedures in today's information age. This study takes an inquisitive trip to the interface between human resources and machine learning, investigating the empirical discoveries and practical applications that reframe HRMI. We explore the complex relationship between HR choices and outcomes like performance and turnover using machine learning models. A convincing narrative is articulated by the study's authors: machine learning methods, ranging from linear regression to random forests, lead a data-driven HR revolution. The results highlight the value of strategic investment in employee development, provide light on the complex dynamics of employee happiness and retention, and explore the ethical elements of HRMI in an age of heightened data scrutiny. Real-world examples illustrate the concepts and provide actionable guidance for HR experts who want to make more informed decisions with the help of data. This study also supports a more comprehensive method of HRMI, one that integrates empirical data analysis with theoretical frameworks. The convergence of AI, ethical AI, and the changing nature of remote labor opens up exciting possibilities for HRMI in the future. This waypoints towards an HRMI field that is not just reactive but also prescient, an area where information serves as the compass leading businesses to improved financial health, more diversity of thought, and a more promising future in the workplace. The research paper reveals the future of HRMI, which is a data-driven frontier where HR experts transform into architects of better work environments, where strategic insights, organizational success, and the well-being of the workforce are all harmoniously balanced.

articleTitle: Thematic Clustering of Latent Topics in Banking Fraud Detection: A Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Fraud detection in banking is crucial for averting losses, preserving client confidence, and ensuring regulatory compliance. This study employs a machine learning text-mining technique named structural topic modelling to explore a dataset comprising 331 articles from Elsevier’s Scopus database, covering 2003 to 2022. It concentrates on fraud detection within the banking sector, investigating publication patterns, emphasising influential countries, and identifying significant sources. India emerges as a substantial contributor, with 54 articles, mainly in single-country publications (47 articles) and a multiple-country publication Ratio of 0.13. "Advances in Intelligent Systems and Computing" notably contributes 14 articles. Structural topic modelling reveals four distinct thematic clusters: Machine learning in fraud detection, Banking transaction fraud detection, Customer behaviour in fraud detection, and Credit card transaction fraud detection. The findings provide valuable insights into the banking sector’s dynamic fraud detection landscape. These thematic clusters enhance our understanding of this field, aiding researchers seeking to publish their work in reputable sources. These findings hold significant implications for a wide range of stakeholders, encompassing academics, practitioners, regulators, and policymakers.

articleTitle: Utilizing deep learning techniques for detection of Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome using ovarian ultrasound image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This Polycystic Ovarian Syndrome (PCOS) is a medical condition that affects women of reproductive age, characterized by a hormonal imbalance. It usually starts during adolescence, but symptoms may fluctuate over time. PCOS can cause hormonal imbalances due to the cysts present in the ovaries and that can lead to secretion of excess level of androgen. Due to this a PCOS patient can have irregular periods which can cause infertility due to the lack of ovulation. One of the major cause of infertility is PCOS. PCOS is a condition where it is incurable. However, through lifestyle changes, medications and fertility treatments some symptoms can be controlled. Factors like genetics, obesity and high level of androgen can be the causes of the PCOS. But the exact cause is unknown. Polycyst detection using ovarian ultrasonography (USG) scans is a very reliable way to accurately diagnose PCOS and create individualized treatment plans for affected people. Adopting an intelligent computer-assisted cyst detection method is a workable alternative to depending on the imperfect process of manual identification. Thus, we introduced a deep learning-based classification system for PCOS prediction in this research. We train and test the model with a dataset of ovarian ultrasonography (USG) images. To distinguish between ovaries affected by PCOS and those that are not, relevant features from the dataset were specifically extracted using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). This paper compares different deep learning algorithms such as Alexnet, Resnet50, VGG16 and YOLO V5, which have been found to be the most useful in classifying the ovaries affected by PCOS effectively. The validation techniques show Yolo V5 to be the most effective with an accuracy of 99.8%.

articleTitle: Enabling Smart Banking AI and IoT: Challenges and Opportunities
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper examines Smart Banking, where AI and IoT are transforming the financial system. We examine Smart Banking's difficulties and potential and use mathematical models to assess AI and IoT usage in banking.Our results show that AI-driven consumer personalization positively correlates with customer happiness, demonstrating its transformational potential. IoT technology may boost operational efficiency, saving financial institutions money and giving them a competitive edge. AI-powered security methods successfully reduce data breaches, protect consumer data, and build confidence.We stress regulatory compliance and ethical responsibility to demonstrate the industry's commitment to responsible AI and IoT. Financial institutions can transform the sector and benefit customers by investing in AI and IoT technologies and aligning them with regulatory and ethical issues to deliver highly customized, efficient, and secure financial services.For financial institutions, politicians, and technology suppliers, this study provides practical advice. It shows Smart Banking's disruptive potential, practical methods to achieve its advantages, and the industry's commitment to responsible innovation. A more safe, efficient, and customized financial environment is possible by harnessing Smart Banking potential and tackling its difficulties.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Secured IRIS Recognition System using Learning Assisted Classification and Prediction Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: An IRIS Recognition System is a biometric technology that identifies individuals based on the unique patterns in their irises, which are the colored part of the eye surrounding the pupil. This technology relies on the fact that every individual has distinct iris patterns, even between identical twins. In this study, we present an experimental evaluation of the Secured IRIS Recognition System (SIRISRS) employing a Learning Assisted Classification and Prediction Methodology. The core of our approach lies in the utilization of a Hybrid Inception and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model, a fusion of Inception architecture and traditional CNN.The SIRISRS demonstrates its proficiency in iris recognition, an area of biometrics vital for authentication and security applications. Leveraging a dataset with diverse iris patterns, our methodology focuses on feature extraction and classification. Through rigorous evaluation, we assess the system’s recognition accuracy and efficiency. Performance metrics such as Sensitivity, Accuracy, Specificity, Precision, Recall, and F Measure are employed to comprehensively gauge its capabilities. Our results underscore the SIRISRS’s exceptional accuracy, cementing its position as a formidable solution for iris recognition in security and authentication scenarios, which showcases remarkable accuracy, achieving a rate of 99.85%. This study contributes valuable insights into the fusion of advanced neural network architectures and machine learning in biometric systems, opening avenues for enhanced security and identity verification applications.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Impacts on Human Resource Digitalization Industry 4.0
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Industry 4.0 has ushered in a new age of profound change, one in which technological advancements and human ingenuity are merging to redefine whole sectors. The incorporation of AI into HR processes is the driving force behind the current revolution. Within the framework of Industry 4.0, this study investigates the far-reaching effects of AI on HR digitization. Our study sheds light on the mutually beneficial interaction between AI and HR processes via the use of rigorous techniques, such as mathematical modelling and ethical issues. The findings confirm a causal link between AI implementation and HR outcomes, highlighting the opportunity to boost effectiveness, talent management, and workforce output. The temporal dynamics also show that this connection is dynamic, which highlights the need of flexible approaches. Predictive models built with machine learning may be used practically to foresee HR results from AI implementation. The ethical implications of AI-driven HR highlight the significance of justice and the elimination of prejudice. This study helps HR experts, company executives, and government officials better understand the evolving environment of AI-driven HR and implement constructive reforms in the field. By highlighting the importance of advanced AI algorithms, ethical considerations, interdisciplinary collaboration, and a human-centred approach, this research points to a path forward that will make AI-driven HR in Industry 4.0 not only efficient but also ethical, equitable, and responsive to the changing needs of today’s workforce.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Smart and Personalized Education Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)

authors.preferredName: Gamage J. G. A. C. H

abstract: An AI assistant addresses online education's shortcomings, focusing on personalized learning and career guidance. It provides tailored recommendations, assesses performance, suggests subjects, and crafts learning plans. Objectives include accurate grade prediction, subject stream advice, customized assessments, and personalized strategies. The study shows data analytics and machine learning forecast grades, while multi-tenancy architecture improves data handling. Personalized assessments consider both academics and soft skills. Machine learning promises accurate subject stream predictions, and engagement detection aids in optimal learning. This AI system holds potential in reshaping online education, but ongoing improvements are vital for enhanced learning.

articleTitle: Virtual Laboratories in Higher Education Enhancing Chemistry and Biology Learning Outcomes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research looks at whether or not primary school pupils' critical thinking and decision-making skills may benefit from the use of virtual labs. One hundred kids at a Chennai, India, public, all-girls elementary school were randomly assigned to one of two classes. In the beginning, the experimental group and the control group undertook different virtual laboratory tasks. Following this, Test I was given to both sets of participants. Next, we had both groups do some genuine lab work using real equipment, and then we gave them Test II. Statistical analysis, including independent t tests, was employed to evaluate the data from both groups. The findings demonstrated notable disparities between the two groups, with the experimental group surpassing the control group in their grasp of experimental concepts, execution of experiments, and attainment of precise results. Nonetheless, there was no substantial distinction in the accuracy of task completion. In summary, the study showcased a valuable transference of skills acquired from virtual laboratory exercises to the actual laboratory, consistently resulting in higher average scores for the experimental group

articleTitle: A Data-driven Predictive Approach Using Custom and Regression Algorithms for Estimating Student’s Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Efficient approaches to estimating and understanding student performance are paramount in the dynamic landscape of higher education. This paper introduces "AData-driven Predictive ApproachUsing Custom and Regression Models for Estimating Student’s Performance," aiming to provide educators with valuable insights into academic outcomes. By integrating specific academic data sources and employing regression analysis, machine learning algorithms, and other data-driven methodologies, educators can gain actionable insights into student performance trends through predictive modeling. The paper delves into the technical complexities of the strategy, outlining methodologies and presenting practical implementations through illustrative examples and case studies. The ethical considerations of data usage and privacy are carefully investigated, emphasizing responsible implementation in the educational context. Pilot implementations in real-world educational settings are explored, shedding light on the strategy’s efficacy and potential impact on educators and students. This study represents a significant advancement in using data-driven strategies to estimate student performance in higher education, envisioning a future where educators are equipped with valuable tools to understand and support each student’s academic journey comprehensively.

articleTitle: Automated Brain Disease Diagnosis and Patient Support System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)

authors.preferredName: Sai Shree Ram Balaji B L

abstract: The "Automated Brain Disease Diagnosis and Patient Support System" is a web application that aids hospital administration in diagnosis of five classes of brain disorders: Alzheimer's Disease, Parkinson's Disease, Brain Tumor, Epilepsy, and Stroke. The application involves radiologists to upload the MRI scans for detection of brain diseases through a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). After successful diagnosis, the system automatically generates detailed reports containing diagnosis results, supportive action measures, patient details, and recommends neuro-specialists for further consultation. A statistical visualization tool is also integrated to the system to identify trends in brain diseases diagnosed. Secure OTP based authentication is utilized to authenticate patient access, allowing them to access diagnosis reports and interact with an AI assistant for further queries. React.js is used in developing the front-end of the system, while the back-end is developed using Node.js, Express.js, and MongoDB for efficient data handling. For email automation and report generation several python libraries are used, and Streamlit (an open-source Python framework) is integrated for statistical data visualization. The proposed system aims to detect a broader spectrum of brain diseases with high accuracy and streamline patient support services, thereby contributing to improved healthcare outcomes.

articleTitle: IoT Based Bank Locker Security System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This article presents the design and implementation of an IoT based bank locker security system utilizing the ESP32-CAM microcontroller and Telegram messaging platform. By installing a camera, wireless connectivity and an instant messaging module, the system aims at providing security and convenient door access control. ESP32-CAM is recording images of persons entering the door, sending a notification via telegram to authorized users. This system allows users to control lockers via remote access from anywhere with the Internet connection, monitor entrance and permit or reject access at any time.

articleTitle: Model Privacy Preservation in Distributed Systems through Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The increasing integration of machine learning models into distributed systems raises a pressing concern: how to safeguard privacy of the data and secure the model during sharing. In response to the challenge, a robust solution was proposed. The project's central problem is ensuring the privacy and security of machine learning models within distributed environments. To solve the issue, a machine learning based model is developed for predictive tasks while emphasizing the paramount importance of data privacy and security. With dataset selection, a k-nearest neighbors (KNN) model was constructed. For secure sharing of the model across distributed systems, the Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) algorithm was used to encrypt the model feature and dataset. AES, being a symmetric key algorithm, necessitates secure encryption key exchange. The Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) algorithm is used to solve the problem, an asymmetric key system with public and private keys. The AES encryption key is securely transmitted via the recipient's public key encryption. Upon reception, decryption enables the reconstruction and utilization of the machine learning based model for further predictions. The project offers a comprehensive solution to the overarching problem of preserving data privacy and model security in distributed systems. By combining various encryption algorithms, the confidentiality and integrity of sensitive machine-learning models within distributed environments were ensured.

articleTitle: A Secured Framework Model to Design Electronic Voting System using BlockChain Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The usage of a technology known as blockchain, which offers an advantage in terms of technology and is becoming more prevalent in the industries of digital money and monetary transaction. The blockchain is used to keep track of transactions, and these records may be used to verify that a contract’s terms are legitimate. The simple accessibility of blockchain applications that are built on top of other types of technology, such as the electronic voting system, is the major emphasis of this research. As an illustration, the traditional way of electronic voting has been afflicted by a variety of issues and limits for a very long time. In order to build a trustworthy electronic voting system, a decentralized application that is helped by blockchain technology has been developed. This application offers improved equality, honesty, and adaptability in comparison to the current method. This research presents a novel secured distributed database for the purpose of storing information pertaining to voters. The information pertaining to each voter will be saved in the database in conjunction with a secret key and an electronic signature. In the first part of this article, we investigate how well a selection of well-known blockchain frameworks function when used as a blockchain service. Then, as a solution to these issues, we provide a cutting-edge electronic voting system that is based on blockchain technology. This study analyses the deployment of a blockchain-based technology that enhances election security while lowering related costs in order to investigate the possible uses of distributed ledger technology. In conclusion, but certainly not least, the blockchain-based technology allows reliable durability, secrecy, and accountability, which improves system stability and security and lowers the cost of organizing elections on a national scale.

articleTitle: Musa Base - Mobile Application for Banana Farmers to Minimize the Challenges in Banana Production during the Pre-Harvest and Post-Harvest Period
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)

authors.preferredName: N. H. P. Ravi Supunya Swrnakantha

abstract: This research paper presents an innovative solution to address the multifaceted challenges encountered by banana farmers in Sri Lanka, encompassing the entire spectrum of banana production from pre-harvest to post-harvest stages. The proposed system, titled "Musa-Base," is a user-friendly mobile application that seamlessly integrates cutting-edge technologies, including machine learning, IoT-based approaches, natural language processing, and image processing methodologies. This holistic approach aims to elevate the quality and productivity of banana cultivation. The Musa-Base system comprises several interlinked modules: crop yield prediction, disease identification through advanced image processing and interactive chatbot interactions, personalized recommendations for optimal watering and fertilizer strategies, and comprehensive guidance on best agronomic practices. The research rigorously employs a diverse range of algorithms, including deep learning models, for accurate crop yield prediction, rapid disease diagnosis, and finely tuned recommendation systems. The system empowers farmers with informed decision-making capabilities, enabling them to mitigate losses, efficiently allocate resources, and ultimately enhance banana production and product quality. The integration of images of banana plants, sensor data, and user input data forms the backbone of the data-driven research methodology that underpins the development of the Banana Mobile Application. The pivotal outcomes of this research include precise disease detection, reliable harvest forecasting, and the dynamic integration of a chatbot for timely assistance, all of which collectively contribute to superior banana crop management, heightened agricultural efficiency, and enhanced sustainability. This comprehensive solution caters to the needs of both smallholder farmers and commercial producers, representing a significant advancement in modernizing banana farming practices and ensuring food security.

articleTitle: Analysis of Sentimental on Twitter using Content Aware Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the era of the Internet’s rapid expansion, social networking platforms have emerged as a crucial medium for individuals to convey their emotions and opinions to a global audience. Text, images, audio, and video are all ways for people to express themselves. Twitter, a popular social network, allows users to tweet about their daily feelings and opinions. These platforms generate vast amounts of unstructured data continuously, necessitating prompt processing to gain insights into human psychology. This processing is accomplished through sentiment analysis, a technique that assesses the emotional polarity within texts, determining whether the author holds a -Ve, +Ve, or neutral stance toward a subject, service, individual, or place. This article investigates the use of four well-known data mining classifiers, specifically the decision tree, K-nearest neighbor, naive Bayes, and support vector machine, to analyze tweet sentiments. Our findings reveal that the support vector machine consistently yields superior results compared to other algorithms, demonstrating an improvement of 4.01% in accuracy for two-class datasets and 8.05% for three-class datasets.

articleTitle: IoT Based Smart Poultry Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: India’s agricultural economy depends heavily on the chicken sector, which has expanded tremendously because of improved farming methods. Maintaining the pace of the current world requires the adoption of automation and IoT technologies by almost all farming sectors. This work aims to automate poultry form management systems using IoT technology. The health of chicken can be affected by various important environmental factors that includes temperature, humidity, light intensity, percentage of ammonia gas, etc. Furthermore, manual tasks like feeding, timely provision of water, and floor maintenance are to be mechanized. The device continuously monitors the chick’s growth and development and initiates timely alerts to the owner and facilitates remote monitoring and control of the farm. The quality, quantity/number and the health of the chicken can be improved by maintaining optimal conditions. A mobile app and a website are used to provide continuous monitoring through information acquired from the farm and can also provide historical data for future use.

articleTitle: Neural Network Implementation for Battery Failure Detection in Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Soil destruction and global warming have recently come to the forefront of discussion in industrialised nations as governments strive to accommodate the rising demands of their citizens. The demand for zero-emission electric cars has increased as a result of international competitiveness and technological advancements (EVs). Concerns about the high voltage of increasing numbers of electric cars are shared by an increasing number of individuals. Since the system of batteries may be at responsible for over 30% of EV accidents, it is vital to investigate how problems with LIBs are recognized. Many different kinds of problems make it hard to fix EV's LIB. Fast and precise diagnosis of battery pack problems is crucial for the immediate and ongoing safety of EV operation. Utilizing models of neural networks like multiple hidden layers (MLP) or nonlinear activation functions, this research provides a mechanism for identifying and fixing problems with electric vehicle batteries (RBF). To generate information for the BFD system, battery simulations are done in MATLAB. Accuracy may be improved by performing pre-processing steps on the information once it has been generated. After training, the two models are put to the test to see how well they perform. There are both positive and negative measures that may be used to determine which model is the best.

articleTitle: Smart Product Packing and IoT Marketing: Enhancing Customer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The convergence of smart product packaging and IoT marketing has transformed commerce. This study examines the fundamental ramifications of convergence and its potential to improve customer engagement. Our research shows the transformational potential of these technologies via quantitative and qualitative analyses.Smart packaging outperforms non-smart items, giving firms an advantage, according to quantitative data. Regression and correlation analysis confirm IoT data-customer interaction. Our study also emphasizes ethical data acquisition, which supports data privacy and consumer protection.Consumers may expect personalized experiences, transparency, and real-time feedback from this technology transformation. Smart product packaging and IoT marketing enable readers to make educated decisions and influence product development to meet changing consumer expectations.This research allows academics to study the ideas and models that affect consumer engagement. Data privacy and consumer protection may inform IoT marketing and smart device packaging policy.Our research guides organizations and customers towards better customer interactions, data-driven decision-making, and ethical data practices in this changing age. The future promises revolutionary customer contact.

articleTitle: Detecting and Responding to Cloud Security Incidents based on AI and Forensic Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: With the use of AI and digital forensics, this paper outlines a complete strategy for handling security incidents in the cloud. The research is meant to improve cloud-based security issue detection and response. The results indicate the promise of this integrated strategy, with AI models improving the accuracy of issue detection and digital forensics speeding incident triage. Improved cloud security, proactive threat detection, optimized resource allocation, and conformity with legal and regulatory standards are only some of the practical consequences discussed in the paper. Advanced AI models, automated incident response, human-machine cooperation, threat intelligence integration, adversarial machine learning, compliance and legal issues, and cross-cloud security are all areas the report suggests further investigation into. In sum, this study aids in developing a more proactive and resilient strategy for handling cloud security incidents in a dynamic digital environment

articleTitle: A Smart Agriculture Friendly Intelligent Flying Robot Design to Identify Plant Leaf Diseases by using Digital Image Processing with Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Smart agriculture practices have become crucial in meeting the growing global food demand while minimizing resource use. In this context, the development of intelligent systems and automation plays a pivotal role. This paper introduces a novel solution: a smart agriculture-friendly intelligent flying robot equipped with cutting-edge digital image processing techniques and a learning approach to identify plant leaf diseases. The suggested system merges state-of-the-art robotics and aerial technology with advanced machine learning techniques, specifically the VGG-SVM model. The flying robot is equipped with a high-resolution camera to capture images of plant leaves in real-time, and the VGG-SVM model processes these images for disease detection. VGG offers deep feature extraction capabilities, while SVM provides accurate classification, making the model adept at discerning healthy from diseased leaves. Through digital image processing, the robot captures high-resolution images of plant leaves, which are subsequently subjected to advanced machine learning algorithms. These algorithms analyze and classify the images, providing real-time insights into the health of crops. The combination of precision aerial data collection and machine learning ensures early disease detection and targeted intervention, optimizing crop yield, reducing resource consumption, and ultimately contributing to sustainable agriculture. Proposed model excels with the highest accuracy of 0.97, indicating an overall high rate of correct predictions.

articleTitle: Quality Assurance in Low-Code/No-Code Development
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Low-code and no-code development platforms have emerged as instrumental tools in expediting software development, catering to individuals with limited or no traditional coding expertise. Irrespective of the programming language or platform used, thorough testing remains imperative for all applications. Consequently, quality assurance practices hold significant relevance in the context of low-code/no-code development. This study endeavors to scrutinize quality assurance practices concerning the assessment of reliability, security, and performance in low-code/no-code applications. It also strives to elucidate prevailing quality assurance procedures within the low-code/no-codedevelopment landscape while shedding light on the encountered challenges within existing implementation platforms. The research adopts a qualitative approach, involving the distribution of surveys among IT professionals, aimed at identifying the most efficient low-code/no-code development platform. The findings from the survey responses underscore the prominence of Microsoft Power Apps, with 45% of users endorsing it as their preferred low-code/no-code development platform.

articleTitle: Detection of Wild Animals using their sound for identification and conservation in the forest by implementing deep learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Recognition of animals in the forest using sound classification is an emerging trend in the current research. Our study proposed a model to classify the tiger roar sound using optimized CNN. For this, we have extracted the animal sounds from YouTube and applied the Noise Injection and Pitch shift augmentation techniques to increase the sound samples. We use 1200 audio samples of four animal sounds. This model was implemented with MFCC, ZCR, and Mel-Spectrogram feature extractions to enhance the performance. Our model interpretability for practical wildlife conservation and monitoring applications ensures seamless forest department personnel deployment. The primary objective is to accurately identify animals based on their vocalizations using audio features including sounds from tigers, leopards, elephants, and otters. We also classify the sound using SVM, Random Forest, LSTM, and CNN. Apart from all the models, the Optimized CNN achieved an impressive accuracy rate of 91%.

articleTitle: Adaptive Trans-Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory for Detecting COVID19 Epidemic Fake News on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Arguing in a disinformation era in the wake of the COVID19 pandemic is a challenging endeavour for many superpower nations. On social media, disinformation and rumours move such as any actual news, and most of the moment individuals are misguided with that data. Believing in rumours can have severe repercussions in both the society and individual. This makes it more severe in the event of a global epidemic at a point that it has caused chaos among nations and people. Fake news can not only produce cognitive uncertainty during periods like the COVID19 pandemic, but it can also endanger the lives of individuals. To address these difficulties, during pandemics, a deep learning-based detection of fake news is created to determine whether the news is fake or real. Initially, for this identification of fake news, the text data from twitter and other social networks is gathered. The collected data is applied to the text preprocessing strategies for improving text information quality. Further, the fake news from the social media is detected through "Adaptive Transformer Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory (ATrans-Bi-LSTM)" to identify the fake or real news. The hyperparameters from the Bi-LSTM network are tuned via the Komodo Mlipir Algorithm (KMA) to improve the effectiveness over the fake news detection on social networks. The classified outcome is compared with the traditional detection of fake news models in terms of various performance measures to ensure the effectiveness.

Author Keywords: "Adaptive Transformer Bidirectional Long Short Term Memory"

articleTitle: Experimental Design of IoT based LPG Gas Leakage Detection and Accident Prevention Mechanism using Intuitive Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this study, we present an innovative experimental design for an Internet of Things (IoT) based LPG Gas Leakage Detection and Accident Prevention Mechanism, incorporating intuitive sensors. The objective is to enhance safety in environments where LPG gas is utilized by implementing a proactive system that can detect gas leaks and prevent potential accidents. Our experimental setup includes a network of sensors strategically placed to monitor LPG gas levels, temperature, and environmental conditions. These sensors are interconnected through IoT technology, enabling real-time data transmission and analysis. When a gas leak is detected or environmental conditions indicate potential hazards, the system triggers immediate alerts and safety protocols. This research aims to bridge the gap in LPG safety by combining IoT technology with intuitive sensors, offering a reliable and efficient solution for gas leakage detection and accident prevention. The study not only outlines the experimental design but also provides insights into the practical implementation of such systems, contributing to safer environments and reduced risks associated with LPG usage.

articleTitle: An Integrated Approach to Potato Leaf Disease Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks and Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The worldwide agricultural sector is vital to feeding the growing population. Crop health and production must be protected for food security. Sustainable agriculture requires timely plant disease identification and management. This study examines potato disease of leaf detection, an important part of modern agriculture. They test machine learning and deep learning on a Kaggle dataset of plant leaves, including potato leaves. This study aims to determine the best disease detection tool. CNN and Random Forest are the main models. Pooling layers after many convolutional layers extract leaf image features. These models are precisely optimized for performance. In diagnosing potato leaf diseases, CNNs achieve 95–97% accuracy. Precision, recall, F1-score, and confusion matrix data reveal the models' strengths and limitations and their ability to distinguish illness classifications. This research benefits scientists and farmers. The findings aid early disease diagnosis and potato agriculture disease control. As data-driven agriculture advances, machine learning as well as deep learning can mitigate crop diseases and ensure global food security. This research advances the use of innovative technologies to solve agricultural problems.

articleTitle: Sri Potha: A Voice-Based Sinhala Document Maker
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study discusses the development of a web application aimed at facilitating Sinhala document creation, with a specific emphasis on Sinhala voice-to-text conversion and the handling of Sinhala commands through vocal input. Leveraging machine learning techniques, including convolutional neural networks and Natural Language Processing, the application's core features were established. Extensive research was conducted to tailor the application's content to the needs of its primary users, ensuring maximum effectiveness. The user-friendly interfaces of the web application are designed for clarity, simplicity, and consistency. The primary objective of this research is to comprehensively analyze the implementation of Sinhala voice-to-text conversion and Sinhala command handling systems. These systems are primarily designed to benefit diverse users, including journalists, content writers, and differently abled individuals with verbal abilities, by enhancing the efficiency of creating Sinhala documents. Through a detailed exploration of the research methodology, this study offers insight into the development process of the web-based system. The outcomes of the linguistic model training, presented within the study, reveal achievements and advancements that address the limitations inherent in existing solutions. Key findings from this research demonstrate the successful functionality of the Sinhala voice-to-text converter and the efficacy of the Sinhala command handler. The voice-to-text conversion system achieved an impressive accuracy rate of over 80%, while the Sinhala command handler exhibited an accuracy of approximately 80%. Moreover, this research envisions potential applications that extend beyond document creation. The technology showcased in the web application holds promise for broader language-based applications, impacting education, accessibility, and communication across the native Sinhala-speaking community in Sri Lanka. In summary, this research showcases the potential of machine learning technologies to transform linguistic applications within the context of the Sinhala language. By facilitating seamless communication and document creation, the developed web application provides valuable tools for a wide range of users.

articleTitle: Unravelling the Landscape of Mental Accounting Research Using Machine Learning: A Topic Modelling Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The heightened global recognition of mental accounting in the realm of behavioural finance research has attracted the attention of academics, scholars, industry professionals, financial institutions, and decision-makers. This study utilizes bibliometric analysis and structural topic modelling to investigate a dataset of 388 articles from Elsevier’s Scopus database over the past two decades (2002-2022), with a specific focus on the field of mental accounting. It analyses publication trends, influential countries, and notable journals. The United States leads with 102 articles, mainly single-country publications (85 SCPs and 17 MCPs), resulting in an MCP Ratio of 0.167. The "Journal of Economic Psychology" emerges as a prominent source, contributing 18 articles (4.6% of the total articles). Structural topic modelling results reveal five thematic clusters: Financial decision-making and investment biases; Consumer behaviour in purchases, spending, and payments; Consumption patterns and economic decisions; Accounting, taxation, and pricing effects; and Perceived value of mental accounting. The future research agenda for mental accounting research encompasses interdisciplinary approaches, innovative methodologies, and a strong focus on practical applications aimed at enhancing financial decision-making and overall financial well-being. These findings enhance understanding of key topics and keywords in mental accounting. These findings carry substantial significance for a diverse audience, including scholars, financial institutions, and professionals.

articleTitle: Predicting and Analysing University Dropout Rates using Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Data analysis provides constructive outcome to the student performance, allowing teachers and administrators to categorize areas of strength and areas for improvement. This helps them to develop targeted strategies for teaching, learning and growth. To ascertain the most effective technique for evaluating the learning environment and the elements that affect students' academic achievement, the prior studies have been reviewed. The data mining approaches presented in this work may be used to forecast student graduate performance, dropout, and discover relevant elements that may impact students' performance using regression models. Several of the strategies have demonstrated excellent accuracy in their results. Aside from this study, it may be known which methods are more suited and yield the most accuracy when assessing students' performance.

articleTitle: Intelligent IoT-Based Real-Time Water Quality Monitoring and Pollution Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Real-time systems based on internet of things (IoT) are becoming increasingly crucial in safeguarding the safety and integrity of our water supply by means of the continuous monitoring of water quality. These systems are designed to continuously measure and transmit data on numerous water quality parameters with the aid of sensors and advanced technologies. The monitored data is then transmitted to a central server for investigation, enabling the early detection of potential water contamination events.One effective method to address pH issues is the use of pH adjusting chemicals, such as acids or bases. By applying these chemicals, the pH level of the water can be brought to a more neutral range. This is especially important when the pH of the water falls outside the acceptable range for drinking or irrigation purposes.Similarly, high levels of turbidity, which indicate the presence of suspended particles in the water, can be mitigated through filtration or sedimentation techniques. These methods help to effectively remove the particles, improving the clarity and quality of the water.In addition to addressing specific water quality concerns, the utilization of sensors and other monitoring technologies enables the identification of contamination sources. This valuable information allows for the implementation of appropriate treatment strategies. It may involve employing chemical treatments, physical separation techniques, or other methods to eliminate or neutralize contaminants.Overall, the adoption of the aforesaid system for monitoring water quality significantly contributes to ensuring the safety of our water supply. By protecting public health and the environment, these systems play a vital role in maintaining the integrity of our water resources.

articleTitle: A Smart and Reliable Health Monitoring System for Covid-19 using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Health surveillance devices based on the Internet of Things might be of tremendous use during the current COVID-19 epidemic for patients who are afflicted with the virus. Internet of Things (IoT) health monitoring solutions lessen the need for patients and physicians to meet often. However, many people need to be monitored and observed by medical professionals on a regular basis. We have used technology in our suggested effort to simplify the process of diagnosing and treating patients as quickly as possible. Vital indications, such as a person's blood pressure, heart rate, oxygen levels, and body temperature, are being monitored by a state-of-the-art health monitoring model developed with the help of the Internet of Things. Clinics in outlying locations can share patient information with larger facilities, which is especially useful for those living in remote places like villages. Nevertheless, the IoT system will notify the doctor if there are any deviations from the normal numbers for the patient's condition. The technology yielded reliable findings when compared to other commercially accessible tools. It's possible that IoT-based solutions might save lives throughout the COVID-19 epidemic.

articleTitle: An Appliance of Energy Efficient Mechanism to Design Smart Systematic Street Light Controlling System using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In an era marked by rapid urbanization and the pursuit of energy-efficient solutions, the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies has emerged as a transformative approach to enhance public infrastructure. This study delves into the development and implementation of a cutting-edge Smart Street Light System that leverages Light Dependent Resistor (LDR) sensors and Passive Infrared (PIR) sensors. The system's core objective is to dynamically regulate street lighting based on real-time environmental conditions and the presence of vehicular or pedestrian traffic. LDR sensors monitor ambient light levels to ensure optimal energy utilization, while PIR sensors detect motion, thereby illuminating the path of passersby and vehicles. This system offers a cost-effective, eco-friendly, and technologically advanced solution to address the pressing issues of energy conservation and enhanced public safety. This study investigates the behavior of an LED lighting system in response to varying sensor values, specifically 245, 278, and 365, within the context of an environmental monitoring application. Notably, the analysis reveals a consistent LED activation time of 2.0 seconds for these higher sensor values, which signify the least sensitivity. The research explores the technical intricacies, benefits, and practical implications of this IoT-based Smart Street Light System, highlighting its potential to redefine urban lighting infrastructure in the context of modern smart cities.

articleTitle: A Novel Ensemble Deep Learning Framework for Breast Cancer Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Because of its high incidence and high mortality rate, breast cancer requires reliable means of early detection and diagnosis to improve survival rates for its patients. With advantages including increased accuracy and efficiency, deep learning (DL) and machine learning (ML) methods are quickly becoming indispensable in the fight against breast cancer. However, there is a need for additional study because existing approaches have scalability and performance constraints. Utilizing a pre-trained ResNet50V2 and ensemble-based ML approaches, we offer a hybrid approach to reliable breast cancer diagnosis in this study. Learning and extracting latent trends from complex breast-cancer(BC) images is made possible by DL's incorporation, with ML strategies contributing interpretability and generalizability. We performed wide experiments utilizing a openly accessible Invasive-Ductal-Carcinoma(IDC) dataset based on breast histopathology images of varying sample sizes. The resilience and great performance of our hybrid model are supported by the results of our extensive experiments. When compared to state-of-the-art models, our 95% accuracy rate, 94.5 precision, 94.2 recall, and 94.6 F1 score are all improvements. We also found that the best ML model to use with the ResNet50V2 architecture is the Light Boosting Classifier (LGB). This study's findings provide substantial contributions to the field of breast cancer diagnosis thanks to its novel approach, in-depth performance analysis, and trustworthy evaluation. In addition, it may help doctors make better decisions, provide better care, and boost results for people with breast cancer.

articleTitle: Military Aircraft Detection using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Aircraft detection presents numerous challenges in its various applications, including the need to handle diverse sizes, perspectives, and adverse weather conditions. A strategy to tackle these difficulties entails employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for accurate object classification, subsequently using Region-Based Convolutional Neural Networks (RCNNs) for localized region detection. In the context of remote sensing, a notable progress is achieved by integrating a saliency algorithm to optimize the process of object detection. This innovative technique reduces the number of proposed regions, resulting in a notably higher mean average precision (mAP) compared to the state-of-the-art Fast-RCNN model. A significant breakthrough in object detection comes from the You Only Look Once (YOLO) model, explicitly engineered for real-time object detection across images and videos. YOLO partitions the input data into a grid, scrutinizing each grid cell to identify the presence of objects. Within these cells, YOLO predicts class probabilities, enabling it to not only detect objects but also classify them. YOLO’s adaptability shines through its ability to handle objects of varying sizes and orientations using anchor boxes. These predefined shapes allow YOLO to adjust to an object’s actual characteristics, making it versatile across diverse scenarios. Following predictions, YOLO incorporates an essential post-processing stage called Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS), which serves to eliminate redundant or intersecting bounding boxes, leading to enhanced precision and more compact object detections. NMS refines the final set of object detections by eliminating duplicates and selecting boxes with the highest confidence scores.

articleTitle: Hybrid Content-Collaborative Filtering: Improving Collaborative Filtering and Neural Network-based Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Effective recommendation systems have become increasingly important in the current period, which is characterised by an exponential increase in the amount of content available. These systems are essential for guiding users through a sea of possibilities by providing recommendations that are tailored to their tastes. Given the vast volume of content on streaming services and internet databases, movie suggestions are especially important. A new era of precise and customised movie recommendations has arrived thanks to sophisticated algorithms that have arisen as a result of technological advancements.
