By contrasting them with conventional collaborative filtering techniques, this study examines the potential of deep learning techniques in the field of movie recommendation. While deep learning approaches are adept at recommendation jobs, collaborative filtering uses user-item interactions to make predictions from unstructured data. The purpose of the study is to determine whether collaborative filtering's limitations, particularly for new users and objects, can be overcome using deep learning. In order to determine whether deep learning may improve accuracy and circumvent problems associated with conventional approaches, the research probes the complex dynamics of deep learning in movie recommendations. It looks at how deep learning's capacity to find latent patterns can produce more precise and nuanced recommendations. The broad objectives of the research include a comparative performance analysis, an investigation of strengths and shortcomings, and useful insights for model construction.

articleTitle: Paddy Crop Pest Identification and Classification Techniques Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The presence of pests in crops has a significant negative influence on both the quality and the quantity. As a result, taking steps to control and prevent bug infestations is more crucial than ever. Early detection of pests can increase agricultural production, which is of utmost significance to farmers. Finding pests manually may take time and effort for farmers, particularly those who operate bigger farms. Therefore, it is crucial to develop pest identification system based on computer vision in order to reduce the damage due to pests through proper classification of the pests and targeted management strategies. This may be accomplished by targeting management techniques towards specific pests. Deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are capable of extracting features and learn complicated, high-level qualities for images categorization, they are being used to address this problem. This study aims to provide a comparative analysis of several deep-learning methodologies. The Inception V3 model has outstanding performance, with an accuracy of 93.64%. It is clear that resources for determining pests impacting the yield of paddy and assessing their effectiveness are accessible to everyone.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of Video Surveillance based Crime and Anomaly Detection System using Hybrid Deep Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the realm of urban safety and security, the development of efficient and accurate crime detection systems is of paramount importance. This study presents an empirical evaluation of a cutting-edge Video Surveillance-based Crime and Anomaly Detection System (CADS) that harnesses the power of Hybrid Deep Learning, integrating Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). CADS has been meticulously designed to detect and analyze criminal activities and abnormal behaviors in real-time video surveillance data. It employs a hybrid approach that combines the capabilities of ANN for feature extraction and pattern recognition with the temporal analysis prowess of RNN for identifying sequential anomalies. Through rigorous empirical evaluation, CADS demonstrates remarkable performance in urban crime detection scenarios. The system excels in detecting both overt and subtle criminal activities, providing valuable insights for enhanced safety measures. Notable achievements include the recognition of suspicious behaviors such as crowd contraflow, prolonged parking lot scouting, and even direct assaults. This research delves into the intricate workings of CADS, elucidating its design and implementation in Python on a Windows platform. The proposed model represents a significant advancement in the field of crime and anomaly detection when compared to existing models. In rigorous comparative evaluations, the proposed model has demonstrated its superiority by consistently outclassing all existing models, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 97.77%. By leveraging CADS, law enforcement agencies and urban security stakeholders can proactively respond to potential threats and anomalies, ultimately contributing to safer and more secure urban environments.

articleTitle: Ethical Considerations of AI Implementation in Business Planning: Ensuring Fairness and Transparency
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The advent of widespread AI in the field of corporate planning has sparked a revolutionary shift, ushering in previously unimaginable possibilities for efficacy and data-driven decision-making. This evolution, however, is not without of moral consequences. Our increasingly AI-powered environment has elevated the need of considering the ethical implications of AI application in company strategy. Incorporating sophisticated fairness criteria, bias reduction strategies, transparency evaluations, and legal framework compliance, this study examines the varied terrain of AI ethics.The research shows that achieving justice and openness in AI systems requires constant juggling, with model accuracy typically taking a backseat. Concerns about potentially unfair AI-driven conclusions are met with effective solutions for bias reduction, such as reweighing and resampling. Improving AI model interpretability by feature-level transparency evaluation using SHAP values. Also, AI has been shown to be ethically and legally compliant, as shown by its high compliance ratings with legislation like the General Data Protection Regulation and the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission’s requirements.These results provide useful insights for corporate executives, legislators, and the general public as they pertain to using AI in an ethical manner. The full potential of AI may be realized by enterprises while maintaining ethical standards if the correct balance is struck between fairness and openness, investment is made in bias prevention, and regulatory compliance is encouraged. In this study, we focus on how artificial intelligence might be reimagined from its current state as a potentially biased and opaque planning tool to one that drives ethical excellence in corporate strategy.This study acts as a catalyst for change by advocating for ethical and responsible AI deployment, which in turn creates a climate in which judgments influenced by AI are more fair, open, and lawful. These findings will serve as a springboard for other studies and activities that will push for more ethical AI development and use in company strategy.

articleTitle: A Novel Evaluation of Cryptocurrency Future Price Prediction to Manage Fluctuations in Market by using Hybrid Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In recognition of its optimistic vision on the probable future of cryptocurrencies, the value of cryptocurrency has risen dramatically during the previous eight decades. Cryptocurrency offers significant benefits over the established financial system, and investors have taken notice. Cryptocurrency is unique in that it facilitates decentralized financial services, making it immune to control by large financial institutions. With the rise of electronic currencies like Ethereum (ETH) and BTT, business may be conducted entirely online. One illustration of the distributed structure of physical currencies is the reality that all consumers who use virtual money have utilization of operations without the need for a third-party they can depend on. Like the market fluctuations of traditional stocks, cryptocurrencies fluctuations in price are extremely volatile and non stationary. Traders and academics alike have given increased focus to predictions of bitcoin prices due to the asset class' rising popularity. The use of deep learning in projecting the price of cryptocurrencies has become increasingly important. This research presented a new algorithm for predicting cryptocurrency prices called Hybrid Learning for Crypto Prediction (HLCP), and results from these models demonstrated that the proposed HLCP algorithm outperformed all other methods in this area. The HLCP model offered encouraging and precise predictions for all cryptocurrencies; hence it can be considered the most successful algorithm. The model was used to forecast the 6 month ending prices of cryptocurrency. To measure how well predictions match targets during training and testing, we used the HLCP correlation metric. The proposed method efficiency is evaluated with respect to the following metrics such as training and testing accuracy levels, training and testing loss ratio as well as different cryptocurrencies (ETH, BitCoin and BTT) prediction and actual price comparisons. These metrics clearly shows the efficiency of the proposed approach in clear manner over resulting section of this paper.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Dynamic Signal Switching: A Promising Solution to Traffic Congestion
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Today's growing urban population means increased revenue for individuals, translating into growing vehicles on the road. Nowadays, people use their private vehicles instead of public transportation, which results in a considerable number of personal vehicles that lead totraffic congestion everywhere. The ever-increasing number of vehicles and complex congestion leads to frequent traffic jams in major cities. In today's scenario, traditional traffic management methods have become redundant as the traffic volume has grown exponentially. The primary goal of this proposed work is to develop an algorithm that uses machine learning to control traffic effectively and ensure efficient traffic flow in the event of unforeseen events like accidents. The existing algorithm focuses on predicting shortterm traffic flow but ignores that traffic congestion may also occur due to accidents and emergencies. Our proposed model will consider all the above factors and use dynamic signal switching among lanes to predict the best and most efficient solution to reducing waiting time for vehicles and congestion on the road. To create an effective traffic flow management model with the least amount of road mayhem, our suggested model needs traffic data as input, which was then trained using various Machine Learning (ML) models.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Assistive Technology for Object Detection and Recognition for Visually Impaired Individuals
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Enhancing the independence and daily living activities of visually impaired individuals remains a significant challenge. This research proposes a novel approach that combines cutting-edge computer vision and haptic feedback technologies to address this pressing issue. This approach focuses on small environments, such as a study table, where independent mobility can significantly impact daily tasks. One notable distinction of this system lies in the real-time path planning and obstacle avoid ancecapabilities. This approach dynamically generates obstacle-free paths by continuously analyzing the user's hand movements, allowing users to reach their desired objects effortlessly. This real-time adaptation, combined with intuitive and effective communication, dramatically enhances the user's confidence during navigation. By targeting small environments, the proposed solution provides a tailored solution that optimizes the user's experience in confined spaces. This integration of state-of-the art computervision techniques and haptic feedback technologies offers a unique and holistic approach to independent mobility for visually impaired individuals.

articleTitle: A Systematic Analysis of Deep Learning Based Twitter Sentiment Analysis: Emerging Trends and Challenges
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sentiment analysis is a powerful area of research in the realm of natural-language-processing(NLP), with several practical applications. Businesses and governments can gain valuable insights from the immense amounts of user-generated data available through diverse social media platforms. However, it is now challenging to efficiently mine pertinent information from the available data. Readers, product vendors, and legislators all pay close attention to the opinions offered by internet users. Sentiment-analysis(SA) has received a lot of interest as a means of analyzing and organizing the unstructured data that comes through social media. Sentiment analysis is a method of text organization used to categorize the author's attitude or feelings as positive, negative, neutral, or otherwise. Deep learning models are useful because of their automated learning potential, this problem has been solved by combining sentiment analysis with deep-learning(DL). In this study, we undertake a thorough literature evaluation of DL strategies to document-based sentiment analysis, with the goal of extracting various features from social media content, namely from Twitter data. In addition, it offers a concise overview, evaluation, and improvement of deep learning's latest breakthroughs in the areas of sentiment analysis approaches and document applications. This paper investigates the difficulties that researchers have run into and other issues that may arise when attempting to analyze social media sentiment. It explains why and how SA is performed, what problems it solves, and what kinds of problems it solves. It also identifies significant difficulties with the datasets, text languages, investigation methods, and assessment measures, and compares the results of several investigations. This study aids the state of the art in SA and can guide practitioners toward the most useful approach.

articleTitle: Malware Analysis of Cryptojacks: Crackonosh and Winstar Nss Miner
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Malware analysis is an essential process for understanding the behaviour and purpose of a piece of malware. Cryptojacks are malware designed to exploit the computational resources of a machine to mine cryptocurrency. The year of 2017 saw the rise of Cryptocurrency which led to the rise of Cryptojacks. Despite being a very deadly piece of malware, Cryptojacks aren’t researched much because unlike other pieces of malware, they don’t cause any damage to the data or ask for any ransom. In 2018, with the end of Coin-hive project, browser based Cryptojacks disappeared but machine based Cryptojacks are still in the wild. In our work, we are analysing 2 Cryptojacks one taken from 2017 era (WinstarNssMiner) and another (Crackonosh) which was released recently(last week of June). We aim to find out how these Cryptojacks work and also about how they have changed over time. In turn, we can understand how the attitude of hackers has changed towards Cryptojacks.

articleTitle: Experimental Development of Learning based Consumer Behavior Recognition System using Artificial Intelligence Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this research, the Bagging-KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors) cla	ssifier was used to build a customer behavior identification system and test its efficacy. The study's goal is to develop a reliable method for identifying and categorizing various customer behaviors, which will provide useful information to companies and marketers. To achieve this, a dataset of consumer behavior patterns was preprocessed and transformed, and the Bagging-KNN ensemble technique was applied to enhance model performance. The study encompasses detailed experimental procedures, including feature engineering, model training, and validation using cross-validation methods. Results are presented in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, highlighting the system's capability to effectively classify consumer behaviors. The findings demonstrate the efficacy of the Bagging-KNN classifier for consumer behavior recognition, providing a valuable foundation for enhancing marketing strategies and customer engagement in various industries. The Proposed Model emerges as the leading performer after feature extraction, demonstrating outstanding accuracy at 0.98. This indicates its ability to accurately classify 98% of instances, underscoring its remarkable proficiency in this specific task.

articleTitle: Machine Learning with Neural Networks for Early Detection of Peripheral Neuropathy in Patients with Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A key difficulty in healthcare is the often-delayed diagnosis and incapacitating effects of peripheral neuropathy, a frequent complication of diabetes. In this research, We examine the viability of employing neural networks and machine learning for screening diabetes patients for peripheral neuropathy. Training, evaluating, hyperparameter tweaking, and ethical concerns are only some of the steps in the approach that follow data gathering, feature engineering, and the creation of a neural network architecture. To show that this method can work, we utilise hypothetical data. The findings show the possibility for precise early diagnosis, personalised therapy, and lower healthcare expenditures. Ethical concerns highlight the need of proper data handling. This study connects the dots between AI and healthcare, providing useful information for practitioners, academics, and policymakers. Patients would be more in control and have a better quality of life if this were to happen. Technological progress, real-time monitoring with wearable devices, patient-centric initiatives, multidisciplinary cooperation, cost-effectiveness, and policy ramifications are all things to keep in mind as we go forward. This study lays the groundwork for revolutionary improvements in diabetes care by opening the door to preventative measures and individualized treatment plans.

articleTitle: “H2OConnect”- An IoT enabled Smart Card and QR Code based Secure Water ATM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A survey highlights the alarming potential of 700 million people facing displacement due to severe water scarcity by 2030, while projections indicate that by 2040, one out of every four children globally will reside in regions characterized by severe water stress. The paper introduces the “Smart Water ATM,” an innovative solution that aims to revolutionize access to clean and safe drinking water, addressing fundamental human rights challenges. This multifaceted system integrates Radio-FrequencyIdentification (RFID) technology, Quick Response (QR) codes, Unified Payments Interface (UPI) payments, fingerprint-based security, a voice assistant, and an integrated water purification filter. The Smart Water ATM enhances accessibility and convenience by using RFID technology for user identification and monitoring water consumption. It promotes cashless transactions through QR code scans and UPI payments, ensuring compatibility with various financial platforms. Water quality is improved through the inclusion of an integrated water purification filter, mitigating health risks associated with contaminated sources. A fingerprint authentication system enhances security, ensuring only authorized users can access the water dispensing services. The paper provides a comprehensive technical overview of the Smart Water ATM system, including architecture, data flow, and synchronization mechanisms. It details the integration of above-mentioned technologies emphasizing their synergy in creating an efficient and secure water distribution solution. This integrated solution has the potential to significantly improve water access, distribution, and quality in both urban and rural settings. By offering secure digital payments and purified water, it addresses critical challenges in delivering safe drinking water, ultimately contributing to improved well-being for communities in need.

articleTitle: Product Mapping Using Deep Learning in Supermarkets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Our daily work is getting easier and more convenient with the development of Artificial Intelligence. AI is implemented which helps in conserving users’ time and energy. Generally, with drastic growth in technology focuses in brainstorming new concepts and implementation of those ideas. In supermarkets, to save time and effort of the customers, a cashier-less stress free environment is provided by applying the following idea used in this project. The product is identified by AI and the cart is automatized and managed completely by a computer. It can be implemented using Computer Vision and with some deep learning algorithms like YOLO algorithm.

articleTitle: A Novel System Design to Protect Children from the Borewells using Internet of Things and Effective Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Child rescue systems have gained paramount importance in addressing the harrowing incidents of children falling into borewells, which often lead to life-threatening situations. In this context, the integration of advanced technologies, including a Robotic Arm, OV5647 Camera, APC AP9512T Temperature Sensor, Oxygen Sensor, and Pulse Rate Sensor, offers an innovative and comprehensive approach to ensuring the safety and well-being of trapped children. The Robotic Arm serves as the primary mechanical component, designed to reach, secure, and lift the trapped child while preventing further falls. The OV5647 Camera provides real-time visual data, allowing operators to confirm the child's location and condition, enabling precise rescue operations. The APC AP9512T Temperature Sensor plays a pivotal role in environmental monitoring by detecting temperature changes within the borewell, effectively indicating the presence of a child. Additionally, the Oxygen Sensor continuously measures oxygen concentration levels, ensuring a safe breathing environment for the child during rescue operations. The Pulse Rate Sensor contributes to health monitoring by measuring the child's heart rate, ensuring minimal stress and safeguarding their overall well-being. This child rescue system offers a holistic approach, combining technological prowess with real-time data monitoring, safety measures, and health support. It presents a promising solution to mitigate the risks associated with borewell incidents and to provide timely, effective, and safe rescue operations, ultimately saving lives and protecting our most vulnerable members of society.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Clan Updated Grey Wolf Optimization (CU-GWO) based Deep Ensemble Technique for Identifying Sarcasm from Social Media Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sarcasm is often considered as a prevalent linguistic element in online content that conveys strongly held subjectivity and viewpoints. The detection of sarcasm is a significant consideration over the dominant NLP appliances as sentiment analysis, which is utilizing for advertising and opinion mining is a precious tool for figuring out the people sentiments and attitudes. The proposed approach describes automatic detection of sarcasm as an ease classification of text challenges. This paper aims to develop a sarcasm detection model that categorizes words into either sarcastic or non-sarcastic expressions. Initially, the text input involves processing, here the stop word removal and tokenization process are carried out. Subsequently, various features like information gain, chisquare, mutual information, and symmetrical uncertaintybased features are extracted from the preprocessed data. The curse of dimensionality is a crucial issue, thereby the selection of optimal features is conducted by employing hybrid optimization model called Clan Updated Grey Wolf Optimization (CU-GWO). The optimal features are utilized for sarcasm detection by using ensemble technique. The ensemble techniques involve the classifiers such as NN, SVM, RF and DCNN. The final output of DCNN indicates whether the sarcasm is present. The effectiveness of the proposed approach demonstrated through diverse metrices.

articleTitle: A Robust Digital Image Analyzing Methodology to Prevent Vehicle Theft based on Automatic Number Plate Recognition Principle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A sophisticated vehicle theft prevention system built on the foundation of the Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) principle. What sets this system apart is its incorporation of character recognition through the application of Genetic Algorithms, adding a layer of precision and reliability to the process. The primary objective of this system is to significantly bolster vehicle security by excelling at the task of accurately recognizing and validating license plate numbers.To achieve this, the system capitalizes on the ANPR technology, which allows it to capture and meticulously analyze license plate images. Once the images are acquired, the process of character recognition comes into play, and here's where the Genetic Algorithms come into their own. These algorithms are employed to decipher the characters present on the license plate, ensuring an impressive degree of accuracy in the identification process. It addresses the critical issue of vehicle security, and its emphasis on precision and reliability in license plate recognition sets it apart as a promising solution. Furthermore, it provides a glimpse of the system's edge detection capabilities, which play a pivotal role in identifying and highlighting the edges and boundaries of characters, obtained an accuracy of 96.14% performance rate and features on the license plate image, adding another layer of sophistication to the recognition process.

articleTitle: A Modified study on Genetic Algorithm in sensing orientations among the multi-directional Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Achieving maximum coverage of targets in a sensing network while minimizing the usage of directional sensors presents a formidable challenge. The rising popularity of pivoting directional sensors, capable of scanning signals from multiple angles, offers a promising solution to reduce sensor count while preserving or enhancing coverage quality. To address this challenge, we propose the development of a scheduling strategy that optimally leverages a limited set of directional sensors to cover a wide array of targets. By employing Genetic Algorithms and Average Differential Evolution algorithms (GADE), we successfully devised pragmatic layouts for directional sensors that are nearly optimal, along with identifying optimal routes for an array of detectors, facilitating efficient data collection. Through the implementation of GADE simulations, we conducted a comparative analysis against the traditional greedy approach. Our results reveal that the hybrid GADE approach consistently achieves a superior balance between the expanse of monitored areas and the operational sensors, outperforming greedy algorithms by a margin ranging from 44% to 8%. Notably, the simulation experiments underscore that the hybrid GADE method consistently generates more effective schedules and directions in contrast to the conventional greedy technique.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Battery Drain Prediction Using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) are generally regarded as a more environmentally beneficial means of transportation due to their low environmental effect and user-friendliness. Due to its high energy density and long lifespan, lithium-ion (Li-ion) cells are widely employed in battery-powered EVs. No matter how well a system is designed, it will eventually break down due to the effects of time and/or use. Li-ion batteries have a very high replacement cost if they fail. To ensure the safety and dependability of EVs for various uses, it will suffice to assess the current state of the batteries and provide an estimate of the remaining life. Inaccurate predictions were commonly made in the past due to the nonlinear decline in battery capacity with very modest fluctuation in the first few cycles. In this study, we introduce a reliable method for estimating lifespan that is based on artificial intelligence. To acquire this, gather the necessary information, scrub it of extraneous details, and then isolate the top eight traits. The AI models used here include artificial neural networks (ANNs) and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). Each model undergoes 15 training iterations. Models are compared based on their performance using the accuracy and loss functions. The CNN achieves a remarkable accuracy of 97.21 percent with a small mistake of 0.0913 percent.

articleTitle: Precision Farming Using Machine Learning and Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: India’s labor force and economy are highly dependent for agriculture, which accounts for 17% of the country's GDP and 50% of all jobs. The majority of farmers, however, continue to practice traditional farming practices and do not have access to modern machinery and technology. Farmers find it challenging to predict crops that will grow well in their fields because of the changing climate, which results in low yields, a reduction in food sources, and negative effects on their livelihoods. Several variables, including soil nitrogen (N), phosphorus (P), potassium (K), pH content, weather humidity, and rainfall, need to be considered, to predict the best crops to plant using computational tools. In order to do so, we used crop, soil, and weather datasets along with six machine learning algorithms (Naive Bayes, Decision Tree, Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, Random Forest, and XGBoost). We implemented the XGBoost algorithm in a web application using Flask, which has the highest accuracy of 99.31%. The application enables farmers to quickly access and input data to forecast the best crops for their fields.

articleTitle: Mapping the Research Landscape of Exchange Traded Funds using Machine Learning: A Topic Modelling Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study conducts a comprehensive survey of 964 journal articles indexed in Scopus database between 2003 and 2023, solely focused on Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs), employing bibliometric and structural topic modelling approaches. The application of structural topic modelling uncovers five prominent thematic clusters within the dataset: ETF as an investment vehicle, ETF as a trading opportunity, Volatility spillover with other assets, Liquidity, and ETF returns forecasting. The research provides a brief bibliometric assessment, offering insights into publication trends, leading countries, and prominent journals. This information is invaluable for researchers aiming to contribute to esteemed journals in this domain. The USA contributes 249 articles. The "Journal of Portfolio Management" stands out with 31 articles, reflecting its prominence. The study suggests future research avenues, including global influences, market volatility, behavioural insights, sustainable ETFs, and techno- logical integration. The findings have significant implications for academics, industry practitioners, regulators, and policymakers.

articleTitle: Early Diabetics Prognosis Prediction System Adhering to Data Science Utilization Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Early diabetic prognosis is carried out for the age group between 10 -30 years. To predict the diabetic in early stage we consider the following parameters like Cholesterol, BMI, Blood pressure, Blood glucose levels, Gender, Height, and Weight. On calculating the average values of the parameter, we use random forest algorithm to revert the classified data set with an accurate value for prediction. Since the human body can able to transform the intake of the food in the form of glucose which may affect the diabetic parameter value so the keen observation of the value of the diabetic’s parameter must be concentrated. The induction of machine algorithm uses the Uni-variant and Bi-variant variables for the processing of the data. Additionally, support vector classifier (SVC) is used for the unique classification of data set with respect to the diabetic parameters.

articleTitle: Detection of Colorectal Cancer from Histopathological Images Tissue Classification Using Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Colon cancer is still a major public health issue, and improving patient outcomes depends critically on early and precise diagnosis. In this work, we introduce classifying colon cancer tissue by utilizing deep learning and two cutting-edge convolutional neural networks (CNNs), VGG16 and MobileNetV2. Adipose (ADI), Background (BACK), Debris (DEB), Lymphocytes (LYM), Mucus (MUC), Smooth Muscle (MUS), Normal Colon Mucosa (NORM), Cancer-Associated Stroma (STR), and Colorectal Adenocarcinoma Epithelium (TUM) are the tissue types on which our research focuses.We can accurately detect and categorize various tissue types automatically by using deep learning models, such as VGG16 and MobileNetV2. Our findings suggest that deep learning methods, specifically VGG16 and MobileNetV2, hold significant promise for enhancing tissue categorization accuracy in colon cancer diagnosis. In VGG16, we obtained an accuracy of 95%, while in MobileNet-v2, we obtained 97% accuracy. Additionally, another CNN model gave 87% accuracy in classifying colon cancer tissue. The results show that deep learning models can lead to better patient outcomes by recognizing tissue classes more rapidly and accurately, which in turn can lead to better colon cancer diagnosis.

articleTitle: Design and Development of EEG Signal based Driver Activity Recognition and Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Drivers who drive commercial and personal vehicles report having a "very close to miss" owing to lack of energy, while one in five drivers confess to making a severe mistake because of drowsiness pursuant to a 2012-2013 survey by the National-Sleep-Foundation (NSF). This has been shown that drivers' mental exhaustion contributes to the occurrence of road accidents almost as much as their physical fatigue. Driving is a challenging activity that calls for one's undivided attention and a level head. An individual's ability to drive may be impaired if they are under stress or experiencing intense emotions. A system that constantly assesses the driver's well-being is always required. The brain signals of the drivers have been analyzed by researchers using electroencephalography (EEG). This study delves into the current state of the art of EEG assisted Driver surveillance System technology. The planned mechanism for tracking drivers has also been briefly described. Research have looked into brain waves across both brief and lengthy time periods to enable surveillance at varying frequencies. The suggested method achieves 97.2% accuracy in classification compared to an average human professional in a brief time frame, while requiring sophisticated computing. Additional standard warnings, including electrocardiography (ECG), fingers temperature, epidermal of the skin as well as breathing, are additionally assessed with EEG's reliability in constructing a system of this sort. The findings prove that the system makes decisions at regular one-minute intervals and can compensate for differences between users.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Based Human Age Detection from Face Image
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research focused on a qualitative approach while evaluating data collected from several secondary sources. This approach has helped to provide a clear understanding of the direction of this research from identification of research aspects to evaluation of gathered data. This research has found that "Pyramidal CNN" can provide better image classification capabilities when it comes to facial images. The research has also found that "OpenCV" can be beneficial in designing the algorithm for age detection from facial images.

articleTitle: Harnessing Machine Learning for Uterine Fibroid Detection Using Advanced Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the 40 to 50 age range, uterine fibroids are prevalent in over 70% of women. The proposed system employs a dataset comprising 1985 ultrasound images of uterus for fibroid detection. Utilizing advanced classification techniques like ResNet-152 and MobileNet V2, and an ensemble of Logistic Regression and MobileNet V2, the proposed system attained remarkable precision at 87.23% and an impressive accuracy of 91.67%. This outperformed the previous HIFU-Net Segmentation method’s precision of 84.48% on MRI scans, highlighting the potential of advanced techniques in medical diagnostics.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Different Intelligent Tutoring (ITS) Systems in various domain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Intelligent tutoring systems (ITS), which use technology to deliver individualized and flexible learning experiences, represent a paradigm change in the field of education. An overview of the theoretical underpinnings, efficacy, difficulties, and potential of ITS is given in this abstract. ITS utilizes constructivist ideas and scaffolding to lead learners toward a better understanding by drawing on cognitive psychology and learning theories. Studies showing better learning outcomes and engagement provide empirical proof of ITS’s usefulness. Personalization, which adjusts material and tempo to suit each learner’s requirements, is the defining characteristic of ITS. Affective factors are also taken into account, and training is modified in response to emotional cues.

articleTitle: Fake News Prediction in Hindi and English Robust Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The ever-growing consumption of information from digital platforms such as social media has paved the way for information dissemination like never before, but not necessarily all the information or news delivered to us is authentic or holds true to reality. A huge amount of information is created and shared by social media users, some of which are manipulative and have no influence on reality, and can cause harm in a variety of ways. Implementation of an automated or AI-based system to classify text articles as misinformation is a challenging task as identifying the truth is complicated. An AI-based fake news prediction system is proposed to classify fake news from real ones by understanding the context of news and making decisions accordingly. To identify fake news by examining the context of the news, a Bi-directional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) model, a pretrained model with a more potent feature extractor, has been implemented. BERT is well suited for tasks like predicting fake news because of its extensive contextualizing capabilities. The novelty of this paper is that the proposed system is trained, tested, and evaluated in 2 languages, English and Hindi to develop an overall reliable system to predict fake news in both languages. Two models of BERT namely DeBERTa and XLM-RoBERTa are chosen for the prediction of fake news. Further improvement in the model is achieved by using the additional news data to pre-train this model. Also, the model is fine-tuned to fit the requirements and to get the optimum result possible. The performance comparison of the chosen models is made and it is observed that the XLM-RoBERTa has improved accuracy over DeBERTa while testing for both languages.

articleTitle: Decentralized AI for Edge Devices with Federated Learning in the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As a result of the development of the Internet of Things (IoT), connectivity and applications that are driven by data have entered a new age. Decentralised artificial intelligence with federated learning has evolved as a game-changing concept in this environment, giving answers to urgent challenges like as data privacy, network latency, and resource optimisation. This ecosystem is characterised by constant change. In this research project, we investigate the fundamentals of decentralised artificial intelligence and its consequences for edge devices in IoT networks. The research presented in this paper demonstrates, via a series of tests, that it is possible to strike an appropriate balance between data privacy and model performance by combining decentralised AI with federated learning. The research results provide system designers with helpful information by drawing attention to the trade-offs that exist between the number of devices, the number of communication cycles, and the level of privacy that is afforded. With the help of decentralised artificial intelligence, businesses are able to take advantage of the opportunities presented by the Internet of Things (IoT) without sacrificing the confidentiality of their data or the responsiveness of their real-time applications. This paper provides a cornerstone reference, setting the way for further research that may improve privacy approaches, expand to larger IoT networks, and identify fresh uses for decentralised AI in the dynamic environment of the Internet of Things (IoT).

articleTitle: Experimental Analysis for Non-Alcoholic Fatty Liver Disease in Ultrasound Images Based on Efficient Net Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Liver dysfunction is most commonly brought on by fatty liver disease, which is widespread in both developed and developing countries. If not addressed, fatty liver might lead to serious complications. As juvenile obesity rates rise, so does the number of children diagnosed with nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD). In order to distinguish nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) from healthy liver tissue, we wanted to perform digital image analysis (DIA) on ultrasound (US) pictures of the liver and create a machine learning (ML) based categorization model. This study compares EfficientNet Classifier and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) for its ability to detect the presence of nonalcoholic fatty liver disease in ultrasound images. The histological outcome of a liver biopsy may have been consulted as a reference for liver fat, as well as ultrasound scans of persons who went through laparoscopic surgery were additionally utilized as a reference for liver fat. EfficientNet Classifier and K-Nearest Neighbors were then used to classify the photos into one of two categories. For EfficientNet categorization, an artificial model for predicting liver fat from ultrasound images achieved an accuracy of 87%. However, when using K-Nearest Neighbors for categorization, 85% accuracies were achieved. Automatic detection of liver fat utilizing the suggested technique based on textural characteristics utilizing the GLCM and the EfficientNet categorization from ultrasound pictures can aid physicians and radiologists in making a definitive diagnosis.

articleTitle: An Efficient Classification of Cassava Leaf Disease using VGG 16
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cassava is an essential food item in the tropics, it may origin enormous productivity decreases in cassava, leading to significant financial losses and a shortage of basic foods. Small-scale farmers grow the essential food and nutrition crop cassava because it can withstand harsh conditions. In many African nations, it provides a substantial source of carbohydrates. Leaf infections can occasionally harm cassava crops, limiting total productivity and farmers' income. In this study, Pre trained models are utilized for the determination of disease identification and classification on plant leaf issues. VGG 16 has been put into use, and its performance has been examined. An exploratory study is carried out using an online Cassava image collection, which contains pictures of Cassava leaves afflicted with five different disease categories. The vgg16 classifier that was suggested surpasses its competitors greatly and achieves an accuracy of 97.58%. The results of the test demonstrate that improving classification performance by using a database of images that is well balanced is possible.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis between Conventional AVR and Fuzzy Logic Controller Based Excitation Controller of Synchronous Genrator
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The main objective of the excitation system is to enhance the dynamic stability of the system. The issue of power system dynamic stability has garnered significant interest in recent decades due to two primary factors: the escalating scale of generating units and the adoption of high-speed excitation devices. The impact of high-speed excitation on dynamic stability manifests as the introduction of negative damping into the system, resulting in oscillations characterized by diminished damping. Transient instability and subsequent machine oscillation have been noticed in certain circumstances due to the implementation of this excitation mechanism. The design of the excitation system should also be capable of meeting the requirements of various operating situations. Considerable attention has been directed into investigating the impact of excitation control on the damping characteristics of these oscillations. The concepts of linear system theory are used to develop the excitation controller for a synchronous generator. Therefore, the utilization of a linear controller, such as an automated voltage regulator (AVR), can effectively contribute to the provision of required damping via excitation control. This ensures stability in the system after experiencing a minor disturbance. This study presents the development of a standard automated voltage regulator (AVR) and a fuzzy logic-based excitation controller, with the aim of enhancing the attributes of the AVR. The utilization of MATLAB/SIMULINK software is employed for the purpose of evaluating the efficacy of controllers.

articleTitle: A Novel Framework for an Intelligent Transportation and Emergency System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Many accidents and emergencies occur on the road. On the other hand, accidents cause health issues, infrastructure damage, poor circulation, and hundreds of thousands of fatalities due to a lack of timely treatment. As a result, we must establish an effective and intelligent emergency system to ensure that an ambulance arrives promptly at the scene of an accident to provide medical assistance to injured individuals. Other organisations, such as hospitals, must also be contacted immediately in order to make the necessary preparations ... provide immediate medical information to emergency personnel on the scene, including contacting anyone who may have been involved in the accident(s). This article provides a description of a cognitive process. The protocol uses Intelligent Transportation System (ITS) scenarios that combine connected and autonomous vehicles to provide prompt emergency assistance and reduce the mortality rate. In addition, for time-sensitive operations, our protocol reduces the amount of network-wide message broadcasting. In comparison to contemporary methods, the performance analysis yielded outstanding results.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Based Autonomous Vehicle for Making Real-Time Decisions, and Navigating Safely
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The integration of Manufactured Insights (AI) into independent vehicles has revolutionized the transportation industry by empowering vehicles to explore complex situations with increased accuracy and security. This paper proposes an imaginative approach to real-time decision-making and a secure route utilizing the A* calculation in conjunction with Concurrent Localization and Mapping (Pummel). By combining these two methods, the proposed framework points to improving the vehicle’s capacity to explore powerfully changing situations while precisely mapping its environment. The A* calculation serves as the spine for proficient pathfinding by utilizing a heuristic look approach, guaranteeing the vehicle can select the foremost ideal course to its goal. This calculation powerfully alters its course arranging based on real-time information, empowering the vehicle to adjust quickly to unforeseen obstacles or changes within the environment. Furthermore, the incorporation of Hammer innovation encourages the concurrent mapping of the vehicle’s environment and self-localization inside the mapped environment. This permits the vehicle to construct and upgrade an exact outline of its environment in real-time, upgrading its spatial mindfulness and encouraging educated decision-making en route. Moreover, AI-driven decision-making preparation is improved through the integration of machine learning models trained on broad datasets, empowering the vehicle to create complex choices in real-time based on different natural components and verifiable information. The system’s brilliant decision-making capabilities guarantee the vehicle can proactively react to potential dangers, barricades, and energetic activity conditions, in this manner prioritizing security while optimizing route proficiency. Through comprehensive recreations and real-world testing, our proposed AI-based independent vehicle framework illustrates remarkable performance in exploring complex and energetic situations, displaying its potential to revolutionize long-term transportation by altogether upgrading security, proficiency, and in general driving encounters. The comes about of our tests approve the adequacy and unwavering quality of the coordinates A* calculation and Pummel in empowering real-time decision-making and secure routes for independent vehicles.

articleTitle: Link Prediction of biomedical data using Hetrosim GCN-GAT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: With the emergence of large number of Electronic Medical Records (EMRs), the researchers turned their attention towards the prediction, recommendation systems with these available data. This paper deals with the input of the patient details and the drugs administered to them for the different health conditions. The Drug to Drug Interaction (DDI) prediction is essential in order to avoid the unintended adverse reactions and making the drugs less effective. It is represented in the form of graphs with nodes and edges/links. Link prediction is often used to detect the existence of link or edges present in between the specified nodes. Graph Neural Network based algorithm HetrosimGCN-GAT is proposed to address the underlying link prediction tasks. A heterogeneous network is initially built using the drug-drug, protein-protein similarity matrices and drug protein matrices. The embedded representation of the drug and protein is then obtained using the graph convolutional neural network (GCN). Graph attention mechanism provides a weighting factor for every connect in order to assess the significance or highlight the contribution of distinct neighbourhood nodes to the central node. The unknown DDI and Drug Protein Interaction is predicted by applying the inner product decoder. The performance of HetrosimGCN-GAT is evaluated against the baseline methods and its outperforms the baseline methods.

articleTitle: A Novel and Robust Fatty Liver Recognition Method Based on Hybrid Generative Adversarial Networks on Ultrasound Images
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The liver is the biggest gland in the body and is responsible for a wide variety of processes. The digestive system breaks down the food and liquids a person consumes so that the body can use them. It also aids in the fight against diseases by filtering out dangerous elements from the blood. Liver damage can be caused by exposure to viruses or harmful substances. The focus of this research will concentrate on developing methods to forecast the onset of the illness using machine learning (ML) algorithms. In this study, we introduce an information enhancement strategy for generating synthetic medical pictures with Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs). In order to increase the size and variety of the training set, we offer a training scheme that employs both traditional data augmentation and GAN approaches for synthetic data augmentation. In this article, we used many different types of deep neural network architecture to forecast the likelihood of developing liver illness. The most precise deep neural network framework was used to forecast the ultimate result. Our GAN model is so exact that it can accurately forecast the onset of liver disease. The best model for making the prediction, to determine if a person has liver disease, is then used by the system. Accuracy, precision, recall, F-measure, as well as area under the curve (AUC) were used to compare and contrast the suggested model with the existing model SegNet, both of which were developed to foretell the incidence of liver disease. The results of the study demonstrated that the suggested model evaluated better than the SegNet models in all metrics, including accuracy (96%), recall (93%), precision (95%), and specificity (96%). We further demonstrate that the combined use of synthetic pictures and real-world augmented data may considerably boost the effectiveness of GAN networks for the categorization of Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease (NAFLD).

articleTitle: Detection of Malicious Messages from Mobile Computing Devices Using NLP and Slack Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: SMS has emerged as one of the most essential ways of communication in the present-day world, when digitalization increasingly widespread. Despite various chatting-based messaging systems like Facebook, WhatsApp, etc., SMS doesn't demand an active connection to the internet. Criminals and spammers frequently attempt to access mobile computer systems. As a result, hackers are attempting to join the system by delivering a harmful link, making text messages assistance for handheld devices vulnerable; by visiting those hyperlinks, attackers can take control of the mobile computing device remotely. Therefore, in order to identify such communications, built a system that can determine if a message is SPAM or HAM (malicious or not harmful) as well as whether it is malicious. Utilising natural language processing, the system operates. The modal is used to provide a web-based user interface and Slack Integration.

articleTitle: Efficient Multiple UAV Positioning and Resource Allocation in Intelligent Wireless Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Intelligent Wireless Network (IWN) is a trending technology and it is used in maximum of intelligent communication in order to improve its performance Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) is incorporated with the IWS network. In recent times UAVs handles certain drawbacks like and predictable mobility in the random topology. In order to overcome this drawback’s in this article Efficient Multiple UAV Positioning and Resource Allocation (EMURA) is developed. The core idea of this process is the creation of effective system model, channel model, queue based resource allocation and effective multi UAV positioning process. Through this processes an effective communication can be attained by the reduction of delay and power utilization among the devices. The model is implemented using ns2, and the study focuses on calculating the end-to-end delay and as well the vehicles energy consumption characteristics. From results it is proven that the proposed EMURA attains lower delay and energy consumption which leads to improve the communication quality of the proposed EMURA.

Author Keywords: Efficient Multiple UAV Positioning and Resource Allocation

articleTitle: IoT Assisted Fisherman Aid to Detect Borders and Alert System by using Intelligent GPS Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The safety of fisherman will be improved with the use of technology such as the Global Positioning System (GPS) and Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN), which will be employed in this project. The GPS may be used to track exactly where the boat is at any given time. In the event that the fisherman ventures outside of the permitted region, the alarm will sound. The user or owner of the vessel is able to monitor the location of the vessel in reference to known dimensions (latitude and longitude) by making use of the vessel's own electrical equipment and software that has been specifically created for this purpose. If a person has a GPS receiver, they will be able to pinpoint their exact location on a digital map. The relay circuit on the boat will give it the ability to turn around. Technology based on wireless sensor networks might be used to transmit communication between the fisherman and the Internet of Things device. The fishermen are alerted when they get close to the first two borders by a loudspeaker (which acts as a siren) and an indicator that has an LCD. In the event that the warning system is unsuccessful, there is a backup option. The boat's engine will automatically turn off when it gets closer to the third border as it travels. Now, both the government of India and the government of Sri Lanka would have access to identical data on the fishermen.

articleTitle: Assistance for Healthcare Professionals using Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Bedridden and paralyzed individuals need to be continuously taken care of since they find it difficult to convey their requirements due to loss of movement management in their brain. This results in communication disabilities. The proposed system aims to reduce the burden on healthcare providers with a computer-aided system that interprets the hand gestures shown by the patient and displays the needs of the patient on a monitor. Hand gesture recognition involves three processes namely: hand detection, finger detection, and gesture detection. Firstly, Hand gestures are captured by a webcam and are recognized by a Deep learning model called Computational Neural Networks (CNN), followed by background subtraction, image recognition, and image processing. CNN is used as it provides accurate and efficient output. The output/need is displayed by connecting the webcams to any desk for the ease of healthcare providers.

articleTitle: Prediction of Hypertensive Disorders in Pregnancy using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Objective: The primary objective of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of the HDP gestosis score by adopting Machine Learning Algorithms (MLA) to predict preeclampsia. Methods: The information was gathered retrospectively by reviewing the patient’s records. The HDP Gestosis Score predictors were evaluated for their ability to predict preeclampsia. The following machine learning models were utilized in this study: XG Boost classifier, Naive Bayes classifier, Support Vector Machine (SVM), RF classifier, and Decision Tree to evaluate the predictive efficiency of the HDP factors in predicting hypertensive diseases during pregnancy. Results: Approximately 55% of women were assessed as being at high risk for preeclampsia, 17% at low risk, and the rest at moderate risk. Compared to other models, Naive Bayes (NB) and Random forest classifier performed better for prediction of women at risk for preeclampsia. The precision and accuracy of NB were 0.97 and 0.96, respectively, with an AUC of 0.96. The precision and specificity of RF were 0.88 and 1.0; correspondingly, with an AUC of 0.82, both models demonstrated greater under the ROC curve values. Conclusion: Gestosis score and the MLA are effective models for predicting preeclampsia.

articleTitle: A Novel Methodology Design to Predict Employee Attrition by Using Hybrid Learning Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Numerous businesses often hire new and different personnel and companies invest both time and money into training these reps, and they also provide training for current employees. The goal of such initiatives is to increase the economic security of their staff. Human resource analysis is a subfield of business analytics that aims to boost productivity and profitability by using explanation-based methods to an organization's human resource development (HRD).Human resources evaluation is more than just keeping track of how much information can be gathered on how effective a delegate is. Or, it seeks to shed light on every approach by drawing on cultural and sociological facts, with the goal of making informed choices regarding how to enhance existing methods. The term "Weakening in HR" refers to a gradual decline in a company's human resources department. We will try to disentangle factors that cause less correlation and false prediction by include details including their ages, worker position, average pay, satisfaction with work, decades in firm, duration of present position and so on in the set of data utilized as features. The cost to an organization of staff turnover is a serious issue. Some of the usual expenses of shedding specialists and compensating them include advertising open positions, going through the enlistment process, and relocating to a new location and training zone. To find out is our mission. What causes employee turnover, what variables contribute to it and how does attrition effect businesses? In this lesson, we'll learn how to segment inspections for better preventative care and upkeep. In this study, we provide Hybrid Learning based Employee Attrition Prediction (HLEAP), a novel method for accurately predicting employee turnover. The results of this work compares the suggested method to more traditional learning algorithms like RNN and ANN, providing convincing evidence for the efficacy of the former.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of power management circuits for low-power VLSI systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study delves into the topic of low-power VLSI system power management circuit design and optimization. The purpose of this research is to learn what influences VLSI circuits' power consumption and how to minimize that effect in low-power VLSI designs. Using multiple linear regression analysis, this research determines that capacitance, frequency, voltage and temperature are all important predictors of power usage in VLSI circuits. The study's findings may be utilized to guide the creation of novel power management strategies and technologies, with significant implications for the design and optimization of power management circuits in low-power VLSI systems. New materials and technologies for VLSI systems, as well as improved power management strategies, are only two examples of where the report proposes future research should go. This study's findings have significant significance for a broad variety of applications, including embedded systems, mobile devices and IoT gadgets, since they provide light on the design and optimization of power management circuits for low-power VLSI systems.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Advanced Machine Learning Techniques in Health Care Domain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Diabetes Mellitus, is a widespread endocrine illness that affects the entire world today. This is a necessity for an effective model that can predict diabetes and its variants with greater accuracy as early as possible. For increasing the accurateness of prediction with best effectiveness innovative ML Model is proposed. This survey aims to learn about and analyze the operation and performance of different Machine Learning techniques. This survey examines the possible applications of machine learning in the healthcare field. It works with new technologies such as social media platforms for predicting human predilections; in the field of medicine for predicting disease and so on. There are many techniques in data mining each model with its own level of accuracy. However, there is no model which can be said to be flawless as the performance of a model depends greatly on the datasets used. Here in these studies some of the classification algorithms have been deeply discussed. The main aim of this study is to deeply understand and analyze the working of some of the ML algorithms.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Exploration and Visualization of Diverse fields of Startup in India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The objective of this research is to analyze and comprehend the trends in the startup culture of India. Startup insights refer to the knowledge and understanding gleaned from the analysis and visualization of various startup venture information. Startup insights can assist entrepreneurs, investors, and other stakeholders in the startup ecosystem to better understand the factors that come up while building a new business, and to make informed decisions regarding strategy, resource allocation, and risk management. The research involved collection and analysis of data on numerous startup companies. Descriptive statistics were used to explain trends and patterns in the data such as, which sectors are attracting the most startups, which locations are seeing the most startup activity, how many number of startups that have been established yearly and so on.

articleTitle: Low-Power Variable-Gain CMOS Trans Impedance Amplifier for Near Infra-Red Spectroscopy Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A novel low-power and variable gain CMOS Trans Impedance Amplifier (LP-VG-TIA) circuit design for Near Infra-Red Spectroscopy (NIRS) Applications is presented in this paper. The proposed low power and variable gain CMOS Trans Impedance Amplifier achieves a variable gain from 55.06 dBΩ to 119.81 dBΩ with a minimum bandwidth of 12.46 MHz and a maximum bandwidth of 25.33 MHz. The variable gain control is used to achieve different values of the gain and the bandwidth for multiple bio-medical sensor applications. The input-referred noise with photodiode (PD) model with 1pF capacitance is 1.6pA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rms</inf>. The maximum input photocurrent is 1uA<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p-p</inf>. The proposed LP-VG-TIA consumes 95.3 µW at a room temperature of 27 °C from a 1V power supply. The proposed circuit has been implemented using a GPDK 45nm CMOS process. The proposed low power and variable gain TIA outperforms the existing TIAs in the literature.

articleTitle: Securing data in Wireless Sensor Network using Hybrid ECC + AES Cryptographic Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research work unveils a groundbreaking cryptographic strategy designed to bolster the security of wireless sensor networks (WSNs). By harnessing the combined strengths of Elliptic Curve Cryptography (ECC) and Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), this study introduces a novel hybrid approach, denoted as ECC + AES cryptographic system. The primary objective of this system is to fortify the security of data transmission within WSNs. Crafted with a keen understanding of the challenges presented by resource-constrained environments such as WSNs, the ECC + AES solution demonstrates a remarkable capability to ensure data protection. The research's innovative outcomes address the inherent vulnerabilities that characterize WSNs, offering a robust and resilient approach to safeguarding sensitive data. The amalgamation of ECC and AES not only fortifies data security but also does so with minimal impact on resource allocation, effectively minimizing both memory usage and energy consumption. In doing so, the study bridges the gap between security and efficiency, presenting a cryptographic framework that is not only robust but also tailored to the practical demands of WSNs.
