This investigation contributes to the developing body of information on AI-based client behavioral investigation, emphasizing the significance of K-means in encouraging data-driven decision-making and cultivating a customer-centric approach inside businesses. By tackling the control of AI-driven client behavioral investigation, companies can remain ahead of the competition, construct enduring client connections, and accomplish economic development in today’s energetic and competitive commerce scene.

articleTitle: Mobile Ad Hoc Networks Supporting Adaptive Threat Detection through Intrusion Detection Effective Use of Machine Learning for Cyber Defense
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Due to the ever-changing nature of MANETs, novel methods of adaptive threat identification are required to ensure user safety. In this study, we investigate how machine learning may be used to improve MANET intrusion detection. To this end, we use a wide variety of machine learning models, such as Multilayer Perceptron (MLP) Neural Networks, Support Vector Machines (SVM), and Random Forests, and compare how well they can spot harmful activity in network data. The findings illustrate the advantages of the MLP Neural Network, giving heightened accuracy and flexibility. In addition, we develop a reinforcement learning-inspired adaptive learning technique to improve real-time intrusion detection by allowing the model to quickly adjust to changing network circumstances. Our results pave the way for future cross-domain applications and have far-reaching consequences for MANET network security. This study contributes to a more secure cyberspace by outlining the next steps for more adaptive and resilient protection of vital infrastructure, military networks, and emergency response networks.

articleTitle: A Logical Air Quality Monitoring System using Arduino and Smart Sensors Association
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Pollution of the air is a major problem all around the globe now-a-days. Human activities and natural processes are both potential causes of air pollution. Particles and gases in the atmosphere that is harmful to human health. It affects the majority of big cities in both developing and developed countries. That's why it's so important to have a system for constant monitoring of pollution and air quality. Using a simple, low-cost sensor and an Arduino microcontroller, we were able to create an air pollution detector. The detector's benefits are its dependability, stability, quick reaction recovery, and longevity. This hardware is suitable for portable measurement and understandable data collecting; it is inexpensive, user-friendly, low-cost, and requires minimal power. It features processing software that can precisely analyze the data it has acquired. Easy air quality monitoring is made possible by straightforward equipment with practical applications in industry. This setup makes use of a number of different parts, including an Arduino Uno and a MQ135 gas sensor. When compared to its competitors, Arduino offers superior speed and compatibility. The MQ135 gas detection device is able to properly measure the amount of dangerous gases in the atmosphere and display the results in Parts Per Million (PPM).

articleTitle: Blind Hurdle Stick: Android Integrated Voice-based Intimation Via GPS with Panic Alert System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: There are currently many blind assistive systems in use around the world, but none that are designed specifically to guide the visually impaired and keep tabs on their every move in case of an emergency or to locate them as part of a group that has become disoriented. In this study, we introduce a voice-based, GPS/GSM cooperative blind stick with an integrated emergency alarm system for navigating obstacles. A pair of glasses that are connected to an Android app can guide the visually impaired through the system. The programme generates voice instructions in either Hindi, Kannada, or English based on the location of obstacles, allowing the blind person to move freely throughout their surroundings. In addition, a panic button or voice commands make it possible for a blind person to send an SMS to a predetermined number without ever having to physically touch the phone. The blind-assistive app uses GPS and GSM to determine location, then transmits that information to a server. By using yet another android software that indicates the user's present location on Google Map, a blind person's every step may be tracked and watched. The system's primary goal is to give the visually impaired with an efficient and straightforward navigational tool that contributes to artificial vision by illuminating the dynamic and static items in their immediate surroundings.

articleTitle: Data Analytics Using Machine Learning For Cyber Security Safeguards Individual Privacy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The merging of data analytics and machine learning offers tremendous potential for boosting cyber security and protecting individual privacy in an age when personal data and cyber dangers are abundant. The purpose of this study was to create, test, and publish a model that takes into account this junction. Accuracy, precision, recall, F1-Score, and area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) are only a few of the indicators that show how well the framework can identify cyber threats. Further, the use of privacy-preserving methods like differential privacy highlights the moral need to guard sensitive information. Readers are given a concrete knowledge of the framework's real-world effect via vivid depictions of its practical use based on hypothetical data sets. This study serves as a helpful resource for a varied audience, from consumers worried about data privacy to organisations looking to better their cyber security defenses and legislators aiming to safeguard citizens' data. It also provides a springboard for further study in areas such as privacy enhancement, more sophisticated machine learning models, and sector-specific framework development. The digital ecosystem is always changing, but this study provides a guide for overcoming obstacles and capitalizing on possibilities at the intersection of cyber security and personal privacy.

articleTitle: Hybrid Genetic Algorithm with a New Fitness Measure of Clusters for Training Special Children
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Clustering is one of the most interesting and popular areas of data mining, which is gaining more and more interest from researchers. There has already been a lot of research, and as a result, many clustering algorithms have been made. K-means is the most common, simple, and well-known way to group numerical data into groups. But it has been changed over time so that it can also handle categorical data. People have noticed that there haven’t been many works done on categorical data clustering so far. This is likely because of how hard it is to work with them. When genetic algorithms are used in the field of clustering, they improve the quality of the clustering results, making them almost as good as the global best instead of just the local best. Taking these things into account, we chose chapter 4’s work area to include categorical data clustering and genetic algorithms. As the results, implemented the approach which described using the similarity measure and a consistent manner of encoding an item and a cluster representative as a fuzzy set and a new fitness measure has been developed that finds the most fit or fittest chromosome among all generations by measuring the fitness of each chromosome (clustering solution) belonging to a generation of population.

articleTitle: Sentimental Analysis for Social Media Platform Based on Trend Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Social media platform is one of the most preferable domains of the people of the society where people are primarily using it for the communication, digital marketing, exploring things, gaining knowledge and in some occasions, it stands as the means of taking decisions based on the information gained from it. The abundant information or data on the platform may strive towards right in certain scenarios but it stands as a faulty either in one or in many situations. Sentimental analysis is a difficult task due to the rise of informal and noisy data. There has been a wide and powerful word embedding techniques with large dataset of various categorized word embedding. In this paper we are trying to implement sentiment analysis on the data gained from any social media platform for example consider twitter whereas tweets are raised based on the specific event or topic we are trying to perform sentimental analysis on that data and we are giving the conclusion either as positive or negative based on the data which exists its updates as long as the specific topic is being discussed among the people .The trend favorability is the new feature we are implementing in this paper.

articleTitle: A Smart Blood Donor Locator and Component Matching System for Rapid Disaster Response
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Crucial part of life is surviving without any Health dangerous incidents but we cannot negotiate completely. Every human has shortage of blood during serious issues such as organ transplant, Bleeding disorder, medical conditions, road accidents, etc. Which can be cured by a blood donation? So, Blood donations are aside but blood transfusion is mostly for cancer treatment, Anemia and blood infections, etc. In order to help people to find a suitable blood that is rich in particular component we use cloud computing to find blood donors for blood transfusion. The approach involves building a cloud-based application that connects blood donors with patients in need of blood transfusions. Donor information such as blood type, blood components count, donor’s live location, and availability to donate blood is collected and stored in a cloud-based database. The application then searches the database for donors with a matching blood type who are located nearby right now and available to donate when a patient requires a blood transfusion. The process is monitored to ensure the safe collection and transportation of donated blood. Using cloud computing provides benefits such as scalability, accessibility, and security to connect donors with patients and improve the blood donation process. Additionally, we integrate all blood banks, hospitals, and labs into one system unit for communication if any blood packets run out of limits. Also providing certified donor’s live location can help people contact easily.

articleTitle: Computer vision-based Deep Learning for Comprehensive Skin Cancer Detection: Precise Diagnosis and Early Intervention in Dermatology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Early identification is essential for successful treatment and patient survival for skin cancer, a critical issue. However, accurate skin image analysis for cancer is difficult due to class imbalance, inconsistent picture quality, and small datasets. To aid in early detection and treatment, the primary objective of our work is to create a reliable system that is capable of accurate classification & detection of skin cancer from photographs. Due to the similarity of various skin cancer colors, dermatologists have difficulty in detecting the disease. Identifying lesions, which are the source of skin cancer, is required for providing complete patient care. Access to a big picture collection with dangerous lesions and benign lesions that have undergone histopathology has been made easier with the inclusion of tools powered by various deep learning approaches. This study conducts a comparative assessment of six different transfer learning networks for multi-class skin cancer classification, leveraging the HAM10000 dataset. To mitigate dataset class imbalances, we employ image replication for underrepresented classes. The transfer learning networks under evaluation include Baseline CNN, ResNet50, and InceptionV3. The outcomes reveal the effectiveness of replication, as it yields high classification accuracies and F-measures while minimizing false negatives, emphasizing its suitability for this task. The security and privacy of patient data are guaranteed by strong encryption and data anonymization methods. Our approach compiles with current medical guidelines thanks to close collaboration with dermatologists for clinical validation. We are committed to ensuring that the system is accessible worldwide, thus we have translated it into several languages and adjusted it to work with various healthcare infrastructures. Our system’s capacity for continual learning, which considers the changing subtypes and therapies for skin cancer, emphasizes how dynamic and forward-thinking it is in the fight against this illness. Compared to all the models that we have built InceptionV3 has obtained high accuracy of 88.6%.

articleTitle: Intelligent Irrigation Management: An IoT-Driven Approach with Real-Time Data Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In the ever-evolving landscape of agriculture, the need for precision and efficiency has never been more critical. This paper introduces a cutting-edge irrigation management system that leverages the power of the Internet of Things (IoT) and real-time data integration. Instead of traditional irrigation methods, this system adapts irrigation practices dynamically based on soil moisture and plant growth stages. Through a seamless synergy of wireless IoT sensors and web applications, this solution provides farmers with a robust platform to remotely monitor and control irrigation processes. Soil moisture data is collected and analyzed in real-time, ensuring that water is delivered precisely when and where it's needed. Beyond soil data, this system integrates external sources of information, including real-time weather data encompassing rainfall probability, temperature, and wind speed. This data fusion empowers farmers to make informed decisions and fine-tune their irrigation strategies from anywhere, at any time. The project's scalability is a hallmark, capable of serving the needs of small-scale farms as well as extensive agricultural operations, and adaptable to a wide variety of crops. By embracing technology, this IoT-driven irrigation management system represents a significant stride towards sustainable and efficient agriculture, promising not only resource conservation but also increased crop health and resilience.

articleTitle: Strategic Integration of CNN, SVM, and XGBoost for Early-stage Tumor Detection using Hybrid Deep Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A tumor is an unnatural cell development that can develop into cancer. Most often, cancer affects the brain, kidneys, lungs, liver, and other organs of the body. MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) scans are the official method for locating tumors. Detecting a tumor in its early stages and using the resulting image to spot aberrant tissue growth allows for early cancer treatment. Early detection of tumors plays a pivotal role in improving the prognosis and overall survival rates of patients. A Hybrid Model was constructed which composed of a self-defined Convolution Neural Network (CNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), and Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) is applied in detecting the presence of tumors and their performance is analyzed and the Proposed system detects the Tumor in the beginning stage with the accuracy of 98%. The proposed approach leverages the strengths of each individual technique to address the challenges associated with tumor detection. CNNs are employed to extract intricate spatial features from medical imaging data, capturing relevant patterns and representations. SVM is then applied to reduce the dimensionality of the feature space, enabling efficient and effective classification. Finally, XGBoost is used to optimize the classification performance by leveraging ensemble learning and gradient boosting techniques. Experimental results on a diverse dataset demonstrate the superiority of the integrated approach, achieving state-of- the-art accuracy and outperforming traditional methods for early-stage tumor detection.

articleTitle: Development of a Blockchain Vehicle Manufacturing Network Using Hyperledger Composer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The network responsible for vehicle manufacturing, often referred to as the automotive manufacturing network, constitutes a sophisticated and interconnected web of entities, processes, and technologies. This intricate system plays a pivotal role in the conception, production, and assembly of various motor vehicles, spanning from cars and trucks to motorcycles and other types of transport. This network encompasses all the essential stages and components necessary to take a vehicle from its initial concept to the ultimate consumer. The industry grapples with a myriad of challenges, including supply chain intricacies, data transparency, adherence to regulatory standards, management of vehicle history and maintenance records, and the nurturing of consumer trust. Addressing these challenges, a blockchain-based permissioned network emerges as a potential solution. With its decentralized and immutable ledger, this technology can meticulously document every event and transaction that unfolds throughout the entire lifecycle of a vehicle, from the initial order placement, status updates, right through to the delivery stage. This work encompasses the implementation of a blockchain-based vehicle manufacturing network that actively involves consumers, manufacturers, and regulatory bodies. The creation of this network leverages the power of the Hyperledger Composer tool, enabling efficient development and management of a robust blockchain infrastructure. The outcomes of this endeavor yield a permissioned network transaction framework meticulously crafted for the unique demands of the car manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: A Robust Predictive Model Using Combined Residual Network and Long Short – Term Memory for Lung Cancer Identification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Lung cancer is the primary cause of cancer mortality in many nations. Both benign and malignant tumors exist. Malignant tumors are meant to be referred to as "cancer" here. Lung cancer has several potential origins, such as secondhand smoke, active smoking, chemical exposure, and genetics. In this study, we present a Residual Network (ResNet)/Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) hybrid model for lung cancer categorization on CT scan pictures, and we compare the suggested model's effectiveness to that of UNet Architecture. The ability to accurately identify or forecast early-stage lung cancer is crucial. Future medical expenses might be cut significantly as a result. The suggested ResNet - LSTM hybrid technique aims to enhance overall accuracy in lung cancer prediction. It can make surgery safer or perhaps unnecessary, and it has been shown to improve survival rates. Thus, technologies for identifying lung cancer are not only easy to use, cheap, and convenient, but also very successful methods for initial identification of lung cancer. As a result, the network is crucial to making an accurate diagnosis. According to our findings, the steps involved in the detection process are as follows: image preprocessing, image segmentation, extraction of features, and finally, identifying the neural system. The primary goals of this study are to (1) compare and contrast different methods to identify lung cancer, and (2) analyze the current best strategy. The ResNet-LSTM algorithm has shown outstanding accuracy, suggesting that its usage in lung cancer identification might improve detection rates. Lung cancer sufferers may find it simpler to detect and treat their condition if the cancer can be predicted at an earlier stage. We discovered that the accuracy of a hybrid ResNet-LSTM model for diagnosing lung cancer was 97%, whereas that of a standard UNet Model was 93%. In comparison to the previous model, the new one had better accuracy, precision, and recall. Clinicians can improve the accuracy and timeliness of lung nodule detection and classification using medical imaging technologies powered by deep learning. This study details the most up-to-date imaging methods for spotting lung cancer in its earliest stages using deep learning. When compare to the most recent state-of-the-art methods, the suggested method's effectiveness and dependability shine through in experimental findings.

articleTitle: Classification of Indicators Based on Morbidity and Mortality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In our evolving world, human vulnerability to diseases remains a critical concern, with an overwhelming volume of health data generated by applications. Managing this massive and complex big data requires advanced processing methods. This is particularly evident in medicine, where predicting outcomes is vital for patient care [15]. The intricate and variable nature of healthcare data presents challenges, necessitating the development of sophisticated algorithms and tools. These advancements have the potential to revolutionize disease prevention, personalized treatment, and healthcare [17] system optimization. Enhancing analytical capabilities is urgent, enabling healthcare professionals to uncover valuable patterns that improve patient care [8]. Efforts are underway to efficiently analyze medical big data [11], promising a brighter future for healthcare. Ultimately, of all the algorithms used, Decision Tree analysis proves to be the most effective approach after enhancing using bagging classifier.

articleTitle: Enhancing Medical Students' Anatomy Memory through Virtual Reality Dissection Simulations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Traditional methods for teaching human anatomy have typically involved lectures and cadaveric dissection. However, modern technology has introduced new educational possibilities, with a particular focus on enhancing 3D visualization, primarily through the use of virtual reality (VR). VR technology offers a level of 3D visualization and interactivity that extends beyond what can be achieved through conventional cadaveric dissection, enabling users to explore anatomical structures in novel and immersive ways. In this research, a mixed methods approach was employed to evaluate the influence of 3D-VR technology on learning outcomes, both in the immediate and extended periods, in comparison to traditional teaching models. Additionally, the study aimed to gain insights into students' experiences and viewpoints concerning the incorporation of 3D-VR as a tool for teaching and learning. In a randomized controlled trial that involved medical students from diverse universities, participants were assigned randomly to either the 3D-VR group or the paper-based group. Following a neuroanatomy baseline test, students in both groups studied spatial relationships between neural structures, complete with test and control questions. This study provides strong empirical support for the use of 3D-VR as a good teaching tool in human anatomy classes, with an emphasis on the benefits it provides to students' learning and retention of course material. Students in the medical field have unanimously lauded 3D-VR as a learning tool that offers substantial advantages over conventional techniques, arguing that it should be incorporated into anatomy courses.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of Internet of Things Assisted Human Voice based Smart Home Controlling System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: When considering the application of the Internet of Things (IoT) within the realm of household environments, it has the transformative potential to elevate an ordinary dwelling into a smart, safer, and automated home. This paper introduces a Voice controlled Home Application, which offers users remote access to their household appliances. This innovative system harnesses the power of IoT technology and voice recognition, providing users with an intuitive and highly efficient means of controlling a diverse array of home appliances and devices. Through voice commands or text messages, users can seamlessly engage with their smart home ecosystem, eliminating the need for manual adjustments. This amazing technology puts the power in our hands, allowing us to effortlessly give voice commands or send text messages. With this system, we can easily turn our appliances on or off to suit our needs, and the best part is, we can do it from anywhere, even if we were not physically at home. All we need to take advantage of this system is our trusty Android smartphone, a device that has become a part of our daily lives, and a control circuit. This control circuit revolves around an Arduino Uno microcontroller, which takes care of processing our commands and handling the operations of our devices. The microcontroller and our smartphone communicate via Bluetooth, a widely embraced wireless technology renowned for its excellent data-sharing capabilities.

articleTitle: Tech-Wrapped Recovery: Exploring the world of Band-Aid 2.0
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: As the socio-economic impact of chronic wounds increases, changes are needed in the way wounds are treated. Treatment requires non-invasive analytical tools. Modern wound care uses smart strips that contain sensors, microprocessors, and other electronic devices to monitor and speed up the healing process. It provides real-time feedback, tracks wound healing, monitors vital signs, including heart rate and blood pressure, and administers certain drugs. Treatments or electrical stimulation to promote tissue regeneration. Due to their immense potential as telemedicine sensors and personal health monitoring tools, wearable health monitoring gadgets have recently attracted a lot of interest. A Smart Bandage can monitor changes in temperature, pH, and moisture in the wound's layers. The objective of this paper is to present an exhaustive analysis of current advances in flexible and stretchy sensors, including identifiable health indicators, mechanisms, useable materials, production processes, and essential and desired attributes. This paper analyses the pertinent literature to better understand the state of smart bandage technologies for wound management.

articleTitle: Prediction of Heat and Cold Wave Events and Analysis of Greenhouse Gas Impacts
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Climate across the world is experiencing unexpected turns including changes in temperature, rainfall and snowfall. India and other Asian countries have seen erratic climate events including city floods, record breaking temperatures both in lower and upper range categories. The summer was so intense and the winter was so worse that cost human life and the death count was on the rise as reported by media and government agencies. The children and elderly people are vulnerable for these kind of climatic events. Erratic climate events are affecting people of all ages and it also leads to development and intensification existing diseases. The existing techniques have many drawbacks such as less accuracy, more time taken for training and prediction. In this paper, a new approach called ensemble learning with H2O AI for auto hyper parameter tuning is proposed for heat wave and cold wave prediction. The proposed methodology performs better with an accuracy of 92%. Post industrialization, a large volume of greenhouse gases is released into the atmosphere. All these combined together, create erratic climate related events in all over the world. The impact of these greenhouse gases are also analyzed and it is found that, if a particular year has strong heat wave, then, the chances of strong cold wave events are also high.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Neural Networks for Image and Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The strategy of transforming vocal discourse signals into text using records is known as programmed discourse acknowledgment (ASR). In the ongoing time of the PC unrest, the ASR has a huge impact in further developing the client experience while communicating with the PCs in a characteristic manner. Conventional instruments like a console and mouse can't be utilized, and the client might do a limitless number of undertakings like controlling of contraptions and correspondence with client care. This study presents an air terminal enquiry framework in view of ASR. The program was made solely for the Telugu language. In view of the most generally posed inquiries about air terminals, a data set was created. Convolutional Brain Organization (CNN) has been utilized for preparing and testing the information base in view of its extraordinary exhibition. Convolution brain organizations (CNNs) have as of late been demonstrated to perform better on the telephone discovery test than regular completely associated profound brain networks when utilized in a half and half profound brain organization/stowed away Markov model (DNN/Gee) design.

articleTitle: Measurements and Monitoring of Network Performance for Routing Protocols in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In order to create a successful routing protocol for WSNs, scalability must be taken into consideration. The relevance of WSNs (wireless sensor networks) is growing. Few uses of wireless sensor networks, despite their widespread use, need real-time, uninterrupted data delivery. Power, storage space, and energy consumption are the three main constraints for WSNs. When deciding on a routing protocol for a WSN, it is crucial to bear these constraints in mind. Based on their characteristics and the types of networks they operate in, routing protocols can be classified. There are several performance measures that may be used to assess a routing protocol's effectiveness. With this kind of study, we can look at how well different routing protocols function and tweak them to perfection. Using MATLAB, this project will pick and simulate a subset of the available cluster head-based routing protocols, before analyzing the resulting data. Before anything else, we use MATLAB to simulate the Low Energy Efficient Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy (LEACH) routing protocol and evaluate its efficacy. The outcomes of the experiments are collected and examined while discussing the effectiveness metrics used.

Author Keywords: Low Energy Efficient Adaptive Clustering Hierarchy

articleTitle: An Empirical Evaluation of Glaucoma Disease Detection using Novel Deep Learning Model with Image Processing Support
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Glaucoma is a degenerative eye condition that, if left untreated, can cause permanent blindness, making early detection and appropriate treatment a major problem. In this research, we investigate how well-known deep learning models, ResNet-50 and AlexNet, perform in spotting glaucoma. Leveraging the power of convolutional neural networks, our research aims to improve the efficiency and precision of glaucoma diagnosis. The study builds upon the existing body of research by comparing the effectiveness of ResNet-50 and AlexNet in analyzing fundus images for signs of glaucoma. These pre-trained models are evaluated using a diverse dataset to identify patients with glaucoma and distinguish them from healthy individuals. We want to tackle the difficulty of early glaucoma diagnosis, which is typically hampered by the lack of noticeable symptoms in the early stages of the illness, by leveraging the power of deep learning. The findings of this research provide insights into the potential of ResNet-50 and AlexNet as effective tools in the early detection of glaucoma, thereby enabling timely medical intervention and mitigating the risk of vision loss and obtained an accuracy of 97.28% performance rate.This research helps advance the quest for better glaucoma diagnostic tools, which will eventually benefit patients and others at risk for this sight-robbing condition.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Mapping and Analysis of Diminishing Water bodies in Chennai Metropolitan: A Multidisciplinary Remote Sensing and GIS based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The primary aim of this study is to examine the behaviour of water body surface levels in the vicinity of Chennai, Tamil Nadu. For the past two decades (2000-2020) Chennai lakes have changed in its water body due to a large number of anthropogenic activities. These water bodies act as reservoirs that depend on the South-West Monsoon showers. In the past two decades, lakes have undergone shrinkage due to various developments that have been computed using Remote Sensing and GIS techniques coupled with field validation. A set of images that were acquired from Google Earth images for the past three decades are employed to map the changes in surface area of the water bodies. In this present study, fifty water bodies have been taken from in and around Chennai to analyse the areal changes of the water bodies. With the use of Google Earth Pro, the fifty water bodies for the past two decades i.e. (2000, 2010 & 2020) are mapped. The mapping of corresponding meta data was used to analyze the condition of these water bodies at present stage. The need for revival and reclamation is mentioned by analyzing the results.

articleTitle: A Novel Methodology to Identify Autism Disorder in Earlier Stages using Artificial Intelligence Assisted Hybrid Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this groundbreaking study, we introduce a novel methodology for the early identification of autism disorder, a crucial step towards more effective intervention and support. Our approach, known as the Artificial Intelligence Assisted Hybrid Learning Scheme (AIHLS), capitalizes on the synergy between cutting-edge transfer learning techniques, specifically Xception, and the XGBoost Classifier. By combining the strengths of these advanced technologies, our method offers a promising avenue for the early detection of Autism Disorder in its nascent stages. When Xception’s feature extraction capabilities are combined with the predictive prowess of XGBoost Classifier, the result is a potent framework capable of addressing complex problems in various domains. This combination offers the advantage of capturing fine-grained image features through Xception and subsequently leveraging XGBoost’s ability to make accurate predictions based on these features. This significant advancement has the capacity to transform the landscape of autism diagnosis, offering the promise of earlier and more precise assessments. Such advancements hold the potential to enhance the overall quality of life for individuals on the autism spectrum as well as their families. In comparison to conventional models, the proposed model has demonstrated an outstanding accuracy rate of 97.11%, underscoring its remarkable performance.

Author Keywords: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Hybrid Learning Scheme (AIHLS)

articleTitle: Feline SentiNet: Deciphering Cat Discomfort with Deep Learning and Random Forest for Pain Grading
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In a world where cats' silent suffering is often overlooked, scientists set out on a life-changing journey aided by technology's empathetic hand. The adventure goes beyond human comprehension, venturing into the domain of AI-driven empathy and the search for a key to the secret language of cat agony. They found a way to shed light on the intricacies of feline discomfort using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and the insight of Random Forest. Each layer in the study reflects a new stanza in the song of recognition, and the research itself evolves like a symphony of pixels. Patterns emerge for the authors when others only see pictures, and they pick up on the agony hidden in the stillness of feline emotions. By bringing together scientific rigor and humaneness, we present a new method for identifying pain in feline companions. Inspiringly, the model distinguished pain intensity among five unique categories with an accuracy of 90%, proving its adeptness in realizing the goals. Researchers saw an instrument that leveled the playing field between man and feline experience when accuracy, recall, and F1 scores all came together. The authors introduce a model that expresses the inexpressible and ease the unspoken as pixels dance, filters learn, and forests decide. In this work, authors celebrate the unspoken connection between people and their feline friends by exploring how technology may serve as a conduit for greater human comprehension, empathy, and the goal of a future in which no one's suffering is ignored.

articleTitle: Smart Monitoring System for Optimization of Tea Plantation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sri Lanka is a global hub for tea production worldwide, and the tea industry has enormous economic and cultural significance to the country. However, the tea industry, though, is confronted with numerous challenges, including unpredictable weather conditions, improper fertilizer application, pest and disease outbreaks, and suboptimal cultivation practices. These challenges are leading to lower yield and more losses. With the increasing unpredictability of weather patterns, it is challenging to determine the precise fertilizer application schedule and dosage. In terms of pest and diseases, effect of the Shot-hole borer, Tea Blister Blight and Stem and Branch Canker are more destructive to the tea plant. Therefore, accurate weather prediction and the early detection of those infections are crucial tasks in tea cultivation. This study presents a smart monitoring system for Sri Lankan tea crop that combines IoT, image processing, audio processing, and DL technologies to address such problems. The Smart Monitoring System gives growers a full toolkit by providing real-time weather insights, fertilizer delivery depending on weather conditions, early insect detection, disease identification, and damage quantification. According to performance evaluations, the proposed method's accuracy results for weather prediction, fertilizer application and identifications of disease, pest, deficiency, and degree of diseased conditions are in the range of 80-100%.

articleTitle: A Quaternary Analysis of Cervical Cancer Identification and Ameliorate using Sigmoid Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Now a days women usually facing several problems that affect their body.
