articleTitle: Design and Development of Human Detection Robot to Rescue People from Disaster Environment by using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In disaster-stricken environments, the rapid and efficient rescue of individuals is of paramount importance. This abstract presents a novel approach to enhance disaster response efforts through the development of a Human Detection Robot (HDR) designed to locate and rescue people in disaster-affected areas. The proposed robot integrates Light Dependent Resistors (LDR) and the HC-SR501 Passive Infrared (PIR) sensor to detect the presence of human beings in low-visibility and challenging environments. The Human Detection Robot is equipped with a robust mechanical structure and a combination of sensors, including LDRs and the HC-SR501 PIR sensor. LDRs are employed to detect variations in ambient light, while the PIR sensor is used to detect human body heat and motion. These sensors work together to ensure reliable and accurate human presence detection, even in environments with low light conditions or obstructions such as dust, smoke, or debris. The robot's design also includes a microcontroller unit (MCU), which processes sensor data and controls the robot's movements. The MCU enables real-time decision-making and navigation to reach and rescue individuals in disaster-stricken areas. The robot is equipped with a communication system that allows it to relay information to the disaster response team, providing them with crucial data about the location and condition of the people in need of rescue. The HDR's rapid response time, when coupled with its robust mechanical design and communication system, positions it as a game-changing asset in disaster management and search and rescue operations.

articleTitle: SmartTask: A Neural Network Powered Block-chain based Intelligent Task Scheduling for Project Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research pioneers SmartTask, an innovative paradigm for intelligent task scheduling in project management, leveraging the novel technique of Reinforcement Learning with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Departing from traditional methods, SmartTask utilizes PPO to dynamically adapt to evolving project requirements, resulting in a significant 30% improvement in task scheduling accuracy. Through meticulous analysis of historical project data using PPO, the system achieves an impressive 25% increase in overall project efficiency, surpassing existing techniques. The implementation of SmartTask with PPO leads to a substantial reduction in scheduling errors, marking a distinct departure from conventional methods. The technology’s exceptional proficiency in resource utilization minimizes idle time and enhances task completion rates. In extensive testing, SmartTask demonstrates unprecedented precision in task scheduling with an outstanding 92% accuracy, establishing a new benchmark for efficiency in project management. This research positions SmartTask as a technological breakthrough and underscores its novelty with the introduction of PPO, reshaping intelligent task scheduling in project management.

articleTitle: Juncture of Text Preprocessing Techniques & Extracting Sentiment Analyzing of Micro-Blog Based on Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Sentiment analysis finds applications in various fields, including marketing, social blog monitoring, public opinion, and customer feedback analysis. Sentiment analysis is the technique of extracting and infers subjective information from content using computational methods, NLP, and phrase analysis. The objective of sentiment analysis’s is to analyze a emotional tone, posture, or opinion identify if a text, such as reviews, social media postings, surveys, or news articles, and classify them as positive, negative, or neutral. Preprocessing methods are used to enhance a quality and relevance of data to be able to optimize the efficiency for any analytical or machine learning (ML) model. These techniques involve various activities such as data cleaning, normalization, transformation, feature engineering, and data integration. In this paper, describe the phase of preprocessing methods transforms raw data into a format that will be effectively processed in machine learning model. In proposed work, we used four ML model (Logistic regression (LR), Decision tree (DT) models, Multinomial Naive Bayes (MNB) and support Vector machine(SVM) model) for train and test the Twitter Sentiment(TS) Review Dataset. It improves the accuracy, consistency, and reliability of data.

Author Keywords: Multinomial Naive Bayes (MNB) and support Vector machine(SVM) model

articleTitle: LiFiData: A Secured Data Communication over Defense Fields by using Intelligent Visible Light Assisted Transmissions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The electronic industry is currently experiencing a transformation due to the rise of solid state devices. Light-Emitting-Diode (LED) are the quintessential solid-state gadget example. LEDs' are a viable alternative to both incandescent and fluorescent lighting. They produce little to no heat and can save you money. As an added bonus, LEDs have a far longer lifespan than conventional light bulbs. LEDs generate higher-quality light in terms of color temperature than both incandescent and fluorescent bulbs. In addition, they can rapidly cycle across a wide range of light intensities. This system must be safe, cheap, and environmentally benign in order to successfully initiate electronic communication utilizing visible light. The suggested system uses a Arduino microcontroller in the transmitting portion, where a high-brightness LED light serves as the channel for communication and a transistor, BC 547, is employed to transform 5v to 12v.When a microcontroller receives data from a computer, it decrypts the information by first converting it to binary, and only then sending it to the led as a digital pulse. The lightbegins to blink as data is transmitted to the receiver; the photo diode begins to sense light, generating electric pulses; the amplifier processes these pulses into data; the data reaches the Arduino, where it can be viewed in the program's serial monitor. For this transmission, direct line-of-sight is essential; however interference from other sources can improve the results in a dark environment. In the lab, LiFi has reached very high speeds, and it also outperforms Wi-Fi in terms of bandwidth, efficiency, availability, and security. This study provides a clear, experimental perspective on the benefits of LiFi technology as well as its potential future applications. However, the hybrid model that incorporates the WiFi and LiFi technologies is expected to see significant growth in demand in the telecommunications industry.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Filter and Optimization Methods for Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Selecting the most important features or attributes from a dataset is a crucial part of machine learning and data analysis. This paper explores the effectiveness of feature selection (FS) methods, comparing filter based techniques such as Pearson Correlation Coefficient (PCC), Spearman Rank Correlation Coefficient (SCC), and Mutual Information (MI) with optimization techniques including Genetic Algorithm (GA), Grey Wolf Optimizer (GWO), Cuckoo Search (CS), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO). The evaluation involves diverse datasets with varying sizes and complexities. The results show that the choice of FS method significantly impacts accuracy. Filter methods perform better with smaller datasets, while optimization algorithms show adaptability across small and high dimensional datasets. This paper shows that the effectiveness of feature selection is closely tied to the specific dataset being analyzed.

articleTitle: A Secure and Adaptable Framework for Decentralized Cloud Storage by Fusion of RDH-EI and Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The primary objective of this research is to investigate the seamless fusion of RDH-EI and blockchain, capitalizing on the inherent strengths of both paradigms. By integrating blockchain into the RDH-EI framework, a distributed ledger system is established, ensuring the confidentiality, integrity, and traceability of embedded data. The integration also introduces a decentralized governance structure through smart contracts, empowering fine-grained control over data access within the decentralized cloud storage environment. Innovatively, this research introduces dynamic parameter adaptation within the RDH-EI process, leveraging blockchain consensus mechanisms to optimize embedding parameters in real-time. This dynamic adjustment accommodates variations in network conditions and evolving security requirements, enhancing the adaptability of the embedding process. The envisioned contributions of this research include a fortified security posture for RDH-EI applications in decentralized cloud storage, dynamic adaptability of embedding parameters, a decentralized key management system, and cross-dataset generalization through extensive evaluations. As the research unfolds, it not only addresses the contemporary challenges of secure multimedia data embedding but also provides a forward-looking perspective, offering a robust and adaptable solution for the evolving landscape of decentralized cloud storage ecosystems. The outcome of this research is anticipated to shape the future of secure and efficient data embedding in the rapidly advancing domain of decentralized cloud storage.

Author Keywords: Smart Contracts and Data Access Control

articleTitle: An Efficient Human Activity Recognition Scheme using Hybrid Deep Learning Strategy with Intelligent Classification Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) is a critical component in various domains, including healthcare, security, and human-computer interaction. Accurate and efficient HAR systems are essential for understanding human behaviors and facilitating smart applications. In this study, we present a novel approach for HAR using a hybrid deep learning strategy that combines Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) and Light Gradient Boosting Machines (LightGBM) with intelligent classification principles. We evaluate the proposed scheme on the publicly available Stanford40 Human Action Dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness and versatility. The Stanford40 Human Action Dataset contains a diverse range of human activities captured through sensors and cameras. Our hybrid approach begins by preprocessing and feature extraction from this dataset, aiming to extract informative features that capture both temporal and spatial patterns. Our hybrid strategy involves a two-stage classification pipeline. In the first stage, a CNN-based model is employed to learn intricate representations from the feature vectors. In the second stage, LightGBM, a powerful gradient boosting framework, is introduced to refine the classification process. LightGBM focuses on addressing misclassified instances from the CNN's output, acting as an intelligent ensemble component. This combination enhances overall recognition performance significantly. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our hybrid approach with an accuracy of 96%, when compared to traditional methods and single-model architectures. This approach combines the strengths of deep learning and gradient boosting while introducing adaptability and context-awareness to achieve accurate and reliable recognition of human activities, thereby contributing to the development of smarter and more responsive human-centric technologies.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis for Depression using Human Expression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Millions of people across the globe suffer from the debilitating mental illness known as depression. Early intervention and treatment of those suffering from depression is of the utmost importance in ensuring that the condition does not worsen. This study demonstrates a machine learning system for recognizing depression in an individual through their vocal characteristics and facial expressions. Psychological questions are posed, and their answers are recorded along with their voice and facial features, to evaluate their current emotional state.To develop this system, we employ AngularJS for the front end, Flask for the back end and Python for the machine learning process. Specifically, we utilize Python packages such as io, cv2, pickle, numpy, pandas, talk\_recognition, moviepy, pydub, keras, tempfile, flask, vander Sentiment and twitter_analysis. The data collected is then processed through video, audio and question-and-answer methods, and the results show that our system is able to detect mood disorder with 89\% precision, 92% accuracy, 87% recall, and 89% F1 outcomes. The conclusion that can be drawn is that these techniques have the potential to be effective tools in the early identification of depression.

articleTitle: A highly efficient and scalable prediction approach based on random forest that is capable of handling enormous data sets
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Cardiovascular illnesses include elevated blood pressure, stroke, heart failure, and heart disease. They are the leading causes of premature mortality all over the globe, especially in economically disadvantaged and countries with middle incomes. The diagnosis of these conditions at an earlier stage might lead to a drop in the number of untimely deaths. Health care is an incredibly important and promising application of data mining. The medical field has benefited substantially from data mining. Heart Disease is a challenging but manageable chronic disease that people around the world are diligently striving to manage. There are a total of 70,000 samples in the dataset, and its qualities may be broken down into 12 categories. Data was then examined in a jupyter notebook (anaconda-3) environment. Random forest, a machine learning approach, is used to do both classification and analysis of the data sets. Percentages representing accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity are used to illustrate the dataset's findings. Employing the random forest technique, we were able to enhance our accuracy at foreseeing cardiac issues by 86.9%. Furthermore, the sensitivity was 80.6%, while the specificity was 82.7 percent. After conducting an analysis of random forest's operational features, we found that it has a medical accuracy of 85 % when it comes to forecasting the outcome of cardiovascular illness. It has been shown that the random forest is the most efficient algorithm for identifying cardiac diseases consequently, which is included in the suggested technique.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Novel Artificial Intelligence Assisted Children’s Fingerprint Recognition System using Enhanced Biometrical Strategy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The Novel Artificial Intelligence Assisted Children’s (NAIAC) Fingerprint Recognition System using Modified Artificial Neural Network presents an innovative approach to biometric authentication tailored specifically for children. In an era marked by heightened concerns for child security and privacy, this research introduces a pioneering solution that harnesses the potential of artificial intelligence (AI) and a modified neural network architecture to achieve accurate and dependable identification of young individuals based on their fingerprints. This system effectively addresses the unique challenges associated with fingerprint recognition in children, such as evolving physical features and limited fingerprint data. Through the application of a specialized artificial neural network architecture, enhanced with modifications tailored to the intricacies of children’s fingerprints, NAIAC achieves exceptional accuracy and robustness in the identification and authentication of young subjects. Notable features of the NAIAC system encompass its adaptability to changing physical traits, remarkable reduction in false-positive rates, and seamless integration into a wide range of applications, including child protection, access control in educational institutions, and healthcare management. Furthermore, the NAIAC system places paramount importance on adhering to stringent privacy regulations and ethical guidelines, ensuring that children’s sensitive biometric data remains secure and confidential. An accuracy of 99.12% is considered exceptionally high in many applications. It indicates that the model is making accurate predictions or classifications for a vast majority of cases, which is often the primary objective in machine learning.

articleTitle: Enhancing Online Learning: A Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Models and Data Visualization Techniques for Predicting Learner Flexibility
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: The fast growth of online learning has increased the demand for efficient tools and approaches to measure and improve student’s capacity to adapt to online learning. This paper gives a thorough comparative comparison of Machine Learning (ML) models and data visualization techniques for predicting the flexibility of learners in the realm of online education. In this study, various data visualization techniques are investigated to learn more about how learners behave, engage with, and perform in online courses. Understanding patterns and trends through data visualization is essential for educators and institutions to make well-informed decisions to enhance learner’s learning journeys. To find out how effective different visualization techniques are in revealing useful insights, IBM Cognos and Python are used. The suitability of several ML algorithms for predicting learners’ flexibility levels is also examined in this study. The predictive accuracy or mean accuracy score of several ML models, including XGBoost, Random Forests, CatBoost, Logistic Regression, and K Nearest Neighbour, is compared. The dataset used for this investigation contains a variety of learner-related variables, such as demographic data, past academic achievement, and interactions with online courses. For educators and educational institutions looking to use data-driven techniques to improve online learning experiences, the findings of this comparative study offer invaluable advice to them. This study contributes to the ongoing attempts to raise the caliber and efficacy of online education by identifying the most efficient data visualization strategies and ML models for forecasting learners’ flexibility. The study’s conclusions enable educators to proactively identify learners who are at risk of having difficulty with online learning, enabling prompt interventions and individualized support for academic success.

articleTitle: Forecasting of Cryptocurrency and Stocks Prices using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Algorithmic trading is the process of executing the predetermined set of trading instructions to account the varying market data. Recently, the use of Machine Learning techniques to forecast Stock Market prices has become popular, however, the recent focus has been shifted to the value of the new digital asset, Cryptocurrency. It is a virtual or digital currency used in the financial system. This paper aims to build an Algorithmic Trading Bot that can forecast (Time Series Forecasting) the more accurate Stocks price and try to predict the Cryptocurrency prices. Several Machine Learning techniques like Support Vector Regression (SVR), Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) network, and Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA), are put into practice for forecasting. It is primarily concentrated on offering the most profitable predictions and precise findings that would permit significant gains for interested users. This study has provisionally acquired an effective outcome, with price prediction accuracy of the selected stocks ranging from 92-99% and cryptocurrencies ranging from 80-85%.

articleTitle: Efficient Power Generation System Using Single Axis Solar Tracking with Weather Monitor
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Growing at the fastest rate among renewable energy sources is solar energy. Using a basic dual-axis solar tracker system, the project is conceived and executed. Solar tracking devices are a must for solar power plants in order to optimize solar energy production. Utilizing a switching solar panel, a dual-axis tracker tracks the sun's beams in many directions to maximize energy production.The 360-degree rotation of this solar panel is possible. The light intensity was sensed at 30 degrees per degree, or 180 degrees overall, using an LDR (Light Dependent Resistor), which subsequently sent data to the microcontroller. Also, this dual-axis solar tracker project has an LCD display, humidity and temperature sensors, and a raindrop detector.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-based Intelligent Algorithms for Effective Transmission Authentication and Anomaly Identification in Vehicular Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Vehicular networks enable effective traffic control and security on the roads. Sustaining security and network performance depends on authentic transmission and anomaly detection. The inherent delays in conventional approaches to transmission authentication and anomaly detection limit their utility in actual-time vehicular network conditions. In this paper, we present the Deep Attentive Optimized Bidirectional Long/Short Term Memory (DABLSTM) method. The method combines the advantages of deep learning with those of attention mechanisms and bidirectional LSTM. The dataset was gathered from the Hacking and Countermeasure Research Lab (HCRL). Min-max normalization is used for data pre-processing, and then Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is used for efficient feature extraction, which optimizes the source data for our method. The DA-BLSTM method examines the approach's efficiency by evaluating its performance achieves the accuracy (91.2%), recall rate (92.8%), precision (92.3%), and F1-score (93.4%). The DA-BLSTM prevails over traditional techniques by displaying lower latency and considerably higher accuracy in detecting proper transmissions and anomalies within vehicular network data. We present a promising approach for real-time, safe, reliable, and effective authentication and anomaly identification in vehicle networks, establishing an innovative standard for vehicular communication safety.

Author Keywords: deep attentive optimized Bidirectional long/short term memory (DA-BLSTM)

articleTitle: An Efficient Allocation of Resources in wireless Communications IoT Network for Numerous Users
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Wireless-powered communication (WPC) emerges as a highly promising technological avenue for a diverse range of intelligent network applications spanning the industrial, commercial, and security domains. The proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices on a global scale is experiencing an unprecedented surge. In the landscape of next-generation networks, the strategic deployment of distributed fog computing at the network periphery offers a pivotal means of provisioning computational resources, with a specific focus on applications demanding minimal latency. Pertaining to the matter of link spectral efficiency within wireless networks, the conventional assumption that higher values inevitably translate to heightened efficiency across the broader radio access network is challenged. Within this context, we introduce a low-complexity Robust Channel Allocation Algorithm (RCAA) designed for efficient user grouping. Furthermore, we utilize Reinforcement Learning (RL) to model the challenges posed by unpredictable energy arrival and fluctuating channel conditions for each user. Within this framework, we introduce an innovative power allocation algorithm designed to enhance the overall network throughput over a limited time span comprising multiple time slots. To verify the effectiveness and resilience of our proposal, we employ Logarithmic-based utility functions that cater to the unique requirements of both devices tolerant to delays and real-time Internet of Things (IoT) applications. Through thorough simulations, we establish the effectiveness of our approach, providing conclusive evidence of its ability to efficiently manage resource allocation and achieve optimal results.

articleTitle: Safety Wearable Devices for Monitoring and Predicting the Emergency of Civil Workers Using Mobile Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In several industries, wearable sensing devices are assisting workers in maintaining their health and safety. However, because WSDs can record precise information that might be regarded as private and personal, workers, particularly in the construction industry, have demonstrated some resistance to their use. Nonetheless, this highly regarded data may offer some crucial insight that management needs in order to plan and enhance worksite safety and assist the implementation of technology in decision-making. This project aims to develop a wearable safety device for construction workers, integrating various sensors such as a flame sensor, max30100 sensor, neo-6m GPS module, and MPU6050 sensor. The wearable device is intended to track the worker's position, monitor heart rate and SpO2, and identify falls and fire mishaps. The MQTT protocol will be used to transfer the sensor data to an Android application, enabling for real-time monitoring and emergency warning. To detect falls at the edge, the device also includes a Raspberry Pi camera module. The ultimate purpose of this initiative is to increase safety for construction workers and lower the likelihood of accidents and injuries occurring on job sites. The findings show the development of wearable technology in construction safety research and shed light to reduce the risk of civil workers. The analysis also provides a dynamic platform for integrating future applications and describes the current state of wearable technology in the field of construction safety.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-Based Autonomous Collision Prediction and Avoidance System for Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study investigates the feasibility developing an Autonomous Collision Prediction and Avoidance System (RL-ACPAS) based on Reinforcement Learning automobiles in light of the increasing prevalence of autonomous vehicles on the road. In this research, we used a thorough approach that included data gathering from many sensors, RL agent training using deep reinforcement learning algorithms, and performance assessment. The findings show that RL-ACPAS has high rates of avoiding collisions, fast reaction times, and effective decision-making, all of which bode well for enhancing road safety, traffic efficiency, and economic sustainability. These results, combined with hypothetical data and practical consequences, illustrate the transformational potential of RL-ACPAS. The real-world effects on security, effectiveness, economy, and trust are emphasized throughout the presentation. Insights into technological developments, road safety awareness, regulatory issues, and consumer advantages are also provided to readers. Future directions include things like improved learning algorithms, sensor integration, field testing, ethics, human-AI interaction, regulatory frameworks, data sharing, and constant progress. The future of RL-ACPAS is one of experimentation, cooperation, and dedication to making autonomous transportation systems more secure and dependable.

articleTitle: Smart Hela Wedakama Application to Guide Patients and Apprentice Native Physicians
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research paper explores the transformative potential of Machine Learning (ML) and augmented Reality (AR) in healthcare and Sri Lankan traditional medicine otherwise "Hela Wedakama". It focuses on four key aspectsas the ayurvedic plant identification component leverages using Machine Learning(ML) models to identify medicinal plants with decent accuracy, fostering the preservation and utilization of ayurvedic remedies, disease diagnosis, and doctor recommendations utilizing voice recognition and machine learning to enhance healthcare accessibility, handwritten prescription identification offers a specialized solution, catering to Sinhala language complexities and, an augmented reality-based application visualizes pressure points otherwise "Nila Wedakama", bridging the gap between traditional practices and modern healthcare. These integrative approaches exemplify the potential of traditional medicine in modern contexts. The paper highlights the benefits of ML & AR to advance patient care, streamline processes, and contribute to the development of skilled practitioners, driving innovation in healthcare and traditional medicine practices.

articleTitle: Machine Learning based Learning Style Detection using Felder-Silverman Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This research paper examines how the Felder and Silverman learning style framework can be used to predict student performance and improve learning outcomes by predicting a learner’s preferred learning style. By using a questionnaire-based approach, data can be collected and analyzed to categorize learners according to four dimensions: perception vs. intuitive; visual vs. visual; verbal vs. reflective; and sequential vs global. The predicted learning style information can then be used by educators to customize teaching strategies or course materials to meet the individual learning needs of learners, especially in online or distance learning settings. The adaptive approach has been shown to improve student engagement and learning outcomes. This framework is a valuable tool for understanding and responding to the diverse learning needs of students in different educational settings.

articleTitle: Improving Accuracy of Activity Recognition in IOT-enabled automated residence using CatBoost: A Comparative Evaluation with OpenSHS Generated Dataset
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Automated residence depends on precise activity identification to offer personalized services, improve safety, and improve user experience. This research article compares the performance of CatBoost, a potent machine learning algorithm, in enhancing activity detection. To conduct the assessment, we construct an elaborate dataset using the OpenSHS for a particular user over a span of a time. The dataset captures a wide array of activities performed within an Automated residence environment. Using this dataset, we train and evaluate the CatBoost modelalongside other advanced algorithms. We analyse variousfactors such as accuracy, resilience, and computational efficiency to gauge CatBoost performance. The outcomes demonstrate that CatBoost outperforms other algorithms inprecisely recognizing activities in the Automatedresidence environment. This research contributes to the advancement of Automated residence by highlighting CatBoost as an effective solution for activity recognition. The findings offer valuable insights into CatBoost’s potential for enhancing activity recognition in real-world Automated residence scenarios, leading to improved personalized and intelligent services.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach to Memory Disorder Diagnose Using Deep Learning Integration and Adaptive Artificial Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Alzheimer’s illness is an untreatable brain condition that gradually erodes cognitive function, early identification can greatly lessen effects. In light of the lack of skilled doctors, the computerized identification of the illness becomes increasingly crucial since it lessens the workload on doctors and improves the accuracy in making the diagnostic. Using segmentation MRI scans, the condition must be precisely diagnosed by a thorough examination of particular brain problem tissues. The collection of pictures taken for dementia detected using MRI scans is divided into four categories: mildly informal (896 pictures), moderately informal (64 photos), not informal (3200 pictures), as well as extremely mildly informal (2240 pictures). The information available is seriously skewed. To solve this problem, we applied the adaptive artificial exceeding method. This method was used, and the information collected was matched. In order to test the effectiveness of the designs, a combination of VGG16 as well as Efficient Net was utilised to identify Alzheimer’s disease using both unbalanced and equal information. This method was used, and the information collected was normalised. The suggested approach merged numerous algorithms' projections to create a team approach that extracted intricate and subtle trends within the information at hand. Both algorithms' input and output were merged to create a combined approach, which was subsequently transferred to additional levels to create a more reliable prediction. In this project, we suggested a combination of EfficientNet-B2 and VGG-16 to accurately detect the illness at its earliest stages. Using two databases that are accessible to the public, studies were conducted. According to the findings of the study, the suggested technique obtained 97.85% efficiency and 99.64% (Area Under Curve) for multiple classes information.

articleTitle: Enhancing Tourism Experience in Sri Lanka through Data Driven Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)

authors.preferredName: N. H. P. Ravi Supunya Swarnakantha

abstract: Prescriptive systems used today have expanded to such an extent that it can be said to be one of the essential needs of man. These systems are designed to help users choose the best option based on their preferences. In this paper, a system called TourBuddy is proposed with the aim of solving and improving the existing problems in the Sri Lankan tourism industry. This system is also a recommendation system based on personalized recommendations. The system utilizes machine learning algorithms and large amounts of data, and the proposed mobile application aims to provide tailored suggestions for travel destinations, food and dining experiences, activities and events, and transportation options. Based on personalized recommendations, the system can recommend attractive destinations in Sri Lanka, recommend food and dining, recommend sports, festivals and activities available in Sri Lanka, and recommend transportation options. In addition to personalized recommendations, other technologies are also used to incorporate several other valuable features into the system. A component to provide cultural and ethical practices to be followed based on the specific destination, a component to identify the local food of Sri Lanka, a component to post the various events organized in Sri Lanka and a component for tourists to choose suitable vehicles for their travel. Through the seamless integration of these features, the mobile app seeks to revolutionize the way travelers plan their trips to Sri Lanka, offering a convenient and efficient online platform. This research contributes to the advancement of the travel industry by not only providing a user-friendly and reliable mobile application but also exploring the potential of data-driven personalization to improve the overall travel experience.

articleTitle: An Examination of Machine Learning Techniques for Automating and Optimizing VLSI Design
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This study centers around assessing power utilization in CMOS VLSI circuits utilizing administered learning. The proposed model does not rely on a biased set of empirical conditions or restrictions, but on additional conventional strategies such as recommended SPICE circuit representations. Unlike other innovations, it delivers accurate results without customer bias on availability or circuit geography. The proposed plan recommends a more convincing alternative translation, but doing so would require a significant amount of additional information. Exploring and improving technologies to reduce planning complexity due to long process variations and reduce time to return to chip manufacturing is clearly a challenge for the nanoscale integrated circuit industry (IC). The usual strategy used for these commitments is generally manual. Therefore, they require a lot of time and wealth. Conversely, very large integrated planning (VLSI) and testing can take advantage of a variety of new computational pathways due to the unique learning methods of artificial intelligence (AI).

articleTitle: Utilize Azure Traces Cold-Start to Predict using Machine Learning on Azure ML
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: A significant delay of as many as a few seconds was often noticed by researchers when initially using serverless routines. This condition, sometimes called the "cold start," is exacerbated when users use a workflow that orchestrates many serverless activities. However, users often need to launch many serverless functions at once, sometimes as part of simultaneous loops. This article introduces the spawn start and examines how three Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) providers Microsoft Azure Functions behave when concurrent loops are started both warmly and coldly. Through a series of studies, we discovered three findings that will be useful to the scientific community. unreasonable expenses to consumers or service providers. In contrast to the state-of-the-art policies with a more constrained emphasis, this study suggests a unique low-coupling, high-cohesion ensemble policy that solves the cold-start issue. The forecast of function case arrivals, between ten and fifteen minutes in the future, serves as the anchor for this ensemble strategy. Through the application of the machine-learning approach, it is possible. Benchmarking findings on a large-scale serverless cloud provider's real-world dataset demonstrate that outperforms other well-known machine learning methods for time series.

articleTitle: Mobilenet and Deep Residual Network for Object Detection and Classification of Objects in IoT Enabled Construction Safety Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Construction areas are extremely dangerous since the dynamic communication amongst workers and moving tools along with wide fatality rates occurred by collision. Falls, struck-bys, and caught-in-between are the general kinds of accidents that happen in work area. In spite of having their unique benefits, more number of day–to-day accident prevention events respond passively to situations where workers or tools enter predefined unsafe areas. To prevent these types of accidents, a new scheme is introduced for object detection (OD) and classification of objects in IoT-enabled constructing safety monitoring named Mobile-Residual Network (MR-Net), where MR-Net is merged by MobileNet and Deep Residual Network (DRN). This module is composed of three sub-systems, prevention of backover accidents, smart alerting for probable risk avoidance, and middleware IoT platform. The first technique has IoT network with sensor unit. The second technique has cloud server employed to provide smart alerts. The third one is detection progress carried out by image processing with the aid of collected images. First, IoT nodes are simulated, wherein IoT image sensors are responsible for collecting data. At base station, the collected data is pre-progressed by utilizing Non- Local Means (NLM) filter. After that, object is detected by you only live once v3 (YOLO v3) where the recognized objects, like person, machines, vehicles and safety cones are detected. If the detected object is person then classify the objects like Hardhat, Mask and Safety Vest worn using MR-Net. The analytic measures utilized for MR-Net such as accuracy, True Positive Rate (TPR), True Negative Rate (TNR), Positive predictive value (PPV) and Negative predictive value (NPV) gained maximal values of 0.912, 0.905, 0.923, 0.909 and 0.919.

Author Keywords: you only live once v3 (YOLO v3)

articleTitle: Multimodal Speaker Recognition: Combining FFT, CNN, Speech-to-Text, BERT-Based Punctuation Restoration and Sentence Correction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: In this paper, we look at technological solutions to problems with speech recognition, text-to-speech conversion, sentence correction, and punctuation restoration. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for model development, the Fast Fourier transform (FFT) for feature extraction from data, and the potent Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers (BERT) model for context-aware sentence correction are all included into our methodology. Our study intends to enhance the precision, context sensitivity, and usability of language processing systems by merging CNNs, FFT, and BERT. By providing excellent transcription and precise sentence correction, this holistic approach pushes the limits of audio-based applications.

articleTitle: Automatic Skin Pathology Prognoser - Cutis Care

abstract: It takes a Physician, a family doctor, a specialist and a chief doctor to diagnose a skin disease and make a critical decision about the treatment process. It is important for a Doctor to spend enough time on a patient’s diagnosis as it decides the course of treatment. The prevalence of skin diseases in the general population in different geographic regions of India varies from 7.9 to 60 percent. This ratio is increasing as the skin diseases are not considered seriously and handled very recklessly by people People are lazy to go visit a doctor until and unless it becomes something serious Diseases like Psoriasis first start like a small rash and can be treated and cured if found in a early stage whereas delaying makes it deadly. The aim is to automatically diagnose a skin disease just by scanning the affected part.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Security in Cloud Computing Using Optimal Risk Access Control Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: This paper develops an Optimal Risk Access Control Model (ORACM) for enhancing security in cloud computing. In this proposed model, three important risk aspects are considered such as environment attribute, resource attribute and subject attribute. Based on these factors, the suggested risk validation indexes were created, and by fusing Adaptive Snake Optimization (ASO) and Policy Approach Access Control (PAAC), the risk validation computation method would be quantitatively validated. In the PAAC, the optimization method is taken into account while choosing the decision. Based on the validation, optimization and choosing the best risk decision is reducing waiting time. conventional access control continues to receive access needs as extended as they are genuine once the architecture is in an emergency state (like when the CPU and memory remain saturated), raising the danger of a system crash. Consider a case where the system is presently in an emergency, on the other hand. The authentication token may be misused, leading to the unauthorized access of system resources and services, if the security of the primary environment depreciates. The suggested strategy is put into practice, and its effectiveness is assessed by taking into account performance indicators including waiting time, convergence analysis, and CPU usage. It is also contrasted with traditional approaches.

Author Keywords: adaptive snake optimization and convergence analysis

articleTitle: Resume Screening–Testing For Data Stability
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Innovative Computing, Intelligent Communication and Smart Electrical Systems (ICSES)
abstract: Resume parsing and evaluation are critical tasks for human resources teams, and with the surplus of candidates applying to jobs in today’s time, the process of resume evaluation is both manual and time consuming. The process of resume parsing has been traditionally done manually, which is time-consuming and prone to errors. However, with the advancements in Natural Language Processing (NLP), automated resume parsing has become a popular research area. In addition to parsing, the advent of machine learning has allowed resume screening to be automated, through the use of key words and named entities. In this technical paper, we provide a comprehensive analysis of pre-existing research on resume parsing and evaluation frameworks, and provide a detailed overview of the different NLP techniques used for resume parsing, such as Named Entity Recognition, along with the various machine learning algorithms used for screening resumes, such as cosine similarity. We then implement our own models using resume datasets provided by a third-party firm, and analyze the stability and consistency of output data for each model using frequency distribution graphs, statistical averages, etc. in order to determine the best model for our given dataset. This paper provides a number of valuable graphs and observations that can be helpful for researchers and practitioners in the field of recruitment, machine learning.
